abstract_en: The utility model relates to a classroom management system based on thing networking comprises host computer, zigBee controller and classroom node. The upper computer is connected with the ZigBee controller through a serial port; the ZigBee coordinator is connected with the classroom nodes through no signal. On the basis of wireless Internet of things control, classroom ring-ringing, fire-fighting and security system are integrated, and more than 200 classroom nodes are monitored simultaneously; any instruction information can be issued to any classroom at any time, and each classroom node is independently controlled; the upper computer software and the school educational administration system are networked, so that the purpose of ringing in a classroom is realized, and no classroom is worried. The functions of unattended operation, automatic fortification and automatic starting of the alarm are realized. The method is unattended; monitoring in real time; the automatic alarm system is started, and the correct escape route is automatically broadcasted by voice at the first time, so that the personal and property safety of teachers and students is powerfully guaranteed. The classroom navigation function is realized, convenience is provided for students to study, and the classroom utilization rate is improved.

title_en: Page-turning type dynamic displaying method for multi-floor indoor map
abstract_en: The invention discloses a page-turning type dynamic displaying method for a multi-floor indoor map, which is a method for displaying geographical information of multiple floors on the same plane in a page-turning manner through nonlinear texture mapping. The method comprises the following steps of drawing a planar graph of geographical information data of each floor; calculating a nonlinear transformation parameter of each layer according to a point of sight appointed by a user and the geographical information data; performing texture mapping on the planar graph of each layer according to the parameter, and gradually mapping the planar graph to a screen picture; searching an optimal path from the geographical information data according to information of a start point and an end point which are input by the user; generating a route map of the optimal path; combining the generated route map into a page-turning type map according to a front-and-back sheltering relation of the page-turning type map to obtain a final navigation path map.

title_en: Personnel characteristic-based fire evacuation path navigation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel characteristic-based fire evacuation path navigation method which comprises the following steps: 1, obtaining fire behavior information through a fire detector, calculating an effective time range capable of being used for escape of each path; 2, reading personnel label information by using an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) reader-writer, locating personal position information, performing personnel evacuating speed classifying according to the obtained personnel label information and the obtained personnel position information; 3, for personnel with different speeds, calculating evacuating path information by using a shortest path precedence algorithm, wherein the evacuating path information comprises a shortest path length value from an initial position to an outlet node D and all nodes on the path; and 4, sending the shortest path length value and all nodes on the path to personnel to be evacuated. According to the personnel characteristic-based fire evacuation path navigation method, the utilization rate of the path can be effectively increased.

title_en: Navigation device, control method, program and storage medium
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation system capable of evacuating a user to an evacuation place quickly and safely.SOLUTION: A navigation device includes: tsunami information acquisition means; guide means; and notification means. The tsunami information acquisition means acquires tsunami information including information showing an arrival range of tsunami and information showing arrival prediction time. The guide means shows an evacuation place which is reachable before the arrival prediction time and where tsunami is avoidable as a destination on the basis of the tsunami information and a present location of a vehicle. The notification means notifies, in voice or in display, a user of the fact that the user should get off the car and evacuate when there is no safe route to the destination.

title_en: Emergency, security, and accessibility apparatus and methods
abstract_en: Systems, methods, means and computer program products for determining a position of an object in an environment are disclosed. Certain systems, methods, means and computer program products carry out position determination for asset tracking, emergency evacuations, navigation and other uses.

title_en: Evacuation guidance device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation guidance device capable of being easily used by anyone without a use of a terminal device capable of connecting to a communication network.SOLUTION: The evacuation guidance device which is installed in an outdoor location includes: a display part for displaying a map which includes a present position and an evacuation place; an outdoor light for lighting the whole of the display part; a route guidance light which is placed along a route from the present position displayed on the display part to the evacuation place; and a seismic control part for detecting shakiness and, when detecting shakiness equal to or greater than the predetermined seismic intensity, supplying power to the route guidance light so as to cause the route guidance light to light.

title_en: Robotic First Responder System and Method
abstract_en: A robotic first responder system provides injured patients with first response medical care and extracts the injured patient from a dangerous or remote area. After assessing of the level of consciousness of an injured patient, the robotic unit utilizes an inflatable immobilization device for safe robotic rescue of injured patients. The robotic unit lifts and transfers an injured patient to an extraction vehicle, a secure, bullet-proof wheeled system that can be pulled by the robot to safe location. The extraction vehicle continues serving as the evacuation stretcher to a medical station. The robotic unit utilizes zero moment point control to maintain stability while lifting the patient. A robot first responder tows the extraction vehicle or the extraction vehicle self-navigates incorporating with power drive and autonomous navigation systems.

title_en: Service to inform the approach of emergency vehicles and concessions
title_ko: 긴급차량접근 알림 및 피양 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for notifying the approach of an emergency vehicle and guiding evacuation and, more specifically, to a system for notifying the approach of an emergency vehicle and guiding evacuation capable of informing a driver of an ordinary vehicle about the approach of an emergency vehicle or a safe evacuation method by transmitting a certain frequency when the emergency vehicle is dispatched and installing a receiver for receiving the frequency in a navigation device. To achieve the objective described above, the present invention includes: a signal generator which is installed in an emergency vehicle and transmits a certain frequency in an emergency situation; a signal receiver which is installed in a navigation device or a terminal including a navigation function and receives the signal transmitted from the emergency vehicle when the emergency vehicle approaches within a certain range; and an audio guide unit which notifies a driver about the approach of the emergency vehicle. According to the present invention, a method for notifying the approach of an emergency vehicle and guiding evacuation includes: a step of transmitting an emergency dispatch signal from an emergency vehicle; a step of receiving the signal transmitted from the emergency vehicle using a navigation device or a terminal; and a step of notifying the approach and current location of the emergency vehicle based on the received signal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급차량접근 알림 및 피양 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 긴급차량이 출동하는 경우에 특정의 주파수를 발신하고, 내비게이션에는 상기 주파수를 수신할 수 있는 수신기를 구비하여 일반차량의 운전자가 긴급차량의 접근 여부 및 안전한 피양 방법 등을 알 수 있도록 하는 긴급차량의 접근 알림 및 파양 안내 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
상기의 목적을 달성하기 위한 기술적 사상으로서의 본 발명은, 긴급차량에 구비되어 긴급상황에서 특정 주파수를 발신하는 신호발생기와, 내비게이션 또는 내비게이션기능이 구비된 단말기에 구비되어 상기 긴급차량이 일정한 범위 내에 접근하면 상기 긴급차량으로부터 발신되는 신호를 수신하는 신호수신기 및 운전자에게 긴급차량의 접근 여부를 알려주는 음성안내부를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다. 
 본 발명에 따른 긴급차량 접근 및 피양 안내 방법은, 긴급차량에서 긴급출동신호를 발신하는 단계; 상기 긴급차량으로부터 발신되는 신호를 내비게이션 또는 단말기를 이용하여 수신하는 단계 및 상기 수신된 신호를 기초로 상기 긴급차량의 접근사실 및 상기 긴급차량의 현재의 위치를 알려주는 단계를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Simulation testing system for inertial navigation technology
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a simulation testing system for an inertial navigation technology. The simulation testing system comprises a loading vehicle, a shelter, an aligning analog device, a vehicle-mounted testing system, a GPS transmitting system and a power supply system, wherein the shelter comprises an air conditioner, a vehicle-mounted cabinet, a worktable and a seat; the aligning analog device comprises a rotary table and a rotary table control system; the vehicle-mounted testing system comprises an industrial personal computer, a PCI expansion card, a power supply monitoring device and a test system software program. The test system software program is based on a LabVIEW platform, and utilizes the moving of the loading vehicle and the rotating of the vehicle-mounted rotary table to provide real operating environment for the inertial navigation to be tested, the equipment to be tested is mounted on the vehicle-mounted rotary table, and the simulations of ground movement and space flight are realized through the movement of the loading vehicle; through the precision control of the vehicle-mounted three-axle table, precise posture simulation is realized, the power supply system provides uninterruptible power supply for experimental equipment in the vehicle parking, starting and driving process, and the testing benchmark is obtained through a test control system so as to provide excitation signal, collect and analyze the navigation data in real time and provide a test result.
assignees: TIANJIN OPTICAL ELECTRICAL COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Indoor emergency response and context awareness navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor emergency response and context awareness navigation system and method. The navigation system at least comprises a location sensor network, a server and an early warning sensor, wherein the location sensor network comprises a location base station, a mobile terminal and/or a location label and an LED (Light Emitting Diode) screen; the location base station is in wired or wireless connection with the server; the mobile terminal and/or the location label is in wireless connection with the location base station; the LED screen is in wired connection with the location base station; the early warning sensor is in wireless connection with the server. The navigation method is capable of combining a plurality of context calculation navigation paths of indoor environment, self-adaptively presenting the navigation paths to users according to the scenes of the users in many ways and providing real-time, accurate and individual navigation service. The navigation system and the navigation method are applicable to personnel location, emergency evacuation, rescue after disaster and safety management of large complex indoor venues such as hospitals, markets, office buildings and stations; meanwhile, the navigation system and the navigation method are capable of improving scientificity, timeliness, effectiveness of emergency response of public places.

title_en: Marine navigation simulation device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a marine navigation simulation device capable of performing an accurate simulation for a plurality of vessels when preparing a routing or the like.SOLUTION: A marine navigation simulation device comprises: a storage unit 21 which stores weather and marine conditions in a predetermined sea area, a plurality of navigation routes in the sea area, and vessel speeds of the plurality of vessels that operates in the sea area; a navigation route selection unit 23 which, on the basis of the weather and marine conditions and the vessel speeds, selects a navigation route from among the plurality of navigation routes. The navigation route includes harbor shelters for a vessel. The navigation route selection unit 23, when determining that the weather and marine conditions are unfavorable for the vessel to sail from the current harbor shelter to a next harbor shelter, calculates the vessel's navigation time with the vessel staying in the current harbor shelter for a prescribed time and selects the navigation route by which the navigation time can be the shortest among the plurality of navigation routes for each of the plurality of vessels.

title_en: Disaster condition escape helmet
abstract_en: A disaster situation escape helmet comprises a helmet body, wherein a wind shielding goggle and an oronasal mask are connected to the front of the helmet body, breathing holes are formed in the oronasal mask, smoke filters are installed on the breathing holes, a searchlight is installed at the front end of the helmet body, a lining, an intelligent map prompting device and a battery for supplying power to the intelligent map prompting device and the searchlight are arranged in the helmet body; the intelligent map prompting device comprises a chip which is arranged at the top of the helmet liner and can be positioned in real time and has map information stored therein, and loudspeakers arranged at two inner sides of the helmet. The helmet is provided with the chip with the positioning function and the stored map information, when a disaster occurs, the chip can be used for positioning a disaster-encountering person in real time and planning escape route navigation in time, and helps the disaster-encountering person to leave a disaster site as soon as possible and escape in time.

title_en: Lane-level vehicle navigation for vehicle routing and traffic management
title_ko: 차량 라우팅 및 교통 관리를 위한 차선 레벨 차량 내비게이션
abstract_en: A lane-level vehicle routing and navigation apparatus includes a simulation module that performs microsimulation of individual vehicles in a traffic stream, and a lane-level optimizer that evaluates conditions along the candidate paths from an origin to a destination as determined by the simulation module, and determines recommended lane-level maneuvers along the candidate paths. A link-level optimizer may determines the candidate paths based on link travel times determined by the simulation module. The simulation may be based on real-time traffic condition data. Recommended candidate paths may be provided to delivery or service or emergency response vehicles, or used for evacuation planning, or to route vehicles such as garbage or postal trucks, or snowplows. Corresponding methods also may be used for traffic planning and management, including determining, based on microsimulation, at least one of (a) altered road geometry, (b) altered traffic signal settings, such as traffic signal timing, or (c) road pricing.
abstract_ko: 차선 레벨 차량 라우팅 및 내비게이션 장치는 교통 스트림(traffic stream) 내의 개별 차량들의 마이크로 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 시뮬레이션 모듈, 및 시뮬레이션 모듈에 의해 결정되는 바와 같은, 출발지로부터 목적지로의 후보 경로들을 따른 조건들을 평가하고, 후보 경로들을 따른 추천된 차선 레벨 책략(lane level maneuver)들을 결정하는 차선 레벨 옵티마이저(lane-level optimizer)를 포함한다.  링크 레벨 옵티마이저는 시뮬레이션 모듈에 의해 결정된 링크 주행 시간들에 기반하여 후보 경로들을 결정할 수 있다.  시뮬레이션은 실시간 교통 조건 데이터에 기반할 수 있다.  추천된 후보 경로들은 배달 또는 서비스 또는 긴급 응답 차량들에 제공되거나, 피난 계획(evacuation planning)을 위해 사용되거나, 쓰레기 트럭 또는 우편 트럭 또는 제설차와 같은 차량들을 라우팅하기 위해 사용된다.  해당 방법들은 또한 마이크로 시뮬레이션에 기반하여, (a) 변형된 도로 기하구조, (b) 변형된, 교통 신호 타이밍과 같은 교통 신호 설정들, 또는 (c) 도로 통행료 책정(road pricing) 중 적어도 하나를 결정하는 것을 포함하는 교통 계획 및 관리에 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Escape route guide system of offshore structure
title_ko: 해양구조물의 탈출 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an escape route indication system of an offshore structure. The escape route indication system of an offshore structure comprises a light emitting diode (LED) unit for escape route indication which is installed in a hull in order to indicate the escape route during fire evacuation; a control board which checks a fire spot from a fire sensing unit for sensing fire when a fire occurs, and visualizes and controls the escape path by lighting the LED unit for escape route indication; and a power supply unit which applies power to the control board.
abstract_ko:
해양구조물의 탈출 경로 안내 시스템을 개시한다. 
해양구조물의 탈출 경로 안내 시스템은 화재 피난시 탈출 경로를 안내하기 위하여 선체에 설치되는 탈출 경로안내용 발광다이오드 유닛, 화재 발생시 화재 발생을 감지하는 화재 감지 유닛으로부터 화재발생 지점을 확인하고, 상기 탈출 경로안내용 발광다이오드 유닛을 점등시켜서 탈출 경로를 하는 가시화하고 제어하는 제어반, 및 상기 제어반에 전원을 인가하는 전원부를 구비한다.

title_en: Road traffic network emergency evacuation route generation method based on Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road traffic network emergency evacuation route generation method based on the Internet of vehicles. The method involves a vehicle-mounted device, a roadside device, a network background server device and a vehicle emergency evacuation route decision making model. A wireless data communication module of the vehicle-mounted device broadcasts vehicle information to the roadside device through a wireless network, the roadside device performs statistics on the vehicle information of the road section and the local road network region, and the vehicle information is transmitted to the network background server in a wired data communication mode; a multi-target vehicle emergency evacuation route optimal decision making model is established and resolved by a vehicle emergency evacuation route planning module of the network background server with the minimum evacuation total travel distance, the minimum evacuation travel time and the minimum road section congestion probability as the targets, and an optimal route is obtained to guide vehicles in a dangerous region to be evacuated to a safe region. The road traffic network emergency evacuation route generation method based on the Internet of vehicles has the advantage that a real-time, safe, reliable and efficient emergency evacuation route can be provided for vehicles in the road traffic network.

title_en: A kind of method for improving storm surge disaster risk profile precision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of method for improving storm surge disaster risk profile precision, the described method comprises the following steps：Storm surge disaster scene is built based on condition analysis method；Propose storm surge disaster Three-dimensional Numerical Simulation Method；The big flood for building multi-mode multiple target is taken refuge optimal route selection model；Wherein, the proposition storm surge disaster Three-dimensional Numerical Simulation Method is specially：1) three-dimensional grid model of region landform is set up；2) the SST k ω advance of freshet Three-dimensional Turbulent Flow models of coupling VOF methods are set up；3) based on Three-dimensional simulation result drawing three-dimensional risk map.Invention increases the flowing of flood dynamic realtime and the authenticity and effect of visualization of disaster Annual distribution；The integrity and reasonability of emergency-sheltering system are further improved with the emergency route evacuation model of multi-mode multiple target, calamity emergency prediction scheme is effectively formulated, multiple modules coupling, the storm surge disaster risk analysis system that integrity degree is high, exploitativeness is strong is set up.

title_en: Navigation device and method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a navigation device and method which, upon occurrence of an earthquake, can automatically set a route to a place of a shelter far from the epicenter and guide a user to the set place.SOLUTION: A navigation device 10, for searching for a route from the current location of a vehicle to the destination on the basis of the current location of the vehicle and map data, comprises an earthquake information acquisition unit 11 for acquiring earthquake information in the event an earthquake occurs, and an arithmetic unit 14 for determining, on the basis of the current location of the vehicle, map data and the earthquake information, whether the vehicle needs to seek a shelter and, when determined that the vehicle needs to take the shelter, searching for a place of the shelter in the neighborhood of the vehicle and then setting a route to the place of the shelter and starting guidance. Thus, the navigation device 10 can secure safety for even a user (driver) not acquainted with the place by prompt movement, since it would automatically set a route to the place of the shelter far from the epicenter and guide (show) the user to the set place.

title_en: Navigation system, navigation method, and navigation terminal for escaping from current position
abstract_en: A navigation system, a navigation method, and a navigation terminal for escaping from a current position are provided. The navigation system comprises a vehicle-mounted navigation terminal and a service center. The vehicle-mounted navigation terminal comprises a processing module, a human-machine interactive module, a GPS module for providing the current position information, a first communication module for communicating with the service center, and a memory module for providing digital maps; wherein the human-machine interactive module, the GPS module, the first communication module, and the memory module are individually connected to the processing module, and the human-machine interactive module is provided with a button for representing a function of triggering an escaping function. When a user needs to escape from a current position, he just needs to trigger the escape button, the vehicle-mounted terminal takes the current position information from the GPS module as the address where the user needs to escape and sends the ID information of the vehicle-mounted navigation terminal to the service center; the service center collects and processes the dynamic traffic data of the escape position, then generates an escape route, and sends the escape route to the navigation terminal; and the user's vehicle-mounted navigation terminal escapes from the current position according to the provided escape route, and thus the travel efficiency is improved.

title_en: Fire evacuation device linked to mobile communication terminal
title_ko: 이동통신단말기와 연동된 화재 대피 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire evacuation device for guiding an evacuation to the outside when an emergency such as fire occurs in a building. According to one aspect of the present invention, an evacuation guide message is transmitted to mobile phones possessed by people in a building when a fire breaks out such that people can safely evacuate. Additionally, according to another aspect of the present invention, an evacuation route is displayed in a navigation form when a fire breaks out such that people can quickly evacuate by immediately recognizing the evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 대피 장치로서, 건물 내에서 화재 등의 비상 상황 발생시에 외부로 대피하도록 안내하는 화재 대피 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 실시 형태에 따르면, 화재 발생 시에 건물 내의 사람들이 소지한 휴대폰에 대피 안내 메시지를 전송함으로써, 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있다. 또한 본 발명의 실시 형태에 따르면, 화재 발생 시에 대피 경로를 네비게이션 형태로 표시해 줌으로써, 사람들이 대피 경로를 즉각 인지하여 신속한 대피가 가능하다.

title_en: Techniques for indoor navigation with hazard avoidance via light-based communication
abstract_en: Techniques are disclosed for enhancing indoor navigation using light-based communication (LCom). In some embodiments, an LCom-enabled luminaire configured as described herein may include or have access to a sensor configured to detect a hazardous condition. In response to detection of a hazard, the LCom-enabled luminaire may adjust its light output, transmit an LCom signal, or both, in accordance with some embodiments. A given LCom signal may include data that may be utilized by a recipient computing device, for example, in providing emergency evacuation routing or other indoor navigation with hazard avoidance, emergency assistance, or both. In a network of such luminaires, data distribution via inter-luminaire communication may be provided, in accordance with some embodiments, via an optical interface or other wired or wireless communication means. In some cases, the network may include a luminaire that is not LCom-enabled yet still configured for inter-luminaire communication.

title_en: Ice alert system and method of evacuating an arctic floating platform from a hazardous ice condition
abstract_en: An ice alert system includes an ice floe monitoring system, and an ice floe forecast system operatively connected to the ice floe monitoring system. The ice floe forecast system is configured to determine a hazardous ice condition. An evacuation system is operatively connected to the ice floe forecast system. The evacuation system is configured and disposed to determine, in response to the hazardous ice condition, a safe harbor location, and a navigational course from an original anchor point to the safe harbor location.

title_en: Intelligent evacuation and rescue indicating device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent evacuation and rescue indicating device and an intelligent evacuation and rescue indicating method, and is mainly used for an emergency evacuation and rescue system. The device provided by the invention mainly includes an image-text display module, a radio beacon module, a data communication and processing module and a data acquisition module, can display evacuation instruction information through static and/or dynamic image-texts, can acquire and store general information, such as the location of a trapped person with a user terminal and/or a rescue worker with a user terminal, the optimal evacuation and/or rescue route, and emergency evacuation and rescue instruction information, in a real-time manner, and can send the general information to the user terminals in a real-time manner. The method provided by the invention mainly includes the following steps: real-timely locating the trapped person with the user terminal and/or the rescue worker with the user terminal, providing evacuation and rescue navigation, and sending the general information, such as the location, evacuation and rescue navigation information as well as the emergency evacuation and rescue instruction information, to the user terminals for displaying and/or playing.

title_en: Owner controlled evacuation system with notification and route guidance provided by a user device
abstract_en: A method includes receiving, by a user device, information regarding a sensed condition in a structure. The sensed condition is sensed by a sensory node. The method also includes providing, by the user device, a notification identifying the sensed condition to a user of the user device, and receiving, by the user device, information regarding navigable pathways of the structure. The method further includes determining, by the user device, a location of the user device, and identifying, by the user device, a first evacuation route based at least in part on the information regarding the sensed condition, the information regarding navigable pathways of the structure, and the location of the user device. The method also includes displaying, by the user device, the first evacuation route.

title_en: System and method of voice based personalized interactive evacuation guidance
abstract_en: Systems and methods of voice based personalized interactive evacuation guidance are provided. Some methods include receiving a notification about an occurrence of a predetermined event in a monitored region, responsive to receiving the notification, pairing with a fixed device in the monitored region, responsive to pairing with the fixed device, transmitting location identifying information to a remote wireless system, and receiving, from the remote wireless system, information identifying an optimal route from a current location. Some methods include receiving user input requesting an optimal route from location A to location B in a monitored region, transmitting the user input to the remote wireless system, and receiving, from the remote wireless system, information identifying the optimal route.

title_en: Emergency navigational smoke helmet
title_ko: 비상용 네비게이션 방독면
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a navigational gas mask for a fire emergency. More particularly, an RFID sensor, which is mounted on a gas mask, and an ubiquitous sensor network system inside of a building are used for an evacuation in a situation where a visibility is not secured due to smoke from a fire wherein a laser provided on a facepiece of the gas mask shows an arrow, which indicates a direction, on the floor so as to enable a prompt evacuation from a dangerous situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 시 사용되는 비상용 네비게이션 방독면에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 화재시 발생하는 연기로 인해 시야가 확보되지 않아 탈출하는데 어려움을 격는 상황을 방독면에 장착된 RFID 센서와 건물 내부의 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크 시스템을 이용, 방독면 안면부에 있는 레이저로 방향을 지시하는 화살표를 바닥에 표시하여 신속하게 위험상황에서 대피할 수 있도록 한 방독면에 대한 것이다.
assignees: JEJU NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Subway fire escape system and method based on real-time sensor monitoring network
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway fire escape system and method based on a real-time sensor monitoring network. The subway fire escape system comprises a monitoring device, a control center, a mobile terminal with an inertial navigation system and a wireless transmitting system and an AP cluster, wherein the monitoring device, the control center and the mobile terminal can exchange data with each other through a WIFI network composed of the AP cluster. The monitoring device further comprises a fire situation monitoring device and a pedestrian counting device, wherein a monitoring range of the fire situation monitoring device can cover the whole subway station, the fire situation monitoring device is mainly used for monitoring whether fire happens in the subway station, a monitoring range of the pedestrian counting device covers entrances, exits, stairs and corners where passengers must pass by, and the pedestrian counting device is used for counting pedestrians and judging the route jam situation. The subway fire escape system can provide a practical solution for passengers in the subway station when fire happens, improves the fire evacuation efficiency and further reduces casualties.

title_en: Terminal for providing emergency evacuation route information for indoor user, method for controlling the same, service server for providing emergency evacuation route information service for indoor user and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 재실자에게 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 단말기 및 그 제어방법, 그리고 재실자에게 피난경로 안내정보에 관한 서비스를 제공하는 서비스서버 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a terminal for providing evacuation route guiding information for an indoor user to easily and promptly evacuate from a disaster through a terminal of the indoor user when a disaster situation such as fire and the like occurs in public facilities or buildings. More particularly, the terminal of the present invention comprises: a communication module for data-communicating with a service server that determines evacuation route guiding information; an evacuation route guiding module for providing the evacuation route guiding information; and a terminal control module for controlling the communication module and the evacuation route guiding module, wherein the terminal control module requests for the evacuation route guiding information to the service server, and provides the evacuation route guiding information through an output module of the terminal.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 공공시설 또는 건물 내부에 화재 등의 재난상황이 발생한 경우 재실자가 재난으로부터 용이하고 신속하게 피난할 수 있도록 하는 재실자에게 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 단말기에 관한 것이다. 
구체적으로, 본 발명은, 공공시설 또는 건물에 재난 발생시 재실자의 단말기를 통하여 재실자에게 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 단말기로서, 피난경로 안내정보를 결정하는 서비스서버와 데이터 통신하는 통신모듈과; 상기 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 피난경로안내모듈과; 상기 통신모듈 및 상기 피난경로안내모듈을 제어하는 단말 제어모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 단말 제어모듈은, 상기 피난경로 안내정보를 상기 서비스서버로 요청하고, 상기 단말기의 출력모듈을 통하여 상기 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 하는 재실자에게 피난경로 안내정보를 제공하는 단말기에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System of evacuation and rescue using wireless sensor network
title_ko: 무선 센서 네트워크를 활용한 재해 대피 및 구조지원 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an evacuation and rescue system using a wireless sensor network. According to an aspect of the present invention, provided is the evacuation and rescue system using the wireless sensor network, which, when a disaster occurs in a structure having a plurality of internal zones and passages, notifies an evacuee and an evacuation guide of a fact of disaster and an evacuation situation through a mobile terminal, and guides the evacuation of the evacuee. The system comprises: a plurality of wireless relays which are installed in the zones and enables wireless communication with the mobile terminal of the evacuee and the evacuation guide; a disaster management server which is connected to the wireless relays using the wireless network, determines a disaster situation inside the zones in which the wireless relays are installed, generates information on the disaster and an evacuation route, and provides the same through the mobile terminal of the evacuee and the evacuation guide; and a guide lamp operation control unit which uses the information on the disaster and the evacuation route generated in the disaster management server to display the evacuation route guidance message through an emergency exit guidance lamp installed in the zones or to control to display a dangerous route entry prevention message.
abstract_ko: 무선 센서 네트워크를 활용한 재해 대피 및 구조지원 시스템에 관하여 개시한다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, 내부에 다수의 구역 및 통로를 갖는 구조물에서의 재해 발생시, 대피자 및 대피안내자의 휴대단말기를 통해 재해 사실 및 대피 상황을 안내하고 대피자의 탈출을 안내하는 무선 센서 네트워크를 활용한 재해 대피 및 구조지원 시스템으로서, 상기 다수의 구역마다 설치되며 대피자 및 대피안내자의 휴대단말기와 무선 통신 가능한 다수의 무선중계기와, 무선 네트워크를 이용하여 상기 다수의 무선중계기와 연결되며, 상기 무선중계기가 설치된 구역 내의 재해 상황을 판단하고, 재해 및 탈출경로 정보를 생성하여 상기 대피자 및 대피안내자의 휴대단말기를 통해 재해 및 탈출경로 정보를 제공하는 재해관리서버와, 상기 재해관리서버로부터 생성된 재해 및 탈출경로 정보를 이용하여 상기 다수의 구역에 설치된 비상구 안내등을 통해 탈출경로 안내 메시지를 표시하거나, 또는 위험경로 진입방지 메시지를 표시하도록 제어하는 안내등 구동 제어부를 포함하는 무선 센서 네트워크를 활용한 재해 대피 및 구조지원 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation information system using NFC
title_ko: Ｎｆｃ를 이용한 비상대피 경로 안내시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation route guidance system using NFC which analyzes the number of mobile devices connected to an NFC tag installed on a building, a ship, etc. to guide people being evacuated to an optimal evacuation route according to time required to evacuate the people. The emergency evacuation route guidance system using NFC comprises: a mobile device (100) to communicate with an NFC tag installed on a structure such as a building, a ship, etc. in an emergency and recognize tag information to transmit the tag information to a safety server (200) and display emergency evacuation information received from the safety server (200) to allow a user to view the emergency evacuation information; and the safety server (200) to analyze the tag information received from the mobile device (100) and analyze the number of mobile devices connected to the NFC tag in real time to set an optimal evacuation route according to time required to evacuate the number of people to supply the optimal evacuation route to the mobile device (100).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물, 선박 등의 구조물에 설치된 NFC 태그에 접속한 모바일기기의 숫자를 분석하여 대피인원별 대피소요시간에 따라 최적의 비상대피 경로를 안내할 수 있는 NFC를 이용한 비상대피 경로 안내시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 주요구성은 비상시에 건물, 선박 등의 구조물에 설치된 NFC 태그와 통신하면서 태그정보를 인식하여 안전서버(200)로 전송하고, 안전서버(200)로 제공받은 비상대피정보를 사용자가 확인할 수 있도록 화면에 표시하는 모바일기기(100)와; 모바일기기(100)로부터 제공받은 태깅정보를 분석하고 실시간으로 접속한 모바일기기의 개수를 분석하여 대피인원별 대피소요시간에 따라 최적의 대피경로를 설정하여 모바일기기(100)로 제공하는 안전서버(200)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation navigation method and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency evacuation navigation method. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an indoor emergency evacuation navigation request, and acquiring the current positional information of a user; generating an emergency evacuation path corresponding to the user according to the current positional information of the user and an indoor map corresponding to the positional information; and determining the user's positional information by means of an acceleration sensor and a direction sensor in real time according to a received positioning signal of a positioning base station, and guiding the user to evacuate under the guidance of the emergency evacuation path. The method allows the user to accurately and reliably find an exit in the first time and evacuate, so the personal safety reliability of the user can be effectively improved in case of an emergency.

title_en: A kind of track traffic fault navigation system
abstract_en: A kind of track traffic fault navigation system, comprises multiple mobile terminal, server end, and office terminal, and described multiple mobile terminal, is communicated mutually by mobile communications network, sends, receives instant character/image information; Described multiple mobile terminal, communicates with described server end respectively by mobile communications network; Described office terminal, it is communicated with described server end by office network.Track traffic fault navigation system of the present utility model, when track means of transportation break down, can guide user to reach the spot fast by priority level and immediately process, improve the promptness of failture evacuation.

title_en: Traffic managing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic managing system and a traffic managing method. The method comprises the following steps: building a regional road network surrounding an activity holding place; configuring road network OD data and simulating adoption of different traffic dispatching means in a simulating system, and adopting road congestion hotspot analysis and road characteristic parameter analysis to select an optimal traffic managing scheme. The different traffic dispatching means include route guidance and traffic distribution at crossings, signal lamp optimization, conversion between one-way and two-way traffic lanes, road driving restriction, etc. According to the invention, the optimized traffic managing method is provided for the situation with dense traffic flow such as large-scale recreational and sports activities. The system and the method also provide reference basis for traffic managers to make entry-exit evacuation schemes of large-scale activities, thereby ensuring safe and smooth traffic.

title_en: Route guidance device, route guidance method, and route guidance program
abstract_en: To provide a route guidance device capable of more clearly indicating a travel direction to a user even when a background image and an air tag are displayed in a single screen image. A portable terminal device (10) is provided with an evacuation route searching means (140) for searching for an evacuation route, an image display means (170) for displaying a background image captured by a user, an air tag display means (180) for displaying an air tag (augmented reality picture) as information used for evacuation route guidance in superposed fashion on the background image, and a background image masking means (190) for displaying a picture (mask picture) for concealing a portion of the background image on a left side and/or right side of the evacuation route. Here, when the mask picture and the air tag overlap in an image display region, the air tag is placed in front of the mask picture.

title_en: Apparatus, method, and program for route guidance
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a route guidance apparatus capable of more clearly presenting a user with a direction to proceed even when a scenery image and Air Tags are displayed in one screen.SOLUTION: A portable terminal device 10 includes evacuation route search means 140 for searching an evacuation route; image display means 170 which displays a scenery image being captured by a user; Air Tag display means 180 which displays as information for guiding through an evacuation route as Air Tags (augmented reality images) superimposed on the scenery image; and scenery image masking means 190 which displays an image (masking image) for hiding a portion of the scenery image on at least either the left side or right side of the evacuation route. When the masking image and the Air Tags overlaps in an image display area, the Air Tags are placed in front of the masking image.

title_en: Apparatus, method, and program for route guidance
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a route guidance apparatus which allows for easily grasping a positional relationship between a geographical location of an item/event represented by an Air Tag displayed in a scenery image and a current location.SOLUTION: A portable terminal device 10 includes; evaluation route search means 140 for searching an evacuation route; image display means 170 for displaying a scenery image being captured by a user; map display means 150 which displays an evacuation route obtained by the evacuation route search means 140; Air Tag display means 180 which displays information for guiding through the evacuation route as an Air Tag (first augmented reality image) superimposed on the scenery image; and link line display means 181 which displays a link line that links the Air Tag displayed on an image display area to one of positions on the map associated with the Air Tag.

title_en: A development of tunnel evacuation route guidance system using vehicle OBD information when a fire breaks out
title_ko: 터널 내 화재발생시 차량정보를 이용한 대피안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation guidance system using vehicle information during outbreak of a fire in a tunnel. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the evacuation guidance system has a server, which guides an evacuation method with respect to a first section, which is an inner section of the tunnel, and a second section from an entrance of the tunnel to a predetermined location which are guidance sections. The server may include: a reception unit which receives a first information, related to an operation condition and a location of a first vehicle, from the first vehicle having entered into the first section; an information processing unit which generates a second information related to outbreak of a fire, intensity of the fire, and a location of the outbreak of the fire in the first section by using the first information, and also generates third information related to how passengers in a second vehicle escape from the fire by using the second information corresponding to a location of the second vehicle in the guidance section; and a transmission unit which transmits, to the second vehicle, at least one from the second information and the third information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 터널 내 화재발생시 차량정보를 이용한 대피안내 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일예와 관련된 대피안내 시스템은 안내구간에 해당하는 터널의 내부구간인 제 1 구간 및 상기 터널의 입구로부터 기 설정된 위치까지의 구간인 제 2 구간에 대해 대피방법을 안내하는 서버에 있어서, 상기 제 1 구간에 진입한 차량인 제 1 차량으로부터 상기 제 1 차량의 동작상태와 위치에 관한 정보인 제 1 정보를 수신하는 수신부, 상기 제 1 정보를 이용하여 상기 제 1 구간 내 화재의 발생여부, 정도 및 상기 화재가 발생한 위치에 관한 정보인 제 2 정보를 생성하고, 상기 제 2 정보를 이용하여 상기 안내구간 내 차량인 제 2 차량의 탑승자가 상기 화재로부터 대피하는 방법에 관한 정보인 제 3 정보를 상기 안내구간에서 상기 제 2 차량의 위치에 대응하여 생성하는 정보처리부 및 상기 제 2 정보 및 상기 제 3 정보 중 적어도 하나를 상기 제 2 차량으로 송신하는 송신부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Solution for providing real-time positioning and escaping route correspond to disaster
title_ko: 실시간 재난대응 위치파악 및 피난경로 안내 솔루션
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for offering an escape route information in the case of an emergency situation inside a building by checking the location through a user terminal, searching for the nearest exit, and guiding the user to the closest exit. More specifically, the present invention relates to a method for detecting the location of the user terminal indoors and for providing accurate and rapid escape routes by using a detecting unit installed on the user terminal, and a beacon installed in the building.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물 내부에서 긴급상황 발생시 실내에서의 사용자단말기 위치를 파악하고, 상기 사용자단말기 주위의 출구 중 가장 가까운 출구를 탐색한 뒤 해당 출구로의 피난경로를 제공하는 피난경로 안내 방법에 관한 것이다. 또한, 본 발명은 사용자단말기 내부에 구비된 감지장치 및 건물 내부에 설치된 비콘을 활용함으로써 실내 공간에서의 사용자단말기 위치를 보다 정확하게 파악하고, 이렇게 파악된 위치정보를 기반으로 정확하고 신속한 피난경로를 제공하는 것에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Evacuation guidance system and moving body
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an evacuation guidance system including a management center capable of swiftly providing an appropriate evacuation guidance to moving bodies according to the actual situation upon an occurrence of disaster.SOLUTION: A management center A distributes evacuation place information and road information to plural on-vehicle apparatuses B via a data section A2 which stores evacuation place information and road information which are used for route searching of on-vehicle apparatuses B and a network N1. When a network N1 with the management center A is interrupted, the on-vehicle apparatuses B share the evacuation place information or the road information updated by an input-output unit B3 via a network N2, which is used by plural on-vehicle apparatuses B for transmitting/receiving information with each other, with other on-vehicle apparatuses B. Each of the on-vehicle apparatuses B performs route search based on the updated evacuation place information or road information and displays the route guidance on the input-output unit B3.

title_en: Exit guiding system and exit guiding method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology that enables a vehicle to achieve appropriate emergency evacuation from disaster, or to avoid disaster.SOLUTION: A navigation device 1 includes an information acquisition unit 13, and a control unit 16. The information acquisition unit 13 acquires disaster information. The control unit 16 can make an output unit lead the way to a smart interchange as an exit from an express highway on the basis of the disaster information acquired by the information acquisition unit 13, and map information 12a including information on the express highway and information on the smart interchange connected to the express highway.

title_en: Exit guiding system and exit guiding method
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a technology that enables a vehicle to achieve appropriate emergency evacuation from disaster, or to avoid disaster.SOLUTION: A navigation device 1 includes an information acquisition unit 13, and a control unit 16. The information acquisition unit 13 acquires disaster information, and information on a special route connected to an express highway but not open to a general traffic. The control unit 16 can make an output unit lead the way to the special route as an exit from the express highway on the basis of the disaster information and the information on the special route acquired by the information acquisition unit 13, and map information 12a including information on the express highway.

title_en: Evacuation navigation device
abstract_en: An evacuation navigation device disclosed. In one embodiment, the evacuation navigation device comprises a position determining component configured to determine a position of a handheld device within a selected environment having access to at least one positioning system. The device further comprises a display device configured to display the position of the handheld device on a digital map of the selected environment and at least one evacuation route from the position to an evacuation position. The device further comprises a wireless communication component configured to receive a real-time update of safety conditions along the at least one evacuation route. The device further comprises logic implemented by a processor for dynamically revising the digital map based upon the real-time update.

title_en: Disaster evacuation system interlocked with portable mobile comprising emergency state disaster evacuation application for passenger ship, and driving method of the same
title_ko: 선박 비상상황 대응용 재난대피 어플리케이션을 구비한 휴대단말과 연동하는 선박 재난대피 시스템 및 이의 구동방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a ship disaster evacuation system interlocked with a portable terminal comprising a disaster evacuation application for ship emergency situation and a driving method thereof. The disaster evacuation system for ship emergency situation includes: the portable terminal (100) installed with an application to deal with a ship disaster; a disaster management device (200) which provides safety status information of a ship in real-time, and provides disaster evacuation information according to a disaster situation, in case that the disaster situation (one of fire breakout, ship collision, stranding and submerging) of the ship occurs due to an external factor or an internal factor; and a disaster monitoring server (300) which is provided with the safety status information and the disaster evacuation information from the disaster management device (200) in real-time, and transmits the safety status information and the disaster evacuation information to a public office related with ship navigation management and the application for ship disaster. The disaster monitoring server (300) provides the safety status information and the disaster evacuation information generated from start point to finish point of sailing of the ship.
abstract_ko:
선박 비상상황 대응용 어플리케이션을 구비한 휴대단말과 연동하는 선박 재난대피 시스템 및 이의 구동방법을 개시한다. 
상기 선박 비상상황 대응용 재난대피 시스템은 선박 재난 대응용 어플리케이션이 설치된 휴대단말(100); 실시간으로 선박의 안전 상태 정보를 제공하며, 상기 선박이 외부적 요인 또는 내부적 요인으로 인하여 재난 상황(화재 상황, 선박 충돌 상황, 좌초 상황, 침수 상황 중 어느 하나의 상황)이 발생될 경우, 상기 재난 상황에 따른 재난대피정보를 제공하는 재난관리장치(200); 및 상기 재난관리장치(200)로부터 상기 안전 상태 정보 및 상기 재난대피정보를 실시간으로 제공받아, 선박 운항 관리와 관련된 관공서 및 상기 선박 재난 대응용 어플리케이션으로 상기 안전 상태 정보 및 상기 재난대피정보를 전송하는 재난관제서버(300)를 포함하고, 상기 재난관제서버(300)는 상기 선박의 운항시점부터 운항종료시점까지에 발생되는 상기 안전 상태 정보 및 상기 재난대피정보를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and program for notifying emergency exit by beacon and wearable glass device
title_ko: 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 탈출경로 제공방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a program to provide an escape route using a glass type wearable device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method to provide the escape route using the glass type wearable device comprises: (S100) a step of receiving accident occurrence location information in a building; (S200) a step of calculating the escape route by determining location information on a safe emergency exit; (S300) a step of generating guidance information in accordance with the calculated escape route; and (S400) a step of providing the guidance information to a user. According to the present invention, the method and the program to provide the escape route using glass type wearable device is able to reduce casualties due to an accident by providing a safe route avoiding accident occurrence place information which the glass type wearable device obtains by a beacon signal to the people. Moreover, the method and the program to provide the escape route using the glass type wearable device allows a user to easily find the emergency exit or an evacuation place by displaying route guidance on a display unit of the glass type wearable device located in front of the user even if visibility deteriorates due to smoke.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 탈출경로 제공방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 탈출경로 제공방법은, 건물 내 사건발생위치정보를 수신하는 단계(S100); 상기 사건발생위치정보를 바탕으로, 안전한 비상구 위치정보를 판단하여 탈출경로를 계산하는 단계(S200); 상기 계산된 탈출경로를 따라 안내정보를 생성하는 단계(S300); 및 사용자에게 상기 안내정보를 제공하는 단계(S400);를 포함한다.  
본 발명에 따르면, 상기 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스가 비콘신호를 통해 획득된 사건발생장소정보를 피해가는 실질적으로 안전한 경로를 사람들에게 제공하여, 사고에 의한 사상자를 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다. 또한, 연기에 의해 시인성이 저하되는 경우에도, 사용자의 눈앞에 위치한 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스의 디스플레이부 상에 경로 안내를 표시하여 사용자가 비상구 또는 대피장소를 용이하게 찾아갈 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Mehtod, Apparatus and System for Providing Safety Shelter Course
title_ko: 안전 대피 경로 제공방법, 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention relates to a method, an apparatus and a system for providing a safe evacuation route. The method for providing a safe evacuation route comprises a step of which grasps an accident situation in real-time and informs the accident situation to evacuees rapidly in case an accident occurs in a building; and a step for extracting a re-searched evacuation route including a route detouring a danger occurrence spot of a basic evacuation route on the basis of the accident situation and then providing the extracted re-searched evacuation route. Therefore evacuees can evacuate more safely.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예는 구조물 내 사고 발생 시 사고 현황을 실시간으로 파악하여 대피자들에게 신속하게 알려주는 한편, 사고 현황에 근거하여 기본 대피 경로 중 위험 발생 지점을 우회하는 경로를 포함하는 재탐색 대피 경로를 추출하여 제공함으로써 대피자들이 보다 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 안전 대피 경로 제공방법, 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Evacuation guiding method and evacuation guiding system thereof
title_ko: 재난 대피 경로 안내 방법 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: A disaster evacuation route guiding system according to an embodiment of the present invention may include: a user terminal where an evacuation route guiding application is executed; and a control server which receives surrounding situation information acquired in a disaster occurrence space and location information of the user terminal from the user terminal, and generates evacuation route information from the location of the user terminal in the disaster occurrence space on the basis of the surrounding situation information, and transmits the evacuation route information to the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 대피 경로 안내 애플리케이션이 실행되는 사용자 단말, 및 상기 사용자 단말로부터 재난 발생 공간에서 획득된 주변 상황 정보 및 상기 사용자 단말의 위치정보를 수신하고, 상기 주변 상황 정보에 기초하여 상기 재난 발생 공간에서의 상기 사용자 단말의 위치로부터의 대피 경로 정보를 생성하고, 상기 대피 경로 정보를 상기 사용자 단말로 전송하는 관제 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Intelligent escape method and its escape system of taking precautions against natural calamities of taking precautions against natural calamities
abstract_en: A kind of intelligent escape method of taking precautions against natural calamities, comprises the following steps:The environmental information of the context of multiple nodes in a region of a building is sensed respectively, to produce multiple transducing signals of the plurality of node respectively；Multiple danger coefficients of the plurality of node are calculated according to the plurality of transducing signal respectively；Respectively according to the distance between the plurality of danger coefficient and multiple adjacent nodes, to perform a best-effort path plan calculus to produce a most Safe path planning；And multiple escapes according to the most Safe path planning to produce the plurality of node respectively are indicated.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows most Safe path planning can be produced according to the distance between danger coefficient and adjacent node to provide safe real-time escape instruction, quickly to guide personnel's escape and evacuation to reduce casualties.

title_en: Wireless intelligent augmented reality firefighting monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless intelligent augmented reality firefighting monitoring system, and aims at providing the monitoring firefighting system of which network transmission performance is stable and reliable, system capacity is variable and information acquisition is rapid and visual. The wireless intelligent augmented reality firefighting monitoring system comprises a basic network which is mainly composed of wireless sensor nodes and an upper network which is mainly composed of a relay gateway, a public network base station and a server. Each wireless sensor node is composed of a sensor and linkage firefighting equipment. All the wireless sensor nodes can perform long-distance wireless communication with each other so as to form an ad-hoc long-distance transmission network. The wireless intelligent augmented reality firefighting monitoring system also comprises an intelligent mobile phone which performs short-distance wireless communication with the wireless sensor nodes. The intelligent mobile phone superposes the acquired virtual information to real monitoring scene images via an augmented reality module so that display of various types of information (navigation information, monitoring point state information and map information) is enabled to be more visual. Multiple functions of parameter setting, personnel positioning, escape route navigation, patrolling inspection punch-in and linkage control for firefighting and disaster elimination can be realized by the wireless intelligent augmented reality firefighting monitoring system.
assignees: CHONGQING JIACHONG NETWORK SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster prevention system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster prevention system that reliably conveys disaster occurrence warning and disaster occurrence information to users, has functions to give disaster response instructions, evacuation instructions, and evacuation guidance most suitable to the respective users, and is easy for the users to confirm visually.SOLUTION: In a system, a tablet terminal which is an information reception and evacuation action support terminal and can be taken out is connected with a fixed telephone in a wired or wireless and angular adjustable manner, and the tablet terminal has stored in advance disaster waring, disaster response, evacuation instructions, evacuation route guidance codes, and detailed information on the codes set tailored to each user. When a disaster is predicted, or a disaster has actually occurred, the system reliably conveys disaster warning and disaster occurrence information to users using wired and wireless communication means including a wired telephone line, and gives disaster response, evacuation instructions, and evacuation route guidance.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Diversified data acquisition and transmission device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a diversified data acquisition and transmission device including a wireless transmission module CC2430, wherein the wireless transmission module CC2430 is connected with an S3C6410 processor; the S3C6410 processor is internally provided with an SDRAM and a Flash memory; the S3C6410 processor is connected with an input/output interface, the input/output interface is connected with a USB, a touch screen, an LCD, a voice module, an SD card interface, and a debugging interface; the wireless transmission module CC2430 and a variety of sensors are connected by a wireless transmission way. A handheld terminal of the device can conveniently manage and deal with unexpected emergencies, the emergency rescue force is allowed to arrive at an event happening location in the shortest time, the disaster crowd is guided to choose a shortest and optimal path for personnel evacuation in the shortest time, and the device has important significance and use value in establishment of a positioning navigation and seamless monitoring early warning system for emergency management and has wide application in Internet of things.
assignees: QINGDAO XINYIFA INDUSTRY & TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Airport shelter bridge docking aircraft hatch navigation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport corridor bridge docking airplane hatch navigation system, and belongs to the technical field of airport corridor bridge docking. The airport gallery bridge docking aircraft hatch navigation system comprises a navigation main control module (1), a gallery bridge position detection module (2), an aircraft position detection module (8), a first satellite positioning antenna (201), a second satellite positioning antenna (202) and a satellite positioning base station (203); wherein: the navigation main control module (1) is electrically connected with the corridor bridge position detection module (2) and the airplane position detection module (8) respectively; the corridor bridge position detection module (2) is electrically connected with the first satellite positioning antenna (201), the second satellite positioning antenna (202) and the satellite positioning base station (203) respectively. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the characteristics of reliable performance, high accuracy and the like, and can be used for carrying out manual gallery bridge butt joint and automatic gallery bridge butt joint.
assignees: DALIAN MODERN HIGH-TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Wireless data collection device
abstract_en: The invention relates to a wireless data collection device which comprises a wireless transmission module CC2430. An S3C6410 processor is connected to the wireless transmission module CC2430. An SDRAM storage and a Flash internal storage are arranged inside the S3C6410 processor. An input/output interface is connected to the S3C6410 processor. A USB, a touch screen, an LCD, a voice module, an SD card interface, a debugging interface and a wireless transmission module CC2430 are connected to the input/output interface and connected with various sensors in a wireless transmission mode. A handheld terminal can conveniently manage and deal with sudden emergency accidents, emergency rescue forces can reach the location where the accidents happen within the shortest time, crowds in disaster can be guided within the shortest time to select the shortest and best path for personnel evacuation, the great significance and using value is achieved for building a positioning navigation and seamless monitoring pre-warning system for emergency management, and the wireless data collection device is widely applied in the Internet of Things.
assignees: QINGDAO XINYIFA INDUSTRY & TRADE CO LTD

title_en: Mobile terminal and method for controlling the same
title_ko: 이동 단말기 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile terminal and a control method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the mobile terminal comprises: a wireless communications unit; a display unit; a depth sensor for generating a depth signal by measuring the depth of a space; a motion sensor for generating a movement signal by tracking a movement of the mobile terminal inside the space; and a control unit for generating a three-dimensional map on the space by combining the depth signal and the movement signal when accessing a search mode by receiving an emergency disaster text message through the wireless communications unit, searching an evacuation route by comparing the three-dimensional map and a reference map, and displaying the evacuation route in the display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동 단말기 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 이동 단말기는, 무선 통신부, 디스플레이부, 공간의 깊이를 측정하여 깊이 신호를 생성하는 심도 센서, 상기 공간 내 이동 단말기의 움직임을 추적하여 움직임 신호를 생성하는 모션 센서 및 상기 무선 통신부를 통해 긴급재난문자를 수신하여 대피경로 탐색 모드에 진입하면, 상기 깊이 신호 및 상기 움직임 신호를 조합하여 상기 공간에 대한 3차원 지도를 생성하고, 상기 3차원 지도와 참조 지도를 비교하여 대피경로를 탐색하고, 상기 대피경로를 상기 디스플레이부에 표시하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Low-cost high-precision BD/MEMS integration attitude measurement method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-cost high-precision BD/MEMS integration attitude measurement method, and belongs to the technical field of navigation. An MEMS inertia sensor module comprises a triaxial accelerometer, a triaxial gyroscope, and a triaxial magnetometer. A BD receiver module comprises two antennas and one integrated BD navigation chip. The method comprises the steps: solving a carrier attitude angle according to the information of an MEMS inertia sensor; solving the ambiguity of the whole cycle through the assistance of an AFM (ambiguity function method); and finally achieving the BD/MEMS integration attitude measurement through an expanded Kalman filter. The method solves a problem that a satellite attitude system cannot work normally under the condition that a BD signal is sheltered by an obstacle because of insufficient satellites, overcomes the difficulty, caused by signal lock loss, in solving the ambiguity of the whole cycle, and also solves a problem of accumulated errors of the gyroscope and the accelerometer. Compared with a conventional method, the method is higher in instantaneity and reliability and is higher in precision.

title_en: Intelligent personnel evacuation navigation system based on wireless fidelity Wifi
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical filed of personnel evacuation navigation, and aims to realize the effectthat an evacuation indicating directionof an indication mark for guiding personnel escape and evacuation can be automatically changedwhen a fire disaster happens, and to improve quick escape and evacuation efficiency of the personnel and reduce personnel casualties by giving a navigation evacuation path based on wireless fidelity Wifi. A system, which can automatically change the evacuation indicating direction according to the actual conditions and can realize intelligent evacuation navigation according to location of the personnel, is characterized by comprising an evacuation indication mark changing part and an intelligent evacuation navigation part, wherein the evacuation indication mark changing part adopts a distributed type temperature or smoke gas acquisition and analysis automatic-control form and a manual control form; and an evacuation indication mark device can be used for giving different directions according to a signal given by a central control processing center. The intelligent evacuation navigation isrealized based on wireless fidelity Wifi, and the best evacuation path is displayed through an intelligent display terminal, so that the personnel can quickly and correctly evacuate and escape.
assignees: ANHUI CHENAN FIRE PROT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Escape path planning method and system based on mobile terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an escape path planning method and system based on a mobile terminal. A wireless network is applied to a large-scale building disaster emergency rescue system, by use of a wireless sensor disposed in a building in advance, whole-area and local real-time information of a disaster field is obtained at an initial state of an emergent disaster, the system, according to global environment information and a change trend of the disaster field, can accurately plan an optimal escape path, by use of combination of the wireless sensor network and an indication system, the optimal escape path is guided, planning and navigation of a personnel safe evacuation path on the basis of the wireless sensor network in disaster rescue are realized, and personnel in the building is evacuated to the maximum degree, such that the personnel casualty is reduced, and the rescue efficiency of fire rescue is improved.
assignees: TIANJIN ACAD FOR INTELLIGENT RECOGNITION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Campus urgent evacuation indication system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a campus urgent evacuation indication system. The system comprises a monitoring main terminal, a service desk and a student subsidiary terminal; the monitoring main terminal and the student subsidiary terminal are separately connected to the service desk in wireless connection; the student subsidiary terminal comprises a first display screen, a first communication device, a one key calling device, a positioning module, a first wireless communication module and an alarm; the monitoring main terminal comprises a navigation module, a second display screen, a second intercommunication device and a second wireless communication module; a navigation module is matched with the positioning module for positioning the student position and carrying out urgent evacuation navigation when urgent evacuation is needed; a service desk is used for providing communication connection and communication processing for the monitoring main terminal and the student subsidiary terminal; a first identification device is also included, and the first identification is installed in a safety area; when the urgent evacuation is needed, the monitoring main terminal is used for providing reasonable evacuation indication for the student subsidiary terminal by the navigation module, and the student uses a first display screen on the student subsidiary terminal for finding the evacuation passage easily in order to evacuate rapidly and safely.

title_en: Safety emergency navigation device
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety emergency navigation device which comprises a communication element, a danger detector, an auxiliary positioner and a voice broadcast device.The danger detector detects whether danger signals exist in surrounding environment, the auxiliary positioner calculates distance between the danger signals and a user terminal when the danger signals are detected, the voice broadcast device plays emergency prompting voice when the danger signals are detected, and the communication element sends the danger signals and danger position information to a remote server and multiple safety emergency navigation devices in a building, sends the distance to the remove server, receives escape path information, corresponding to the user terminal, sent by the remote server and sends the escape path information to the user terminal.The safety emergency navigation device can detect the danger signals and acquire the escape path information corresponding to the user terminal; for users at different positions of the building, the users can be navigated to escape through the escape path information corresponding to the user terminal, so that efficiency and safety of people evacuation are improved.
assignees: ZHUHAI ZHICHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation robot
abstract_en: The invention provides an evacuation robot. The evacuation robot comprises a wheelchair, a central control chip set, a miniature database, a communication module, a mobile control module, a voice output part, a video input part, a voice input part and a navigation module. According to the evacuation robot, through the navigation system, the medical workers carry out navigation, a patient operates by hands, or the evacuation is carried out automatically according to the original set evacuation program, therefore, the urgent evacuation for the people having difficulty in getting around, such as patients and old people can be well assisted during disasters, thus the problems that the rescuing work is difficult when the disasters such as fire disaster and toxic gas leakage occur and the casualties of special firefighters are caused by rescue under the dangerous situation can be solved, and the evacuation robot is particularly suitable for evacuation during the disasters including the ward fire disaster and toxic gas leakage; in addition, the evacuation robot can well complete the simple emergency medical care and assist the medical workers in completing the prediagnosis, so that the not timely medical care possibly caused by the fact that the medical workers need to diagnose face to face first and then rescue can be avoided.

title_en: Airport shelter bridge docking aircraft hatch navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an airport corridor bridge butt joint aircraft hatch navigation belongs to airport corridor bridge butt joint technical field. The utility model discloses an airport shelter bridge docking aircraft hatch navigation system, which comprises a navigation main control module (1), a shelter bridge position detection module (2), an aircraft position detection module (8), a first satellite positioning antenna (201), a second satellite positioning antenna (202) and a satellite positioning base station (203); wherein: the navigation main control module (1) is electrically connected with the corridor bridge position detection module (2) and the airplane position detection module (8) respectively; the corridor bridge position detection module (2) is electrically connected with the first satellite positioning antenna (201), the second satellite positioning antenna (202) and the satellite positioning base station (203) respectively. Compared with the prior art, the utility model have characteristics such as dependable performance, degree of accuracy height, both can carry out artifical gallery bridge butt joint, also can carry out automatic gallery bridge butt joint.
assignees: DALIAN MODERN HIGH-TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Autonomous data evacuation
abstract_en: For autonomous data evacuation, a storage device is motivated by a propulsion device. A navigation module guides the storage device to a disaster recovery target using the propulsion device in response to an evacuation signal. At least a portion of the navigation module comprises one or more of hardware and executable code, the executable code stored on one or more computer readable storage media.

title_en: Novel business circle information intelligent service system
abstract_en: The invention provides a novel business circle information intelligent service system comprising a server, a database, and an intelligent terminal. The server comprises a location and route management module, a store management module, an emergency processing module, an intelligent terminal management module, a navigation module, a message application module, a positioning source management module, and a business circle management module. Information is easy to view, discount information is clear at a glance and facilitates selection, the information is highly extendible, and the system is flexible in design. The information is displayed constantly as users walk, and users have a panoramic view of information and can adjust the shopping plan at any time. The system is further provided with the emergency module, emergency is handled in time, the evacuation route is clear, and the personal property is safe. All the resources in the business circle are integrated effectively, the overall function is brought into play, the quality of service and the management level of the business circle are enhanced, the overall efficiency is improved, and energy consumption is reduced.

title_en: Rescue method and server
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rescue method and a server, which belong to the communication field and are capable of pushing the optimal escape route for trapped people to enable the trapped people to be evacuated in order. The rescue method provided by the invention comprises steps: the server receives a navigation request from user equipment at a disaster occurring place; the server acquires the geographical position of the user equipment according to the navigation request; and according to the geographical position of the user equipment, the server sends the optimal escape route to the user equipment. The rescue method and the server are used for fire disaster rescue.
assignees: HUNAN FELBAAR ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: User position prediction method using physical coordinate of smart device linked object recognition sensor and emergency evacuation route guidance and information delivery systems using the same
title_ko: 사물인식 센서와 연동되는 스마트 디바이스의 물리좌표 연산을 활용한 사용자 위치 추정 방법 및 이를 이용한 시설물 내에서의 비상대피경로 안내 및 정보전달 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a system for transmitting information and guiding an emergency evacuation route using physical coordinate calculation of an object recognition sensor, selecting information customized for each disaster situation, realizing a space and a moving coordinate through a gyro sensor and an acceleration sensor mounted in the device and recognition of data through the sensor attached to the space, and linked with the coordinate by the sensor capable of off-line operation by an initial sensor or a communication device (Bluetooth), and enabling a position thereof to be continuously tracked under the premise of agreement of a user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황별로 맞춤화된 정보를 취사선택하여, 해당 정보를 필요로 하는 다양한 디바이스에 전달 할 수 있고, 공간에 부착된 센서를 통한 데이터의 인식과 디바이스에 내장된 자이로센서와 가속도 센서를 통한 공간 및 이동좌표를 구현할 수 있도록 하며, 오프라인에서 가동할 수 있는 센서에 의한 좌표와 최초 센서나 통신장비(블루투스 등)에 의해 연동 가능할 뿐 아니라 사용자의 동의를 전제하에 지속적으로 위치 추적될 수 있는 사물인식 센서의 물리좌표 연산을 활용한 비상시 대피경로 안내 및 정보전달 시스템을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.
