abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field related to vehicle safety, and discloses a vehicle navigation method and a system based on a sensor, which comprises a sensing acquisition module, a wireless sharing module, a range road condition module and a safety navigation module; the effect is based on the real-time interaction of radar sensing data between a plurality of adjacent vehicles of wireless system realization, thereby realize that vehicle navigation and dodge the system and can have more time to remove perception and acquisition to the barrier in wider range, thereby remind navigating mate safe state or guide navigating mate to make a response, also or realize promptly dodging of vehicle, compare in the mode that vehicle self radar sensing handled among the prior art, can avoid the huge blind area that produces when adjacent vehicle or barrier shelter from, can reduce the incident probability of taking place that can not in time discover to lead to because of blind area barrier pedestrian etc..
assignees: BEIJING JIESHENG TONGDA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual escape route guidance system and method for protective clothing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of protective clothing, which is used for solving the problems that the existing protective clothing cannot guide escape routes for users in the using process, so that the users cannot escape from a fire scene in the fastest time, the safety of the users is easy to be adversely affected, and the safety of the users cannot be guaranteed, in particular to a visual protective clothing escape route guiding system and a visual protective clothing escape route guiding method, wherein a processor acquires an accident road section, a safety route and a dangerous road section according to a danger value, screens the escape routes without the dangerous road section to obtain the safety routes, compares the number of the safety routes, guides the routes of the protective clothing users through a route guiding module, so that the protective clothing users can efficiently escape, and can be guided to reach the safety position to wait for rescue when the escape is difficult, and the protective clothing users are prevented from entering dangerous zones to be subjected to danger, the system can fully ensure the safety of the user of the protective clothing, and has high safety level.
assignees: ANHUI SHANGZAO INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency flashlight for evacuation route guidance and evacuation method using the same
title_ko: 피난로 안내용 비상손전등 및 이를 이용한 피난방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency flashlight for evacuation route guidance and an evacuation method using same. The emergency flashlight comprising a light source unit in which an LED element, a focusing lens, and a focus adjustment lens are built in a row inside a cylindrical housing, and a power supply unit for supplying power to the light source unit, comprises an information output unit. The information output unit includes: a cover coupled to an end region of the housing toward which light travels; an insertion hole formed on one side of the cover by a certain arc length; a transparent rotating plate, a part of which is inserted into the insertion hole, and in which a fixing pin passing through the cover is inserted and fixed to a fixing hole formed at the center thereof to be rotated when pressed with a certain amount of force; and a plurality of image lenses each including information and radially provided around the fixing hole of the transparent rotating plate, wherein one of pieces of the information is an evacuation guide map of a floor equipped with the emergency flashlight, such that, when the power of the emergency flashlight is turned on, the evacuation guide map is transmitted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 피난로 안내용 비상손전등 및 이를 이용한 피난방법은, 원통형의 하우징 내부에는 LED소자, 집속렌즈 및 초점조절렌즈가 일렬로 내장되는 광원부와, 상기 광원부에 전원을 공급하는 전원부로 구성되는 비상손전등으로서, 상기 비상손전등은 정보출력부를 포함하고, 상기 정보출력부는, 빛이 나아가는 쪽 상기 하우징의 단부영역에 결합되는 덮개; 상기 덮개의 일측면에 일정 호의 길이만큼 형성되는 삽입공; 상기 삽입공에 일부가 삽입되고, 중앙에 형성된 고정공에 상기 덮개를 관통하는 고정핀이 삽입 및 고정되어 일정 힘의 크기로 가압하면 회전 가능하게 이루어지는 투명회전판; 및 각각 정보를 담고 있고, 상기 투명회전판의 고정공을 중심으로 방사형으로 구비되는 다수개의 이미지 렌즈를 포함하고, 상기 정보 중 어느 하나는 상기 비상손전등이 구비된 층의 피난안내도이어서 상기 비상손전등의 전원을 켜면 피난안내도가 투과되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: UNIV NAT INCHEON RES & BUSINESS FOUND

title_en: Disaster monitoring response System based on IoT Wireless Network
title_ko: ＩｏＴ 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire monitoring response system based on an Internet of Things (IoT) wireless network and, more particularly, to a fire monitoring response system based on an IoT wireless network, which comprises: a sensing unit installed inside a building, sensing at least one among heat, smoke, carbon monoxide (CO), flame, humidity, and outlet arc, and having an IoT communication chip embedded therein; a wireless gateway for wireless reception, which is installed inside the building, which receives measurement data measured from the sensing unit and information on a location of an evacuee in the building, and which receives CCTV image data in the building; a platform server receiving the measurement data, the location information, and the image data in real time from the wireless gateway, predicting a situation based on simulation data, transmitting response information to a user terminal of the evacuee, and controlling that the situation to be notified through an IoT control unit; and an IoT control unit installed in several places inside the building and embedded with a speaker, a housing, and a display unit displaying an optimal route or an indicator to guide the optimal route. According to the present invention, information for predicting damage due to a disaster is provided in order to mitigate damage caused by the disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 건물 내에 설치되어, 열, 연기, CO, 불꼿, 습도, 콘센트 아크 중 적어도 어느 하나를 감지하고, IoT통신칩이 내장된 감지부; 건물 내에 설치되며, 감지부에서 측정된 측정데이터와, 건물 내 피난자의 위치정보를 수신하여, 건물 내 CCTV 영상데이터를 수신하는 와이어리스 수신용 무선게이트웨이; 상기 무선게이트웨이로부터 상기  측정데이터와, 상기 위치정보, 상기 영상데이터를 실시간으로 수신하여, 시뮬레이션데이터를 기반으로 상황을 예측하고, 대응정보를 상기 피난자의 사용자단말기에 전송하고, 상기 사물제어유닛을 통해 알리도록 제어하는 플랫폼 서버; 및 상기 건물 내에 복수로 설치되며,  스피커와, 하우징과, 최적경로 또는 최적경로를 안내하기 위한 표시자가 디스플레이되는 디스플레이부를 내장한 사물제어유닛;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 IoT 무선네트워크 기반 화재 감시 대응시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency directional evacuation system
abstract_en: The application discloses emergent directional evacuation system of fire control belongs to intelligent fire-fighting equipment field, has solved among the prior art emergent instruction unclear, the evacuation problem of being not convenient for. According to the technical scheme, each evacuation indicator lamp is provided with a plurality of bright light indicating arrows, and the indicating directions of all the bright light indicating arrows on the evacuation indicator lamps are respectively matched with the direction of an evacuation route where the evacuation indicator lamps are located; the navigation system judges the area of the fire source position in the building, reads the evacuation route of each evacuation indicator lamp in the floor where the fire source is located, and selects one evacuation route which does not pass through the fire source as an emergency evacuation route I; the navigation system sends the route direction of the first emergency evacuation route to an indicator light controller; and the indicator light controller controls the evacuation indicator light to light up the light indicator arrow according to the evacuation direction of the first emergency evacuation route. After the technical scheme of this application judges the position of the ignition in the building, can instruct safe evacuation route, the personnel safety in the help building is evacuated.

title_en: Coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coaxial double-rotor unmanned aerial vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles. The vertical cylindrical fuselage is adopted, the coaxial double propellers provide power, and the control of the aircraft is realized by changing the direction of the pulling force and the rotating speed difference of the double rotors. The invention can also adopt GNSS positioning equipment and vision positioning equipment to respectively combine with IMU to form an inertial satellite integrated navigation and vision-inertial navigation synchronous positioning and map building VI-SLAM navigation positioning system, and can realize autonomous flight in both open environment covered by GNSS and closed and GNSS-rejected environment. The aircraft has the attributes of universalization, informatization, autonomy, intellectualization and the like, has a simple structure, low cost, high efficiency ratio, firmness and durability and convenient carrying, can provide global situation information of 'no-go, no-touch and no-see' parts of streets, indoors, jungles and the like, and completes the tasks of detection or search and rescue of closed and sheltered spaces of cities, jungles, indoors and the like.
assignees: SHENYANG AIRCRAFT DESIGN INSTITUTE YANGZHOU COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency fire evacuation guidance system
title_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a fire evacuation route guidance system. The fire evacuation route guidance system comprises: a plurality of fire detectors placed inside a building to detect fire; a plurality of light sources placed inside the building and guiding an evacuation route in case of fire; and a controller receiving a fire location from at least one fire detector located at a fire occurrence point, selecting an optimal evacuation route from preset evacuation routes in accordance with the fire location, and operating the light sources located at the selected evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템이 제공된다. 화재 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 건물 내부에 배치되어 화재를 검출하는 다수의 화재 감지기들, 상기 건물 내부에 배치되며, 화재 시 대피 경로를 안내하는 다수의 광원들, 및 화재 발생 지점에 위치한 적어도 하나의 화재 감지기로부터 화재 위치를 수신하며, 상기 화재 위치에 따라 기설정된 대피 경로들 중 최적 대피 경로가 선택되고, 상기 선택된 대피 경로에 위치한 광원들을 작동시키는 제어기를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Fire-fighting evacuation path planning method, device and equipment based on multiple sensors
abstract_en: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a fire-fighting evacuation path planning method based on multiple sensors, which comprises the following steps: filtering depth three-dimensional point cloud data of a building to be evacuated to obtain standard three-dimensional point cloud data, and converting laser radar data of the building to be evacuated into a point cloud data format to obtain standard radar point cloud data; performing data fusion on the standard radar point cloud data and the standard three-dimensional point cloud data, and performing map construction processing on a result after the data fusion to obtain a global grid map; and performing path planning on a plurality of position nodes identified in the global grid map by using an improved ant colony algorithm obtained by performing algorithm optimization on the basic ant colony algorithm to obtain an evacuation path planning scheme. The invention also provides a fire-fighting evacuation path planning device based on the multiple sensors, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium. The invention can solve the problem of low efficiency of fire-fighting evacuation path planning based on multiple sensors.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINTIANZE FIRE FIGHTING ENG CO LTD

title_en: Positioning method, positioning device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a positioning method, an apparatus, an electronic device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of computers, and in particular to the technical fields of positioning technology, navigation technology, intelligent transportation, etc. The implementation scheme is as follows: continuously acquiring at least one positioning point of a user; responding to the situation that the user is located in the area with the building shelter in the preorder state, and judging whether at least one positioning point is located outside the area; judging whether the user is in a walking state; and in response to determining that the at least one location point is outside the area and that the user is in a walking state, determining that the user has left the area.
assignees: BEIJING BAIDU NETCOM SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Natural disaster early warning system of intelligence wrist-watch
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent watches, in particular to a natural disaster early warning system of an intelligent watch; the disaster early warning system comprises an intelligent watch end, a disaster early warning platform and a rescue center platform; according to the invention, the natural disaster condition is monitored through the disaster early warning platform, the natural disaster is graded, the information of the natural disaster occurrence area is obtained and transmitted to the intelligent watch end in the disaster occurrence area, the intelligent watch end sends out early warning alarm and displays the natural disaster information, the evacuation personnel can go to the corresponding refuge place according to navigation, the effect of rapidly informing the personnel to leave the natural disaster area can be realized through the intelligent watch, in addition, the emergency treatment data of the natural disaster can be searched according to the requirement, the learning and emergency treatment of the natural disaster are realized, the processing capability of the natural disaster is improved, and the help seeking and positioning can be initiated to the rescue center, so that the rescue personnel can position the help seeking personnel and provide help to the help seeking personnel.
assignees: SHENZHEN NIUJIAOJIAN BIG DATA SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: Bus evacuation aggregation point deployment method for urban emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public transport evacuation assembly point deployment method aiming at city emergency evacuation, which comprises the following steps: (1) determining an evacuation area and an evacuation cell; (2) determining a bus evacuation aggregation point alternative set by considering multiple factors; (3) constructing and solving a bus evacuation aggregation point selection optimization model to obtain a bus evacuation aggregation point; (4) temporary evacuation route guidance facilities and public transport evacuation aggregation point marking measures are additionally arranged, and evacuation registration cards are distributed at the aggregation points. According to the method, abnormal factors in an emergency state are considered, people to be evacuated are managed in a centralized mode according to special requirements of emergency response, the distribution of bus evacuation aggregation points is optimized, emergency evacuation is more efficient, casualties during evacuation are reduced as much as possible, and reference is provided for managers to formulate emergency evacuation schemes.

title_en: Fire escape route guidance system based on fire simulation and IoT sensor fusion
title_ko: 화재 시뮬레이션 및 사물 인터넷 센서 융합 기반의 화재 대피로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a fire escape route guidance system based on fire simulation and IoT sensor convergence, which includes: a plurality of sensor units which is disposed in each area inside the building to detect carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, fine dust, temperature, and smoke; a fire receiving unit which monitors whether a fire occurs and the location of a fire based on detection data detected by the plurality of sensor units; and a data server which calculates the fire propagation speed for each space by driving a fire simulator based on the data on the internal structure of the building stored in advance and the detection data received from the fire receiving unit.
abstract_ko: 화재 시뮬레이션 및 사물 인터넷 센서 융합 기반의 화재 대피로 안내 시스템은 건축물 내부의 각 영역마다 배치되어 이산화탄소, 일산화탄소, 미세먼지, 온도 및 연기를 감지하는 복수의 센서부와, 복수의 센서부에서 감지한 감지 데이터를 토대로 화재발생 여부 및 화재발생 위치를 모니터링 하는 화재 수신부와, 미리 저장된 건축물의 내부구조에 대한 데이터와 화재 수신부로부터 수신된 감지 데이터를 토대로 화재 시뮬레이터를 구동하여, 공간별 화재 전파속도를 산출하는 데이터 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Guidance apparatus of evacuation route
title_ko: 피난로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guidance apparatus and aims to provide an evacuation route guidance apparatus that can be easily recognized when visibility is obscured by darkness or smoke. The evacuation route guidance apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a display unit including an electronic display panel that outputs visual information for indicating an evacuation route; a voice output unit that outputs auditory information for indicating the evacuation route; a motion detection unit that detects a motion of a person within a certain distance range; a control unit that controls the voice output unit to output evacuation route guidance information when the motion detection unit detects the motion of the person; a power supply unit that supplies power to the display unit, the voice output unit, the motion detection unit, and the control unit; and a housing that provides a space in which the display unit, the voice output unit, the motion detection unit, and the control unit are installed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 피난로 안내 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 피난로 안내 장치는, 피난로를 안내하는 시각적 정보를 출력하는 전자식 디스플레이 패널을 포함하는 디스플레이부; 피난로를 안내하는 청각적 정보를 출력하는 음성 출력부; 일정 거리 범위 내의 사람의 동작을 감지하는 동작 감지부; 상기 동작 감지부에 의해 사람의 동작이 감지되면 피난로 안내 정보를 출력하도록 음성 출력부를 제어하는 제어부; 상기 디스플레이부, 상기 음성 출력부, 상기 동작 감지부 및 상기 제어부에 전력을 공급하는 전원부; 및 상기 디스플레이부, 상기 음성 출력부, 상기 동작 감지부 및 상기 제어부가 설치되는 공간을 제공하는 하우징을 포함한다.

title_en: Personnel emergency escape path planning method and computer equipment under condition of ship water inflow
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel emergency escape path planning method under the condition of ship water inflow. The personnel emergency escape path planning method comprises the following steps: step 1: simulating the water inflow of a ship, and monitoring the water inflow change condition of a ship body, the water level height change condition of a water inlet cabin and the motion angle of the ship body; step 2: planning a path for the personnel in the water inlet area to escape to the outlet of the water inlet area by taking the water inlet time as a temporary safety check factor; and 3, step 3: and checking the planned path in the step 2 by taking the specified evacuation time of the MSC as a safety index. The invention is used for solving the problem of how to select the optimal escape path when water enters the ship.

title_en: Crowd evacuation dynamic path planning method for solving shortest path based on multi-outlet selection A-x algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a crowd evacuation dynamic path planning method for solving the shortest path based on a multi-outlet selection A-x algorithm, which comprises the steps of carrying out bidirectional search from a starting point and an end point, selecting new expansion nodes, evaluating the expansion nodes by combining a personnel evacuation fluid model, finishing planning when the expansion nodes are the same, and then carrying out priority sequencing on the planned route; queuing or congestion judgment is carried out, and the non-congested and non-optimal lines are redistributed to complete path planning; aiming at the improvement of the existing algorithm, the invention follows the relevant guiding requirements of the maritime organization, considers the complexity of the group path and the evacuation environment, and divides different evacuation routes into allocation strategies with different priorities, so that the map node information matrix is simplified, and the planning efficiency is greatly improved.

title_en: Optimization method for dam break disaster risk avoiding transfer scheme of tailing pond
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of disaster risk management of a tailing pond, in particular to an optimization method of a dam break disaster risk avoiding transfer scheme of the tailing pond, which comprises the following steps: step S1, simulating the evolution process of the dam break tailing flow; step S2, planning the risk avoidance transfer optimal route; and step S3, dynamically simulating the risk avoidance transfer process. According to the method, the time-varying characteristic of dam break tailing flow is considered, dynamic simulation of the risk group risk avoiding transfer process is realized on the basis of the optimal risk avoiding transfer path, the position relation between risk groups and the tailing flow in the risk avoiding transfer process is disclosed, the latest evacuation starting time capable of ensuring that the risk groups can safely finish risk avoiding transfer is obtained, and a theoretical basis is provided for safety completion of risk avoiding transfer of residents in the downstream of a tailing pond.

title_en: System and method for guiding of evacuation route
title_ko: 대피로 유도 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and method for guiding an evacuation route are disclosed. The system for guiding an evacuation route according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a plurality of detection sensors transmitting state detection information sensed within a preset area together with their own identification information; a danger recognition server identifying evacuee information and danger awareness information including at least one of whether a dangerous situation occurs, a point where a danger occurs, a direction to which the danger spreads, and a degree of severity of a danger state based on state detection information transmitted from the detection sensors and a danger recognition machine learning algorithm; an evacuation route guidance server generating evacuation guidance information for each evacuation group including information on an evacuation route and evacuation route guidance; and an output unit inducing an evacuation of evacuees by providing the evacuation route guidance information including at least one of an evacuation notification sound and an evacuation notification video from a start point to an end point of the evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 대피로 유도 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 대피로 유도 시스템 및 방법은 기 설정된 영역 내에서 감지된 상태 감지 정보를 자신의 식별정보와 함께 전달하기 위한 복수의 감지 센서; 복수의 감지 센서로부터 전달되는 상태 감지 정보 및 위험 인지 기계학습 알고리즘을 기초로 위험상황 발생 여부, 위험 발생 지점, 위험 확산 방향, 위험 상태의 심각 정도 중 적어도 하나 이상을 포함하는 위험 인지 정보 및 대피자 정보를 파악하기 위한 위험 인식 서버; 대피 경로 및 대피로 유도 정보를 포함하는 대피 그룹별 대피 안내 정보를 생성하기 위한 대피로 유도 서버; 및 대피 경로의 출발점으로부터 도착점까지의 대피 알림음 및 대피 알림 영상 중 적어도 하나 이상을 포함하는 대피로 유도 정보를 제공하여 대피자들의 대피를 유도하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Portable navigation aid lamp and remote control system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable navigation lamp and a remote control system thereof, which comprise an optical module, an optical sensor, an IOT communication module, a remote control receiving module and a control module, wherein the optical sensor is used for detecting the ambient illumination, the IOT communication module is used for connecting an Internet of things gateway, and the remote control receiving module is used for receiving remote control signals; the control module is used for automatically adjusting and controlling the optical module according to the ambient illumination, automatically adjusting and controlling the optical module according to a signal sent by the gateway of the Internet of things, or automatically adjusting and controlling the optical module according to a remote control signal. According to the portable navigation aid lamp and the remote control system provided by the invention, the portable navigation aid lamp can be configured to emergency shelters such as schools, parks, squares and the like, any engineering construction is not needed, no professional requirement is required for ground workers, the portable navigation aid lamp and the remote control system have the capability of an emergency parking apron, an aviation emergency rescue network is rapidly expanded, and the response speed, the maneuvering capability and the rescue level of rescue are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN STAR STANDARD SCIENCE AND TECH INC

title_en: Mixed reality method for escape and danger avoidance of personnel in dangerous accident of underground space structure
abstract_en: The invention provides a mixed reality method for escaping and avoiding danger of personnel in dangerous accidents of an underground space structure, and belongs to the technical field of space escaping. The method comprises the following steps: grading and calibrating all feasible escape paths from a working surface to a destination of an exit and a refuge chamber, and arranging a sensor network to sense underground space information; constructing a 3-dimensional model of the underground space escape path according to a marking result of the feasible escape path, guiding the model into a game engine to construct a mixed reality 4-dimensional navigation map, and embedding a path optimizing algorithm to construct a virtual navigation system, wherein the virtual navigation system is used for realizing the guidance of the optimal escape path in a man-machine interaction mode according to the shortest path principle according to the acquired sensor information; and deploying the virtual navigation system to the mixed reality equipment, and calling the virtual navigation system through the worn mixed reality equipment to realize the guidance of the optimal escape route in real time when the accident occurs. By adopting the invention, the guidance of the optimal escape route can be realized in real time.

title_en: Power plant alarm notification and information provision system and method using beacon
title_ko: 비콘을 이용한 발전소 경보 알림 및 정보 제공 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a power plant alarm notification and information provision system and method using a beacon. The system includes: a beacon that broadcasts unique identification information by being attached to at least one of at least one pieces of equipment, entrance, emergency exit, facility, evacuation route, and emergency alert notification device; a portable terminal that receives the unique identification information of the beacon when located within the communication range of the beacon; and a control server communicating with at least one beacon and portable terminal. A beacon identification information receiving unit of the control server receives at least one of the unique identification information of the beacon transmitted from at least one beacon and the unique identification information of the beacon transmitted from a portable terminal located within the communication range of the beacon. A first database building unit constructs a beacon identification database by generating beacon identification data for each beacon with the unique identification information of the beacon transmitted from at least one beacon. An emergency evacuation route guidance unit uses the emergency beacon identification data to create dangerous area information at the location of the beacon where the emergency occurs. By transmitting the shortest evacuation route avoiding a dangerous area from each beacon location to a portable terminal, guidance is provided to workers to quickly recognize a disaster situation and evacuate in case of a safety accident that may occur at a power plant. In the event of a safety accident, human damage can be minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비콘을 이용한 발전소 경보 알림 및 정보 제공 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 적어도 하나의 장비, 출입구, 비상구, 시설물, 대피로, 및 비상경보알림장치 중 적어도 하나에 부착되어 고유식별정보를 브로드캐스팅하는 비콘, 비콘의 통신 범위 내에 위치하면 해당 비콘의 고유식별정보를 수신하는 휴대용 단말, 및 적어도 하나의 비콘 및 휴대용 단말과 통신하는 관제 서버를 포함할 수 있으며, 관제 서버의 비콘식별정보 수신부가 적어도 하나의 비콘에서 전송된 비콘의 고유식별정보, 및 비콘의 통신 범위 내에 위치한  휴대용 단말에서 전송된 비콘의 고유식별정보 중 적어도 하나를 수신하고, 제1데이터베이스 구축부가 적어도 하나의 비콘에서 전송된 비콘의 고유식별정보로 각각의 비콘에 대한 비콘식별데이터를 생성하여 비콘식별데이터베이스를 구축하며, 비상대피경로 안내부가 비상상황 발생 시  비콘식별데이터를 이용하여 비상상황이 발생한 비콘의 위치에 위험지역정보를 생성하고, 각각의 비콘의 위치에서 위험지역을 회피하는 최단대피경로를 휴대용 단말로 전송함으로써 발전소에서 발생할 수 있는 안전 사고에 대해 작업자가 신속하게 재난 상황을 인식하고 대피할 수 있도록 안내하여 안전 사고 발생 시 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system, evacuation route creation method, and recording medium recording program
abstract_en: An evacuation route guidance system, which can respectively acquire one or more images shot by one or more cameras placed near roads of a target area, and a hazard map which includes locations of one or more dangerous places and locations of one or more safe areas in the target aera, including: a movement analysis part for analyzing movement of one or more moving bodies passing through a road in the target area based on one or more images shot by the one or more cameras at a time of occurrence of a disaster; a route creation part for creating a route adapted to movement of a moving body passing through the road, which route enables the moving body to move to a safe area by avoiding the one or more dangerous places; and a route output part for outputting the route to a predetermined display apparatus.

title_en: Navigation method for evacuation in emergency state
abstract_en: A navigation method for evacuation in an emergency state includes creating a visualized map image based on an outdoor space and at least one indoor space in an area. A plurality of indoor locators and a plurality of outdoor locators are used to locate a personal mobile device held by a person. The personal mobile device is located when a controlled event, such as a gunshot event or a fire event, occurs. An augmented reality image is used to guide the person to an emergency refuge area. A visualized mag image is used to provide the person with information containing the location of the personal mobile device, the controlled event location, the emergency refuge area, and an evacuation route, thereby assisting the person in rapidly and easily moving away from the controlled event location.

title_en: System and method for planning personnel path of extra-long tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method for planning personnel paths of an extra-long tunnel. The system comprises a distribution box, a wide area radar, a wireless AP, a carbon monoxide detector, a temperature sensor, a visibility sensor, a wireless data transmission module, a positioning information processing module and a path planning terminal. The method of the invention collects the position information of personnel through a wide area radar and a wireless AP and uploads the position information to a positioning information processing module for positioning. When a fire disaster happens, the carbon monoxide concentration, the temperature and the visibility in the tunnel are measured by the carbon monoxide detector, the temperature sensor and the visibility sensor and are transmitted to the path planning terminal. The path planning terminal rasterizes the tunnel in two dimensions, considers the influence of the environment on personnel safety, obtains the optimal personnel evacuation path scheme through the self-adaptive ant colony algorithm based on the maximum entropy, and guides personnel to escape. The invention can provide safe escape paths for personnel according to the real-time condition of fire in the tunnel, and improve the safety level of the personnel in the tunnel.

title_en: Evacuation route guide system capable of remote inspecting life raft and updating evacuation route
title_ko: 구명뗏목의 원격 점검과 대피경로 갱신이 가능한 선박 내 실시간 대피경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a real-time evacuation route guide system within a ship capable of remotely inspecting life rafts and updating evacuation routes. The real-time evacuation route guide system in a ship capable of remotely inspecting life rafts and updating evacuation routes according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an inspection module installed in each of the N life rafts to measure the concentration of gas filled in the life rafts; a server including an analysis unit analyzing the state of the life rafts from the gas concentration information received from the inspection module, a movement path storage unit storing the movement path inside the hull as data, and an evacuation route generation unit receiving first location information, which is information on the location of the user terminal, and second location information, which is information on the locations of the life rafts determined to be normal from the analysis unit, analyzing the shortest distance from the first location to the second location, and transmitting the analysis result to the user terminal. The real-time evacuation route guide system in a ship capable of remotely inspecting life rafts and updating evacuation routes according to the present invention remotely checks whether the life rafts are operating normally in real time, and in the case of an emergency, analyzes, in real time, the shortest distance between a user terminal owned by each of passengers of a ship and life rafts which can be normally operated, sets an evacuation route, and then provides the evacuation route through the user terminal.
abstract_ko:
구명뗏목의 원격 점검과 대피경로 갱신이 가능한 선박 내 실시간 대피경로 안내 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 구명뗏목의 원격 점검과 대피경로 갱신이 가능한 선박 내 실시간 대피경로 안내 시스템은, N개의 구명뗏목에 각각 설치되어 상기 구명뗏목 내부에 충진되는 가스의 농도를 측정하는 점검모듈; 상기 점검모듈로부터 수신한 가스 농도정보로부터 상기 구명뗏목의 상태를 분석하는 분석부와, 선체 내부의 이동경로가 데이터로 저장되는 이동경로 저장부와, 사용자 단말의 위치인 제1위치정보와 상기 분석부로부터 정상 판정된 상기 구명뗏목의 위치인 제2위치정보를 수신하고, 상기 제1위치정보로부터 제2위치정보까지의 최단거리를 분석하여 상기 사용자 단말로 전송하는 대피경로 생성부를 포함하는 서버;를 포함한다.
본 발명에 의하면, 구명뗏목의 정상작동 여부를 원격으로 실시간 점검하며, 비상상황 발생 시 선박 탑승자들 각각이 소지하는 사용자 단말과 정상작동 가능한 구명 뗏목 간의 최단거리를 실시간으로 분석하여 대피경로를 설정한 후 사용자 단말을 통해 제공할 수 있는 구명뗏목의 원격 점검과 대피경로 갱신이 가능한 선박 내 실시간 대피경로 안내 시스템이 제공된다.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted navigation positioning method and system and T-BOX
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle navigation positioning method, which comprises the steps of periodically detecting the loss condition of a GNSS signal; if the GNSS signal is not lost in the current period, acquiring the positioning data of the vehicle in the current period according to the GNSS signal received in the current period, and correcting the positioning data of the vehicle in the current period according to the preset RTK data to be used as the final positioning data of the current period to be output; and if the GNSS signal is lost in the current period, acquiring the speed of the vehicle in the current period and the positioning data of the vehicle in the previous period, and combining a preset dead reckoning technology to obtain the positioning data of the vehicle in the current period and outputting the positioning data as the final positioning data of the current period. The method and the device have the sub-meter positioning capability and can overcome the problem of larger deviation of positioning accuracy caused by no GNSS signal in a sheltering environment.

title_en: Automatic driving and parking abnormality identification method
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic driving and parking abnormality identification method, which comprises the following steps: installing temperature monitoring equipment in a parking lot specifically comprises: acquiring temperature data by using a DS18B20 temperature sensor; installing an automatic driving automobile charging pile in a parking lot; identifying a part with abnormal temperature when the automatic driving automobile is charged; the method for protecting the privacy information of the vehicle owner after identification through the blockchain specifically comprises the following steps: encrypting the private information using the blockchain; an alarm is sent out when the temperature of a parking space at a certain position of the parking lot is abnormal, the method specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring temperature data for prediction; prompting related personnel according to the severity degree of the temperature abnormality, which specifically comprises the following steps: assessing the severity of the temperature anomaly; planning an optimal route for emergency evacuation, wherein the planning of the optimal route for emergency evacuation specifically comprises the following steps: and (3) preparing data, and planning a fastest arrival route by using a Floyd shortest path.

title_en: Mine water disaster flooding analysis and real-time dynamic escape route optimization method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of navigation, in particular to a method for analyzing mine flood damage and optimizing a real-time dynamic escape route, which comprises the following steps: determining the water inrush amount of the mine water disaster according to the water inrush type; determining the equivalent length of the roadway according to the gradient of the roadway in the mine, the type of the roadway, local obstacles and wind speed and direction; determining the water level height of each roadway in the mine within the current time period according to the water inrush quantity of the mine water damage; updating the passing time of each roadway in the current time period according to the water level height of each roadway in the current time period in the mine and the equivalent length of each roadway; and determining the optimal escape route of the mine water damage in the current time period based on the Dijkstra algorithm by taking the passing time of each roadway in the current time period as the weight, so that the optimal escape route can be planned in real time, and underground personnel can escape to a safe place at the highest speed.
assignees: NORTH CHINA INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE & TECH CHINA COAL MINE SAFETY TECH TRAINING CENTER;SHAANXI FUTURE ENERGY CHEMICAL CO LTD

title_en: indoor navigation service method and apparatus
title_ko: 실내 네비게이션 서비스 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An indoor navigation method according to the present invention includes steps of: detecting image information by receiving captured image information from an image capture device; generating optimized visual path information by performing running by receiving the image information; and outputting the visual path information through a display device. Thus, people looking for an emergency evacuation route or rescuers deployed to a building for emergency relief can easily find the evacuation route.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르는 실내 네비게이션 방법은, 촬상장치로부터 촬상된 촬상정보를 제공받아 이미지 정보를 검출하는 단계; 상기 이미지 정보를 제공받아 러닝을 이행하여 최적화된 시각적 경로정보를 생성하는 단계; 상기 시각적 경로정보를 상기 디스플레이 장치를 통해 출력하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: KYUNGPOOK NAT UNIV IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: Emergency evacuation control method
title_ko: 재난대피 통제 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control method for emergency evacuation. The control method for emergency evacuation includes: a step (A) of transmitting access information on an accessor from multiple access control terminals installed for access control by each divided section of a structure to a central control server; a step (B) of sensing and transmitting disaster occurrence to the central control server by multiple disaster sensors installed by being dispersed in a building; a step (C) of setting an optimal evacuation route by considering access information on the accessor, the position and the kind of the disaster occurrence, and existing structure information including division information on the structure, a gate position, a stair position, and a descending life line position by the central control server; and step (D) of guiding an evacuation route through an evacuation route guiding means according to the predetermined optimal evacuation route. According to the present invention, the control method for emergency evacuation sets the optimal evacuation route considering a moving amount of the evacuating people when a disaster occurs, thereby effectively guiding the evacuation route and preventing secondary damage caused by a stampede of the evacuating people.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 (A) 구조물의 구획된 구분구역별로 출입통제를 위하여 설치되는 복수의 출입통제 단말기로부터 출입자의 출입 정보가 중앙 제어 서버로 전송되는 단계; (B) 건물 내부에 분산되어 구비되는 복수의 재난감지 센서가 재난 발생을 감지하여 상기 중앙 제어 서버로 전송하는 단계; (C) 상기 중앙 제어 서버가 구조물의 구획 정보, 출입문 위치, 계단 위치, 완강기 위치를 포함하는 기존의 구조물 정보와, 상기 출입자의 출입 정보 및 상기 재난 발생 위치 및 종류를 고려하여 최적대피경로를 설정하는 단계; 및 (D) 상기 설정된 최적대피경로에 따라 대피 경로 안내수단을 통하여 대피 경로를 안내하는 단계;를 포함하는 재난대피 통제 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면 재난발생 시 대피 인원의 유동량을 고려한 최적의 대피 경로를 선정함으로써, 효과적으로 대피 경로를 안내하고 대피 인원의 집중으로 인한 2차 피해를 방지할 할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Visual vehicle-mounted navigator with freely-adjustable anti-glare effect
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a car navigation technology field just discloses an effectual visual vehicle automatic navigator of anti-dazzle that can freely adjust, including the display screen, the back connection of display screen has the frame, the internally mounted of frame has the pivot, be connected with shading cloth in the pivot, the both sides of shading cloth are connected with plastic iron wire, torque spring is installed on the right side of pivot. This can freely adjust effectual visual vehicle automatic navigator of anti-dazzle, cooperation through shading cloth and plastic iron wire, make the display screen can utilize shading cloth to carry out the shading in the use, make shading cloth can maintain to carry out the highlight to the display screen under suitable state simultaneously under the effect of plastic iron wire and shelter from, avoid the display screen to take place glare phenomenon under the sunshine penetrates directly, improve user's experience, reduce the driving error that glare phenomenon caused, improve the security among the driving process.
assignees: NANJING BOYU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire detection and exit course guide system
title_ko: 화재감지 및 피난경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: A fire detection and evacuation route guidance system is disclosed. The fire detection and evacuation route guidance system, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a fire detection unit that detects a fire-related factor comprising at least one of flame, heat, smoke, and gas, and collects sensing data for each fire-related factor; a fire determination unit that determines that a fire has occurred when the sensing data satisfies a predetermined condition; an evacuation route calculation unit that determines a fire location based on the determination on the fire by the fire determination unit and calculates an optimal evacuation route; and a fire occurrence information providing unit that displays the optimal evacuation route calculated by the evacuation route calculation unit on a preset display panel and outputs a fire warning sound.
abstract_ko: 화재감지 및 피난경로 안내 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일실시례에 따른 화재감지 및 피난경로 안내 시스템은 불꽃, 열, 연기 및 가스 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 화재 관련 인자를 감지하고, 상기 화재 관련 인자별 센싱 데이터를 수집하는 화재감지부; 상기 센싱 데이터가 기설정된 조건을 만족하는 경우, 화재가 발생한 것으로 판단하는 화재판단부; 상기 화재판단부에서 판단된 화재 발생여부에 기초하여 화재발생위치를 결정하고, 최적피난경로를 산출하는 피난경로산출부; 및 상기 피난경로산출부에서 산출된 상기 최적피난경로를 기설정된 디스플레이 패널에 디스플레이하고, 화재경고음성을 출력하는 화재발생정보제공부;를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and system for establishing image of mower and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a system for constructing a picture of a mower and a readable storage medium, wherein the method for constructing the picture of the mower comprises the following steps: acquiring the GPS coordinates of the current position point in real time from a GPS module, and acquiring the position information of the current position point from a navigation positioning module; when the mower enters a high-precision area from a sheltering area, re-determining the GPS coordinates of each position point in the sheltering area according to the GPS coordinates and the position information of at least one position point in the high-precision area; and establishing a map according to the GPS coordinates of each position point in the high-precision area and the re-determined GPS coordinates of each position point in the shielding area. Through the technical scheme, even if the mower enters the shielding area during drawing construction, the accurate GPS coordinates of each position point in the shielding area can be obtained, the drawing construction information accuracy is improved, and the mowing efficiency and the mowing performance (avoiding missed mowing) of the mower during working are improved. Moreover, repeated attempts by an installer to install the charging base station can be avoided.

title_en: Evacuation path planning method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an evacuation path planning method, an evacuation path planning device, computer equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to an evacuation path planning system, wherein the evacuation path planning system comprises a plurality of intelligent bodies arranged on target objects, and each intelligent body is respectively arranged corresponding to each target object one by one, and the method comprises the following steps: when the occurrence of an emergency is detected, the current position and the exit position of each intelligent agent are obtained; generating a planned evacuation path corresponding to each intelligent agent by utilizing a path planning reinforcement learning model introducing a space discount factor based on the current position and the exit position of each intelligent agent; and respectively sending the generated planned evacuation paths to the corresponding intelligent agents so that the target objects corresponding to the intelligent agents are respectively evacuated according to the planned evacuation paths. By the evacuation path planning method, the evacuation path planning device, the computer equipment and the storage medium, the target object corresponding to the intelligent agent is evacuated, so that casualties caused by emergency events are reduced, and the safety of personnel is ensured.
assignees: BEIJING HUADIAN LITUO ENERGY TECH CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for determining emergency evacuation path planning scheme of railway passenger station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for determining a planning scheme of an emergency evacuation path of a railway passenger station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an emergency evacuation scene and a group to be evacuated of a railway passenger station; and inputting the emergency evacuation scene, the group to be evacuated and the target constraint condition into a railway passenger station emergency evacuation model to obtain an in-station evacuation route planning scheme output by the railway passenger station emergency evacuation model. According to the method and the device for determining the railway passenger station emergency evacuation path planning scheme, the railway passenger station emergency evacuation model is obtained through emergency evacuation basic data, emergency situation types, in-station personnel composition data, evacuation group classification and people flow speed training, the influence of the evacuation group types and the people flow speed on evacuation paths is considered, the occurrence probability of trampling or crowding events is reduced, and the crowd evacuation efficiency is improved.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE

title_en: Escape Experience Simulation Devices and Methods in a Ship Crash
title_ko: 선박 충돌 시 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to ship collision escape experience simulation device and method implemented similarly to an actual situation in which a ship collides at sea so that an experiencer can directly or indirectly experience an accident caused by an actual ship collision and directly experience and learn the situation in which it is possible to escape outside the ship. Experiencers directly or indirectly board a model experience center similar to an actual ship, and take safety education through realistic videos and various driving experiences (ship navigation course, collision experience). The purpose is to provide a comprehensive safety education environment with storytelling in the field of ship safety through safety training on boarding and disembarking ships, safety training on boarding ships, how to respond in case of emergency situations involving ship collisions, and safe escape experiences. In order to achieve the purpose, the present invention provides '3D simulation content', 'hydraulic cylinder drive device and solid foundation base as a ship driving device', 'evacuation broadcast' inside the ship, and a physical 'experience space' to escape through risk factors that may occur on the ship. The present invention provides an evacuation zone where those who have boarded the ship can escape safely without panic immediately after being stranded in the event of a ship collision, which provides practical help in providing advance awareness training for maritime safety accidents and preventing fatal accidents, and promotes awareness of ship safety.
abstract_ko:
기계금속 : 선박충돌 시 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법 
{Escape Experience Simulation Devices and Methods in a Ship Crash} 
(1) 기술분야 
- 본 발명은 본 발명은 선박이 해상에서 충돌된 실제 상황과 유사하게 구현되어 체험자가 실제 선박 충돌로 인한 사고 에 대해 직간접적으로 체험하고, 선박 외부로 탈출할 수 있는 상황을 직접 체험 학습 할 수 있도록 선박 충돌 탈출체험 시뮬레이션 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
(2) 해결 하고자하는 과제수단 
- 체험자가 직간접적으로 실제 선박과 같은 모형체험관에 탑승하여, 실감형 영상을 통한 안전교육과 다양한 구동 체험(선박 항해과정, 충돌체험)을 제공 합니다. 
- 선박 승하차 안전교육, 선박 향해전 탑승 안전교육, 선박 충돌한 비상시 대응법과 안전한 탈출 체험등을 통해, 선박안전 부문의 스토리텔링이 있는 종합적인 안전교육 환경을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
(3) 과제의 해결수단 
- 본 발명은 상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위하여, 선박에서 발생할 수 있는 위험요소를 통해 '3D 시뮬레이션 콘텐츠' 와 '선박 구동장치로 유압실린더 구동장치와 견고한 기초 베이스' 와 선박 실내 '대피 방송' 과 선박탈출 물리적 '체험공간' 구현 한다. 
(4) 효과 
본 발명은 선박 충돌 시 좌초 즉시 탑승 체험자가 당황하지 않고 안전하게 탈출할 수 있는 대피 탈출 존을 제공하여 해상 안전사고의 사전 인지 교육과 인명 재해사고로 사전 예방하는 데 실질 도움과 선박 안전인식을 고취하는 데 효과가 있다.

title_en: Evacuation guidance apparatus for the blind that can be evacuated by self in case of fire and method thereof
title_ko: 피난경로를 제공하기 위한 사용자 단말기 및 그의 피난경로 제공 방법
abstract_en: A user terminal for providing an evacuation route and an evacuation route providing method thereof are provided. A user terminal for providing an evacuation route service to a user in a building including one or more evacuation floors and one or more general floors comprises: a communication unit receiving positioning signals from indoor positioning beacons provided in the building and receiving sub-signals from sub-route guidance beacons installed at each evacuation landmark on each floor of the building; a memory storing an evacuation guidance program that automatically recognizes a fire alarm occurring in the building in a standby mode and provides an evacuation route to a user in an active mode; a processor switching the evacuation guidance program to the active mode if a fire alarm is automatically recognized, measuring the current position of the user in real-time by making communications with the indoor positioning beacons, and providing an evacuation route including at least one between a main evacuation route preset based on the measured current position and sub evacuation routes including whether or not to enter the evacuation landmark received from the sub-route guidance beacons; and a speaker providing a user with the evacuation route in a voice. Evacuation routes can be provided more safely and accurately.
abstract_ko: 피난경로를 제공하기 위한 사용자 단말기 및 그의 피난경로 제공 방법이 제공된다.  하나 이상의 피난층과 하나 이상의 일반층을 포함하는 건물에서 사용자에게 피난경로서비스를 제공하는 사용자 단말기는, 건물 내에 구비된 실내측위비콘들로부터 측위 신호를 수신하고, 건물 각 층의 피난 랜드마크들마다 설치된 서브 경로안내비콘들로부터 서브 신호를 수신하는 통신부와, 대기모드에서 건물에서 발생하는 화재경보를 자동인지하고, 활성화모드에서 사용자에게 피난 경로를 제공하는 피난유도 프로그램을 저장하는 메모리와, 화재경보가 자동인지되면 피난유도 프로그램을 활성화모드로 전환하고, 실내측위 비콘들과 통신하여 사용자의 현재 위치를 실시간으로 측위하고, 측위된 현재 위치를 기초로 사전에 설정된 메인 피난 경로와, 서브 경로안내비콘들로부터 수신되는 피난 랜드마크로의 진입 여부를 포함하는 서브 피난 경로 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 피난 경로를 제공하는 프로세서와, 사용자에게 피난 경로를 음성으로 제공하는 스피커를 포함한다.
assignees: KOREA INST CIVIL ENG & BUILDING TECH

title_en: System for monitering occupant and guiding evacuation route and method thereof
title_ko: 재실자 모니터링 및 피난경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring an occupant and guiding an evacuation route. The system includes: a beacon which generates a BLE signal by installing a plurality of evacuation guidance lights in a hallway in a building, an entrance of each room, and an evacuation exit; a smartphone with a fire evacuation guidance application installed therein; and a server which transmits evacuation guidance information to the registered smartphone application after receiving a fire signal. The fire evacuation guidance application is automatically executed by receiving a beacon signal and transmits beacon information and a smartphone number to the designated server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재실자 모니터링 및 피난경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물 내 복도의 피난 유도등, 각 실의 출입구, 피난구에 다수 개를 설치하여 BLE 신호를 발생하는 비콘; 화재 피난 안내 앱이 설치된 스마트폰; 및 화재발생 신호를 전달받아 등록된 스마트폰 전용앱으로 피난 안내 정보를 전송하는 서버;를 포함하되, 상기 화재 피난 안내 앱은 비콘 신호를 받아 자동으로 실행되어 해당 비콘 정보와 스마트폰 번호를 지정된 서버로 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Indoor evacuation navigation method for large complex building based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building indoor evacuation navigation method based on multi-source heterogeneous data fusion, which comprises the following steps: the BIM model data acquisition module scans the environment in a building room and converts the environment into a three-dimensional topological road network, the semantic information updating module updates the environment to obtain an updated three-dimensional topological road network, the camera data acquisition module senses and acquires the environment to obtain safety emergency information, and the sensor data acquisition module senses and acquires the environment to obtain the safety emergency information; the multi-source heterogeneous data fusion module fuses the three-dimensional topological road network or the updated three-dimensional topological road network and the safety emergency information to obtain multi-source heterogeneous data; and according to the multi-source heterogeneous data and the positioning information, the path planning module plans a dynamic optimal path and displays the dynamic optimal path in the visualization module. The method and the system fuse the dynamic change of the indoor safety emergency on the basis of the road network model, automatically avoid the indoor safety emergency road section and provide safe and efficient indoor navigation for users.
assignees: SHENZHEN PLANNING AND NATURAL RESOURCES DATA MAN CENTER SHENZHEN SPACE GEOGRAPHIC INFORMATION CENTER;UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH

title_en: Building fire-fighting emergency escape guiding method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire-fighting emergency escape guiding method, a system, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring fire detection data of each area of a target building, and determining a fire occurrence area, a passing obstacle area and a passable area according to the fire detection data; acquiring a three-dimensional space model of a target building, and determining an evacuation destination, nodes to be evacuated, obstacle nodes and passable nodes of the three-dimensional space model; performing three-dimensional space path planning on the three-dimensional space model through a Dijstra algorithm to obtain a plurality of alternative optimal paths, and further performing secondary optimization on the alternative optimal paths through an ant colony algorithm to determine a global optimal path; and determining a plurality of emergency escape indicating lamps in the corresponding area according to the global optimal path, and performing escape guidance through the plurality of emergency escape indicating lamps. The invention improves the efficiency and the safety of personnel evacuation and emergency escape, and can be widely applied to the technical field of fire safety.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography path planning method suitable for water and soil conservation supervision of mountain wind power construction project
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography path planning method suitable for water and soil conservation and supervision of mountainous wind power construction projects, belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, and mainly comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a base and a system server, wherein the base is connected with the system server, the base is matched with the unmanned aerial vehicle and can charge the unmanned aerial vehicle and transmit a flight control instruction set, and the unmanned aerial vehicle performs data interaction with the base through a 5G mobile communication network. According to the method, planning and optimizing of the aerial photographing path of the mountainous wind power construction project water and soil conservation supervision unmanned aerial vehicle can be automatically carried out according to the arrangement of the inspection point positions and by combining the characteristics of the cruising ability and the type of the supervision point positions of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and an aerial photographing path control instruction set is generated. The instruction set is loaded into the unmanned aerial vehicle through the base, and the automatic control function of image shooting of key elements of water and soil conservation supervision of the inspection point can be realized. The invention can greatly improve the field supervision efficiency of water conservation supervisors and can effectively regulate the safety risk of mountain road patrol after rain shelter.
assignees: HUADIAN ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent emergency management system for evacuation platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses an intelligent emergency management system for an evacuation platform, which comprises a server side, wherein the server side comprises: the information receiving module receives the alarm information of the trigger end, acquires the position information of the trigger end according to the alarm information and sends the acquired position information to the primary data processing module; the alarm information comprises communication base station position information for receiving the alarm information for the first time, and the communication base station position information is position information corresponding to the alarm information; the primary data processing module is used for acquiring safety station information within n meters around according to the position information, generating a safety factor according to the safety station information, selecting the safety station as a navigation site according to preset conditions, generating and connecting a first skip link according to the selected navigation site, generating first mass-sending information according to the first skip link, and sending the first mass-sending information to the underground communication base station which receives the alarm information for the first time.
assignees: BEIJING DINGCHANG COMPOSITE MAT CO LTD

title_en: Urban flooding citizen support service provision system
title_ko: 도심지 침수 시민지원 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an urban flooding citizen support service provision system, which allows flooding prediction and prevention to be made through predictive simulation for risky areas where human life and property damage are concerned when flooding occurs in an urban area, but can minimize damage to citizens in the event of flooding through evacuation/detour route guidance linked to local traffic conditions and rapid real-time situation propagation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도심지에 침수 발생시 인명 및 재산피해가 우려되는 위험지역을 대상으로 예측 시뮬레이션을 통해 침수 예측과 예방이 이루어지도록 하되, 지역의 교통상황과 연계한 대피·우회 경로 안내 및 신속한 실시간 상황전파를 통해 침수 발생 시 시민의 피해를 최소화할 수 있는 도심지 침수 시민지원 서비스 제공 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Design method of indoor fire-fighting map based on space cognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a design method of an indoor fire-fighting map based on space cognition, and relates to the field of fire-fighting safety. The design method of the indoor fire-fighting map based on the space cognition specifically comprises the following steps of S1.BIM model building, S2.GIS data integration, S3. Expressing indoor space division, S4. Expressing fire-fighting special subject elements, S5. Designing the fire-fighting map, S6. Planning an evacuation route, S7. Constructing an auxiliary management system, S8. Simulating a fire simulation experiment, and S9. Formulating an emergency treatment plan. Through extracting the BIM model through the semanteme and geometrically converting into the 3D files data format of the three-dimensional GIS according with the OGC standard, establish data mapping through the database simultaneously and guaranteed that the data of BIM has been integrated completely, the intensity of model rendering has been greatly reduced, and the stability of data has been improved, and through the different map elements of attribute characteristic design, cooperate fire fighter cognitive characteristic, withdraw for the fire fighter of indoor rescue operation and provide effectual dynamic route, personnel's life safety has been ensured greatly.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF GEOGRAPHY FUJIAN NORMAL UNIV

title_en: Method for assisting GNSS-INS (global navigation satellite system-inertial navigation system) high-precision navigation and positioning by fisheye camera
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of navigation and positioning, in particular to a method for assisting GNSS-INS high-precision navigation and positioning by a fisheye camera. And calculating the altitude angle and the azimuth angle of the satellite by taking the position calculated by inertial navigation as an initial position, and mapping the satellite to fisheye imaging. And judging whether the signal is NLOS according to the image segmentation result, directly eliminating the NLOS signal when the LOS signal is sufficient, and performing weight reduction processing on the NLOS signal when the LOS signal is insufficient. According to the invention, the fish-eye camera is used for assisting GNSS to detect and process NLOS signals, the data of multiple sensors are fully utilized, the absolute positioning accuracy of low-cost equipment can be greatly improved under the sheltering environment such as urban canyons, and the like, and the method has a wide application prospect.

title_en: Laser radar device and navigation robot
abstract_en: The application discloses laser radar device and navigation robot belongs to the technical field of robots. The laser radar device comprises an explosion-proof body, a light-transmitting sleeve and a laser radar. The explosion-proof internal chamber that holds that is formed with, the printing opacity sleeve wears to locate to hold the chamber, and laser radar sets up in the printing opacity sleeve, offers and holds the opening that the chamber communicates along the circumference of explosion-proof body, and the open-ended is offered the position and is corresponding with laser radar's laser emission region. In this application, for satisfy laser radar's explosion-proof and scanning demand simultaneously, set up the printing opacity sleeve at the intracavity that holds of explosion-proof body, laser radar sets up in the printing opacity sleeve to set up the opening corresponding to laser radar's lasing region on explosion-proof body, explosion-proof body provides structural support for laser radar, and structural the not sheltering from that exists, the laser of laser radar transmission can be in order through printing opacity sleeve and opening to external transmission, in order to carry out normal scanning operation.
assignees: JIANGSU ELITVISION ROBOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method And System for Monitoring Fire
title_ko: 화재 감지 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for detecting a fire, which can monitor a fire situation so that a danger warning and evacuation route guidance is provided through optical display and people can be evacuated using evacuation elevators. The method comprises: a video monitoring step of performing real-time video monitoring of set monitoring spaces and/or monitoring areas of a building; a fire detection step of detecting a fire sign based on analysis of video data; a control step of performing support so that control personnel makes decisions about whether a fire has occurred by using display means; a control supplementation step of supporting a control supplementation function to improve the accuracy of the decision-making; a remote control supplementation step of supplementing making decisions about whether a fire has occurred through remote support in a situation in which there is no response from the control personnel for a set period of time; a fire notification step of performing notification and warning of a fire in the monitoring spaces and/or the monitoring areas in which it is confirmed that the fire has occurred; and a fire evacuation step of displaying a risk area pattern to warn occupants and/or rescuers of danger and providing fire evacuation routes and/or fire relief routes using evacuation elevators.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에서 화재발생시 광학표시를 통해 위험경고 및 대피경로안내를 수행하고 피난용 승강기를 이용하여 피난할 수 있도록 화재 발생 상황을 감시할 수 있는 화재 감지 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물의 설정된 감시공간 및/또는 감시구역에 대한 실시간 영상 모니터링을 수행하는 영상모니터링단계; 영상데이터의 분석을 기반으로 화재 징후를 감지하는 화재감지단계; 관제 담당자에게 표시수단을 이용하여 화재발생여부에 대한 의사결정을 지원하는 관제단계; 상기 의사결정의 정확성 향상을 위한 관제보완기능을 지원하는 관제보완단계; 설정된 시간내에 관제 담당자의 응답이 없는 상황에서 원격지원으로 화재발생여부에 의사결정을 보완하는 원격관제보완단계; 화재발생이 확인된 감시공간 및/또는 감시구역에 화재 알림 및 경고를 수행하는 화재알림단계; 및 재실자 및/또는 구호자에게 위험을 경고하도록 위험영역패턴을 표시하고 피난용 승강기를 이용한 화재대피경로 및/또는 화재구호경로를 제공하는 화재대피단계를 포함하는, 화재 감지 방법을 제공한다.
assignees: COMPANY S CO LTD;KOREA MIDLAND POWER CO LTD

title_en: Device for outputting guidance lights for evacuation route guidance and evacuation route guidance system including the same
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내를 위한 안내 조명 출력 장치 및 이를 포함하는 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: A guidance lighting output device for evacuation route guidance according to the present invention comprises: a body provided to be attachable and detachable from any installation object; an information output unit accommodated inside the body and including at least one lighting unit provided to emit a predetermined amount of light toward the ground; a power supply unit provided to supply power to operate the information output unit; and a control unit provided to generate a control signal for controlling the information output unit and the power supply unit, and configured to determine whether or not there is a power outage. The information output unit is provided to output at least one type of guidance information through the lighting unit based on the control signal. The present invention can provide accurate evacuation route guidance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 대피 경로 안내를 위한 안내 조명 출력 장치는 임의의 설치 대상물에 탈부착 가능하도록 구비되는 몸체; 상기 몸체 내부에 수용되면서, 지면을 향해 소정량의 빛을 방사하도록 구비되는 적어도 하나 이상의 조명 유닛을 포함하는 정보 출력부; 상기 정보 출력부를 가동시키기 위한 전원을 공급하도록 구비되는 전원 공급부; 및 상기 정보 출력부와 전원 공급부의 제어를 진행하는 제어 신호를 생성하도록 구비되면서, 정전 여부를 판단하도록 구비되는 제어부;를 포함하며, 상기 정보 출력부는, 상기 제어 신호를 기반으로 상기 조명 유닛을 통해, 적어도 1종 이상의 안내 정보를 출력하도록 구비되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Light-based disaster monitoring system
title_ko: 빛을 이용한 재난 감시 장치 및 그것을 이용한 대피로 안내 표시 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster monitoring device using light and a method for displaying evacuation route guidance using the same. More specifically, while disasters include fires with flammable materials, gas explosions, and facility collapses caused by man-made calamities due to carelessness, mistakes, or accidents in daily life, and natural disasters include various accidents such as fires, power outages, and building collapses due to earthquakes or weathers, the present invention relates to the disaster monitoring device using light and the method for displaying evacuation route guidance using the same, wherein various disasters that occur around living environments or around workers are monitored or detected by transmission and reception using straight light, and in case of disaster, an evacuation route is illuminated by lighting operation separately from broadcasting for guiding rapid evacuation, so that a lighting function provides immediate visual and auditory evacuation notifications at or near a disaster site and informs people to find directions and respond quickly. The disaster monitoring device comprises a light transmission unit, a mirror, a light reception unit, and a light blocking unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 빛을 이용한 재난 감시 장치 및 그것을 이용한 대피로 안내 표시 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 재난은 생활에서 부주의나 실수 또는 사고로 인한 인재에 의한 인화성 물질의 화재, 가스 폭발 사고, 시설물 붕괴 등이 있으며, 자연재해로는 지진, 기상이나 날씨에 의한 화재, 정전, 건물 붕괴 등 각종 사고가 발생할 수 있는데, 본 발명은 생활환경 주변이나 작업자 주변에서 발생하는 각종 재난을 직진성이 있는빛을 이용하여 송, 수신으로 감시 또는 재난을 감지, 탐지하여 재난 발생시, 신속한 대피를 안내할 방송과 별도 조명작동으로 대피로를 비춰지게 조명등 기능으로 재난 현장이나 재난 현장 주변에 즉각적인 시청각적인 신속한 대피알림 및 사람들에게 방향을 찾아 신속 대응을 하게 알려줄 수 있는 본 발명의 특징인 빛을 이용한 재난 감시 장치 및 그것을 이용한 대피로 안내 표시 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Building fire escape path planning method and device based on global information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire escape path planning method and device based on global information fusion. The optimal escape route is solved according to the internal conditions of the building and the real-time dynamic rescue information of fire stations around the building, so that disaster management and control, personnel escape and rescue implementation global information fusion are achieved, an optimal escape route strategy is determined, the efficiency and the quality of building fire disposal are improved, the maximum safety space and the real-time escape route planning can be obtained from the evolution of the whole life cycle of the fire, and the personnel jam or trapping caused by information islands or one-sided information is avoided.
assignees: FUJIAN QUANZHOU HIT RES INST ENGINEERING & TECH

title_en: Traffic flow regulating method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a traffic flow adjusting method, device, equipment and medium, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence, and in particular to the technical field of intelligent traffic and navigation. The implementation scheme is as follows: determining, for each of a plurality of channels, an actual traffic saturation of the channel within a current time period; determining a saturated channel and an evacuation channel of the plurality of channels based on the actual traffic saturation and the corresponding target saturation of each of the plurality of channels; and determining a vehicle inducement direction in a plurality of routes respectively passing through the plurality of channels based on a saturation channel and an evacuation channel of the plurality of channels, to perform traffic flow adjustment of the corresponding channel in the plurality of routes based on the vehicle inducement direction.
assignees: APOLLO ZHILIAN BEIJING TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent automobile navigation route positioning split screen query device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent automobile navigation route location divides screen inquiry unit, belong to car smart machine field, an intelligent automobile navigation route location divides screen inquiry unit, including operation panel and screen base, the operation panel is installed at the driver's cabin middle part, screen base fixed mounting is on the operation panel, operation panel surface mounting has button panel, the screen base is installed motor fixed plate and base frame, the inboard fixed mounting of motor fixed plate has electronic commentaries on classics machine, and electronic commentaries on classics machine and button panel electric connection, two universal driving shafts are installed on electronic commentaries on classics machine right side, corresponding ball screw is all installed on the universal driving shaft right side, and the equal fixed connection of ball screw right-hand member in base frame, it can realize drawing respectively to the position of making things convenient for driver and copilot's operation when needing, two can asynchronous inquiry and operate car navigation route, avoid sheltering from the field of vision or hindering driver's operation, be favorable to ensureing driving safety.

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation robot model based on confrontation reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention aims at the problems of path planning and intelligent decision making of the crowd evacuation robot. By modeling the fire environment of a multi-storey building, the building has a perfect building structure and a fire development mode. An intelligent agent behavior model used for simulating limited visual field and having no prior knowledge on building construction is designed by combining crowd behaviors, and the evacuation robot is trained based on a multi-intelligent agent post credit allocation reinforcement learning algorithm. Meanwhile, an antagonistic fire source generator agent is realized and used for deciding the generation position of the next fire source in a fire scene, modeling optimization is finally carried out on the robot behavior by combining an antagonistic reinforcement learning method, a generator-solver mode is formed, and an agent decision model with the optimal evacuation crowd effect is obtained through repeated iterative training.

title_en: Indoor evacuation route guidance method and system
title_ko: 실내 대피경로 안내 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an indoor evacuation route guidance method includes the steps of: receiving disaster situation information including information on the location of a disaster and the type of disaster inside a building; obtaining indoor location information including information about detailed locations inside the building, with respect to each of a plurality of people located inside the building, using a smart device owned by the individual; and dividing each of the plurality of people into a plurality of evacuation spaces, in response to the disaster situation information and the indoor location information, to provide an evacuation route, a route for movement.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 실내 대피경로 안내 방법은 건물 내부에서의 재난 발생 위치 및 재난 종류에 관한 정보를 포함하는 재난상황정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 건물 내부에 위치한 복수의 인원 각각에 대하여, 개인이 보유한 스마트기기를 이용하여 상기 건물 내부의 세부 위치에 관한 정보를 포함하는 실내위치정보를 획득하는 단계; 및 상기 재난상황정보 및 상기 실내위치정보에 대응하여, 상기 복수의 인원 각각에 대하여 복수의 대피공간으로 나누어 이동하기 위한 경로인 대피경로를 제공하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV SOOKMYUNG WOMENS IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: IoT-based intelligent elevator evacuation guidance system
title_ko: ＩｏＴ 기반의 지능형 승강식 피난 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT-based intelligent elevator evacuation guidance system, which comprises: an IoT device which detects the status of firefighting facilities and evacuation route guidance devices provided in a building in real time and generates status information; a management server which analyzes the status information and, in the event of a fire, generates evacuation information to encourage evacuation outside the building based on location coordinates corresponding to the status information, transmits the evacuation information to a smart device, and transmits the location coordinates along with fire information to a previously linked administrator terminal or relief agency; and the smart device which receives and outputs the evacuation information and transmits location coordinates thereof to the management server. According to the present invention, an operating status of firefighting facilities within the building to be monitored is monitored in real time, and when the fire is detected, the evacuation information is provided to the smart device of an occupant, and an evacuation route image can be superimposed on a 3D scanning image of the building to be projected on an inner wall of the building, or a corresponding image can be transmitted to the smart device of the occupant. Therefore, the occupant can quickly evacuate the building.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT 기반의 지능형 승강식 피난 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 건축물에 구비된 소방시설 및 피난로 안내장치의 상태를 실시간으로 감지하여 상태정보를 생성하는 IoT 디바이스; 상태정보를 분석하여 화재가 발생한 경우, 상태정보와 대응하는 위치좌표를 기준으로 건축물 외부로 피난을 유도하는 피난정보를 생성하여 스마트 디바이스로 전송하고, 기 연동된 관리자 단말기 또는 구호기관으로 화재정보와 함께 위치좌표를 전송하는 관리서버; 및 피난정보를 수신하여 출력하고, 자신의 위치좌표를 상기 관리서버로 전송하는 스마트 디바이스를 포함한다. 상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 감시대상 건축물 내의 소방시설 작동상태를 실시간으로 모니터링하여 화재가 감지되는 경우, 입실자의 스마트 디바이스로 피난정보를 안내하고, 건축물의 3D 스캐닝 영상 내에 대피로 영상을 중첩시켜 건축물 내벽면에 투사시키거나 해당 영상을 입실자의 스마트 디바이스로 전송할 수 있다. 따라서, 입실자가 신속하게 건축물 외부로 대피하게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Tunnel emergency evacuation route guidance system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a tunnel emergency evacuation route induction system, which comprises a plurality of groups of disaster site detection units and induction devices arranged along the length direction of a tunnel and a tunnel detection control center electrically connected with all the disaster site detection units and the induction devices; the tunnel detection control center receives the site disaster alarm signal transmitted by any disaster site detection unit and controls the induction device to display emergency evacuation induction information in the opposite direction of the disaster site detection unit corresponding to the site disaster alarm signal. The utility model can accurately judge the disaster occurrence position information so as to facilitate early disaster elimination operation; two groups of induction devices which are parallel to the side wall of the tunnel and the overhaul channel are adopted, so that secondary injury in the evacuation process is avoided; the induction device has high structural strength, can be conveniently arranged and installed, and can play an induction function by means of self power supply.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUZHI JIAOYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway station evacuation path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a subway station evacuation path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium.
