According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, a space topological relation diagram is constructed according to the planar diagram in the subway station, the space topological relation diagram comprises nodes and arc sections, and the two ends of each arc section are nodes; determining corresponding affected nodes and affected arc segments according to the set event influence area and the space topological relation diagram; and carrying out shortest path planning according to the affected nodes, the affected arc segments and the space topological relation diagram to obtain shortest evacuation paths corresponding to evacuation points and corresponding evacuation outlet nodes, so that the problem of lack of objectivity in evacuation of passengers in a subway station can be solved, the objectivity of evacuation guidance is improved, and the evacuation safety and the evacuation speed are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XINKE JIADU TECH CO LTD;PCI TECHNOLOGY GROUP CO LTD;GUANGZHOU HUAJIA SOFTWARE CO LTD;GUANGDONG HUAZHIYUAN INFORMATION ENG CO LTD;GUANGZHOU JIADU URBAN RAIL SMART OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Escape indication system for hydropower station flooding factory accident
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an escape indication system for a hydropower station submerged plant accident, which comprises a water level monitoring unit, a video monitoring unit, a submerged plant accident judging unit, an escape path planning unit and an escape path indication unit; the water level monitoring unit and the video monitoring unit are electrically connected with the submerged plant accident judging unit, the submerged plant accident judging unit is electrically connected with the escape path planning unit, and the escape path planning unit is electrically connected with the escape path indicating unit. Due to the adoption of the technical scheme, compared with the prior art, the utility model not only can display and release alarm information after the accident of the submerged plant, but also can indicate an escape route to provide escape guidance for people in the hydropower station power plant to evacuate rapidly.

title_en: Simulation apparatus for crowd behavior based on 3d virtual space
title_ko: 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a crowd behavior simulation device based on a three-dimensional virtual space, which can prevent damage and loss due to disaster occurrence, comprising: a destination input unit; a destination guidance field generation unit; a collision avoidance guidance field generating unit; a collision navigation field generating module; a steering force calculation unit; and a simulation generating unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것으로서, 3차원 가상공간에서 모델링된 적층식 다층 건물 모델 내부에 배치된 복수의 에이전트들이 해당 건물 모델의 출구 정보에 대응하도록 기설정된 목적지를 향해 이동하는 대피 동작을 시뮬레이션하는 3차원 가상 공간 기반의 군중 행동 시뮬레이션 장치에 있어서, 사용자로부터 상기 다층 건물 모델을 구성하는 복수의 정점들 중 어느 하나를 목적지 정점으로 선택 입력받는 목적지 입력부와, 상기 복수의 정점들에 대하여 기설정된 스칼라 기반 열전도량 함수에 기초한 열전도량을 부여할 때 임의의 정점과 상기 목적지 정점 간의 거리에 따른 스칼라장의 기울기를 나타내는 벡터장에 대응하는 목적지 유도장을 생성하는 목적지 유도장 생성부와, 상기 복수의 에이전트들이 상기 다층 건물 모델에 포함되는 서로 다른 방향의 법선벡터를 갖는 평면상에 배치될 때 상기 복수의 에이전트들 각각의 위치를 기준으로 인접한 적어도 하나의 상기 에이전트에 대하여 작용하는 척력힘에 따른 충돌 회피를 유도하기 위한 충돌 회피 유도장을 생성하는 충돌 회피 유도장 생성부와, 상기 목적지 유도장 및 상기 충돌 회피 유도장의 결합에 의해 상기 복수의 에이전트들에 대하여 작용하는 조종힘에 따라 상기 복수의 에이전트들이 상기 다층 건물 모델의 내부에서 상기 목적지를 향해 이동하는 동작에 대한 시뮬레이션 영상을 생성하는 시뮬레이션 생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라, 인적·물적 피해가 예상되는 긴급 재난상황에서의 개인 및 군중 특성에 따른 행동 예측 모델을 구축 및 훈련할 수 있어 예기치 못한 재난 발생으로 인한 피해와 손실을 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire warning network and emergency guidance system
abstract_en: A method and system of providing guidance and information to an end-user during an emergency situation. A network of one or more enrolled devices can obtain infrared data that will be used by the system to determine whether there is a high likelihood of a fire in a building. When an emergency situation such as a fire is detected, alerts can be generated at the enrolled devices that provide navigation cues based on user preferences and suggested evacuation routes to safely guide the end-user to the nearest designated exit.

title_en: A system and methods for guiding evacuation route based on artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 건축구조물 내의 최적 대피경로 안내시스템 및 안내방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for guiding an optimal evacuation path in a building structure based on artificial intelligence. More specifically, the system includes: an internal structure information acquisition part acquiring internal structure information of a building structure based on two-dimensional drawing information of the building structure; an occupant information acquisition part detecting or receiving location information of occupants scattered inside the building structure; a disaster occurrence monitoring part installed inside or outside the building structure to monitor disaster occurrence; a communication part transmitting/receiving the internal structure information of the building structure acquired by the internal structure information acquisition part, the occupant information acquired by the occupant information acquisition part, and a disaster occurrence signal acquired by the disaster occurrence monitoring part; an evacuation route information providing part formed to be installed in a plurality of places or to be carried such that the evacuation route information received through the communication part can be provided to the occupants or the occupants can request the evacuation route information in case of a disaster; and an evacuation route guide management part identifying the internal evacuation route of the building structure based on the information acquired by the internal structure information acquisition part and the occupant information acquisition part, and providing the optimal evacuation route to the evacuation route information providing part based on the disaster occurrence signal acquired through the disaster occurrence monitoring part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of helping the occupants to safely evacuate the building structure in case of a disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반 건축구조물 내의 최적 대피경로 안내시스템 및 안내방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 건축구조물의 2차원 도면정보를 토대로 건축 구조물의 내부 구조정보를 획득하는 건축구조물의 내부구조 정보획득부; 상기 건축구조물의 내부에 산재해 있는 재실자의 위치정보를 감지 또는 입력받는 재실자 정보획득부; 상기 건축구조물 실내외에 설치되어 재난발생을 감시하는 재난발생 감시부; 상기 건축구조물의 내부구조 정보획득부에서 획득된 건축구조물의 내부구조 정보와 재실자 정보획득부에서 획득된 재실자 정보 및 재난발생 감시부에서 획득된 재난발생 신호를 송/수신하는 통신부; 상기 통신부를 통해 수신된 정보를 상기 재실자에게 대피경로 정보를 제공하거나 재난 발생시 재실자가 대피경로 정보를 요청할 수 있도록 실내의 복수개소에 설치되거나 휴대 가능하도록 구성된 대피경로 정보제공부; 상기 건축구조물의 내부구조 정보획득부와, 재실자 정보획득부에서 획득된 정보를 토대로 건축구조물의 내부 대피경로를 파악하고, 상기 재난발생 감시부를 통해 획득된 재난발생 신호를 토대로 상기 대피경로 정보제공부로 최적 대피경로를 제공하는 대피경로 안내관리부를 포함한 구성으로 이루어진다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION OF GWANGJU UNIV;LABWORKS INC

title_en: Evacuation Route Guidance System and Evacuation Route Guidance Method
abstract_en: To provide a novel evacuation route guidance system and evacuation route guidance method capable of guiding evacuees having moved to a door on a floor leading to an evacuation exit of a staircase, to the evacuation exit without causing confusion.SOLUTION: An evacuation route guidance system 1 for guiding evacuees from a staircase 3 of evacuation stairs 4 of a building 2 to evacuation exits 7, the evacuation route guidance system 1 comprises a guide arrow 20 provided on an inner surface 8a facing the staircase 3 side, of a door 8 provided on a floor leading to an evacuation exit 7, of the staircase 3, and including a vertical line part 21 extending upward from a lower end of the door 8, and a horizontal line part 22 extending from an upper end of the vertical line part 21 toward a direction of the evacuation exit 7.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title_en: Control method and device for evacuation of fire disaster in park
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of fire evacuation and discloses a control method for evacuation of a park fire, which comprises the following steps: calling a three-dimensional model of the park under the condition that a fire signal is detected, and determining the position information of the fire; determining the area to be evacuated and the evacuation priority according to the position information of the fire and the three-dimensional model of the park; and planning an evacuation path of a corresponding evacuation area based on an improved A-based algorithm according to the order of the evacuation priorities from high to low. The method is based on a three-dimensional model to conduct optimal path planning on the multi-layer building. Meanwhile, the division of the evacuation area priority avoids the problem of reduced evacuation efficiency caused by rapid aggregation of short-time personnel. Realizing split-flow evacuation and ensuring the rationality and effectiveness of evacuation. The application also discloses a control device for park fire evacuation.
assignees: QINGDAO HAIER INTELLIGENT TECHNOLOGY RES & DEV CO LTD;HAIER SMART HOME CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for guiding evacuation route using information instrument and method thereof
title_ko: 정보단말기를 이용한 대피경로 안내장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus for providing guidance on an evacuation route by using an information terminal and a method thereof. The apparatus for providing guidance on an evacuation route by using an information terminal comprises: a fire detection unit detecting whether a fire has occurred and transmitting fire information; the information terminal installed in a building to display information; a storage unit storing an indoor map for the building in which the installation locations of the fire detection unit and the information terminal are registered; and a control unit determining the location in which the fire has occurred, from the indoor map stored in the storage unit when fire information is received from the fire detection unit, creating an evacuation route based on the installation location of the information terminal, and instructing the information terminal to display a display direction. Therefore, the apparatus not only provides a safe evacuation route but also increases the utilization of the information terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정보단말기를 이용한 대피경로 안내장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 정보단말기를 이용한 대피경로 안내장치는, 화재발생 여부를 감지하여 화재정보를 전송하는 화재감지부; 건물 내 설치되어 정보를 표출하는 정보단말기; 화재감지부와 정보단말기의 설치위치가 등록된 건물 내 실내지도를 저장하는 저장부; 및 화재감지부로부터 화재정보가 수신될 경우 저장부에 저장된 실내지도로부터 화재 발생위치를 결정한 후 정보단말기의 설치위치를 기반으로 대피로를 생성하여 정보단말기에 표시방향 표출을 명령하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a path planning method, a path planning device, path planning equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data analysis. The method comprises the following steps: if the dangerous event is triggered, determining dangerous area coordinate data of the dangerous event based on a building diagram of a target building; determining a plurality of evacuation areas corresponding to the dangerous event based on the dangerous area coordinate data and a preset area dividing mode; determining an evacuation geometric path based on the plurality of evacuation areas by adopting an optimal path generation algorithm; and performing risk assessment on each target evacuation area on the evacuation geometric path, and determining an assessment result of the evacuation geometric path. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device avoid the problem of accuracy of the generated evacuation path.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SUPCON INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Marine emergency evacuation voice communication broadcasting method based on beyond-visual-distance VHF technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore emergency evacuation voice communication broadcasting method based on a beyond visual range VHF technology, which comprises the following steps: receiving a target very high frequency signal of a VHF (very high frequency) on-water search and rescue base station based on an on-water search and rescue command center; transmitting the target very high frequency signal to a land dispatching center to obtain the position information of the ship; generating a real track curve of the ship navigation according to the position information; predicting the navigation trend of the ship based on the target fuzzy C-means clustering hidden Markov model, and generating a predicted track curve of the ship navigation; abnormal identification of vessel navigation is realized by judging the difference between the real track curve and the predicted track curve, and an identification result is obtained; and generating alarm information according to the identification result, and sending the alarm information to the ship based on the beyond visual range VHF technology to carry out emergency evacuation voice communication broadcasting. The invention realizes the remote communication between the ship and the land dispatching center, and greatly improves the quality of the transmission signals.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: System for guiding evacuation route
title_ko: 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for guiding an evacuation route, which can effectively send the evacuation route to an evacuee in case of a fire in a building and easily recognize the number of people remaining in the building. The system for guiding an evacuation route according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: fire detectors that are provided at a certain interval in a building; an evacuation guidance server that analyzes fire information detected by the fire detectors and then determines an evacuation route; and information display devices that are installed for each fire door, and display a direction of the evacuation route determined by the evacuation guidance server. In addition, the evacuation guidance server of the system for guiding an evacuation route according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a reception unit that receives fire information detected by the fire detectors; a route determination unit that analyzes the fire information received by the reception unit and then determines the evacuation route in a direction growing apart from the fire detector, by which the fire is detected, among the fire detectors; and a sending unit that sends the evacuation route determined by the route determination unit to the information display devices. The information display devices include a reception unit that receives the evacuation route sent by the evacuation guidance server, and an output unit that outputs a direction of the evacuation route received by the reception unit.
abstract_ko:
건물 내에 화재 발생시 대피자에게 효과적으로 대피 경로를 전달하고, 건물 내에 남아 있는 인원을 용이하게 파악할 수 있는 대피 경로 안내 시스템을 개시한다. 
실시예에 따른 대피 경로 안내 시스템은, 건물 내에 일정 간격으로 구비되는 화재감지기; 화재감지기에서 감지한 화재정보를 분석하여, 대피 경로를 결정하는 대피안내서버; 및 방화문마다 설치되고, 대피안내서버에서 결정한 대피 경로의 방향을 표시하는 정보표시장치;를 포함한다. 또한, 실시예에 따른 대피 경로 안내 시스템의 대피안내서버는, 화재감지기에서 감지한 화재정보를 수신하는 수신부, 수신부에서 수신한 화재정보를 분석하여, 화재감지기 중 화재가 감지된 화재감지기로부터 멀어지는 방향으로 대피 경로를 결정하는 경로결정부 및 경로결정부에서 결정한 대피 경로를 정보표시장치로 발신하는 발신부를 포함하고, 정보표시장치는 대피안내서버에서 발신한 대피 경로를 수신하는 수신부와 수신부에서 수신한 대피 경로의 방향을 출력하는 출력부를 포함한다.

title_en: Real-time fire detection and emergency evacuation route guidance system
title_ko: 실시간 화재 감지 및 비상대피로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time fire detection and emergency evacuation route guidance system. More specifically, the real-time fire detection and emergency evacuation route guidance system includes a fire detection sensor which detects fire in real time and emergency guidance lights which guide emergency evacuation routes. According to the present invention, it is possible to detect a fire situation in real time, including a fire detection sensor, and guide the optimal evacuation route by including emergency guidance lights which display various preset colors and directions.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 화재 감지 및 비상대피로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 실시간으로 화재를 감지하는 화재감지센서와 비상대피로를 안내하는 비상유도등을 포함하는 실시간 화재 감지 및 비상대피로 안내 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 본 발명에 따르면, 화재감지센서를 포함하여 실시간으로 화재 상황을 감지할 수 있고, 미리 설정된 다양한 색상과 방향을 표시하는 비상유도등을 포함하여 최적의 피난로를 안내할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, device, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for planning an emergency evacuation path, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an emergency evacuation network undirected graph according to the evacuation path; acquiring risk factors influencing the risk level of the evacuation path, and classifying each risk factor according to the potential injury degree of each risk factor to evacuees; wherein, different risk levels are set with corresponding risk indexes; according to the risk index and the emergency evacuation network undirected graph, a single-target path planning Model I considering the evacuation path risk level is constructed, and according to the emergency evacuation network undirected graph, a single-target path planning Model II considering the evacuation path length is constructed.

title_en: Fire-fighting intelligent positioning escape navigation method and system based on BIM model
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a fire-fighting intelligent positioning escape navigation method and a fire-fighting intelligent positioning escape navigation system for a BIM model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring BIM model information of a target building; judging whether the indoor structure information is in a basic structure shape, if not, dividing the indoor structure information into the basic structure shape, and determining a data set of the basic structure shape; acquiring the space type of a target building, determining the corresponding evacuation space level, and sequentially forming a building evacuation network according to the evacuation space level based on the data set of the indoor structural information; when a fire situation is detected, collecting current fire related information to construct a fire prediction diffusion model, and generating evacuation indexes of all outlets in a target building; and generating a corresponding optimal evacuation path by combining the evacuation indexes of the building evacuation network and each outlet and the position information of the personnel to be evacuated. By adopting the method, the personnel to be evacuated can be ensured to synthesize the actual condition of the building and the actual condition of the fire disaster, and the safest and rapid evacuation path can be determined.
assignees: WUHAN ZHENGYUAN ROCK SOIL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crowd emergency evacuation path planning method for large-scale stadium
abstract_en: The crowd emergency evacuation path planning method for the large-scale stadium comprises the following steps: (1) Realizing automatic identification and labeling of stadium targets based on a convolutional neural network, and constructing scene information; (2) Then, a crowd simulation technology based on density driving is used for obtaining stadium personnel distribution conditions; (3) And finally, determining the evacuation path of the personnel in each area based on a path planning algorithm of the crowd density. The invention realizes the functions of disaster detection, disaster distribution display, crowd evacuation obstacle avoidance, rescue scheme decision and the like by carrying out scientific detection and comprehensive analysis on real-time data such as crowd density, building topography, exit distribution and the like. The invention has the advantages that: when dangerous situations occur, the optimal evacuation path can be quickly found; the scientificity and intuitiveness are good, and the use and the operation are easy; the staff can completely simulate the whole evacuation process and is familiar with the disaster prevention emergency flow so as to grasp stadium information, thereby immediately reacting when the disaster occurs.

title_en: Evacuation Simulation Module
abstract_en: Technology is disclosed for systems and methods for an Evacuation Simulation module generates vehicle trip time and time-series road congestion metrics for vehicles in hypothetical evacuation scenarios. The outputs of the module can be used to understand total clearance time for a neighborhood or region, choke points and areas of worst congestion, individual vehicle routes and trip times, and effects of scenario constraints and mitigation efforts such as road closures, notification urgency, evacuation sequencing, and contraflow. The module contains a large number of input parameters and utilizes high granularity data to model a wide range of specific evacuation scenarios. The model utilizes a novel approach to calculating traffic congestion and a novel application of AI methodology to incorporate human input into the workings of the model.
assignees: KYLE BOWEN;ZLIMAN LEO;ZLIMEN IGOR;LADRIS TECH INC

title_en: Urban mass transit comprehensive passenger network emergency evacuation path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city group comprehensive passenger transport network emergency evacuation path planning method, which comprises the following steps: step 1: constructing a city group comprehensive passenger transport network model; step 2, urban mass comprehensive passenger transport network evacuation phase division; and 3, solving the urban comprehensive passenger transport network emergency evacuation planning problem by using an ant colony algorithm. The invention has the advantages that: when modeling, the urban traffic condition is considered, so that the constructed urban comprehensive passenger transport network model is more in line with the actual traffic network form; dividing the evacuation process into stages, researching travel characteristics and conditions of each stage, and establishing a complete evacuation process from self-generation to dissipation; when the heuristic function of the ant colony algorithm is constructed, the dynamic heuristic function is set according to the travel conditions of different evacuated people, so that the efficiency and the authenticity of the simulation operation are improved.

title_en: Emergency vehicle road congestion evacuation system based on Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban public safety, and particularly relates to an emergency vehicle road congestion evacuation system based on the Internet of vehicles; the method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data acquisition module, a congestion detection module, a path planning module, a traffic police dispatch module and a facility dispatch module; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring road condition information, traffic police information and facility information; the congestion detection module is used for judging whether the road is in a congestion state according to the road condition information; the path planning module is used for constructing a road congestion optimal route according to road condition information and traffic police information when the road is in a congestion state; solving the problem of the optimal route of road congestion to obtain a traffic police dispatching scheme; the traffic police dispatch module is used for carrying out traffic police dispatch according to a traffic police dispatch scheme; the facility scheduling module is used for carrying out facility scheduling according to the road condition information and the facility information, so that the efficiency of emergency tasks of emergency vehicles can be improved, and the probability of tragedy caused by untimely tasks due to congestion is greatly reduced.

title_en: Passenger flow intelligent evacuation lamplight guiding system and method under smoke condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passenger flow intelligent evacuation lamplight guiding system and method under a smoke condition, and belongs to the field of subway station emergency evacuation guiding. The method comprises the steps that under the smoke condition, a monitoring terminal monitors smoke concentration data and pedestrian density data of different areas in a subway station hall, a path planning terminal performs grid division on the subway station hall according to lamp distribution of the subway station hall, at least one lamp is arranged in each grid, the smoke concentration data and the pedestrian density data of different areas correspond to the grids, and then an optimal evacuation path is planned according to the smoke concentration data and the pedestrian density data in each grid, and a lamplight guiding terminal displays the optimal evacuation path through a lamplight illumination system. According to the invention, by combining the passenger flow and fire disaster factors, an optimal path is generated according to smoke and congestion indexes, and the existing lamplight illumination system is utilized to realize evacuation guidance under the smoke condition.

title_en: Emergency evacuation monitoring management system based on data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation monitoring management system based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of monitoring management and is used for solving the problems of emergency evacuation path planning and evacuation route congestion, and comprises an acquisition module, a server, an evacuation module, an analysis module, a diversion module, an alarm module and a registration login module; generating a plurality of emergency evacuation routes by using the obtained three-dimensional modeling diagram of the mall and taking the place of occurrence of the accident as a starting place mall outlet as a destination, analyzing the path pedestrian flow of each emergency evacuation path to obtain a plurality of optimal paths, reminding people to evacuate through the most appropriate emergency evacuation path for the first time, improving the personnel evacuation efficiency and safety under the emergency condition, and reducing casualties and property loss; meanwhile, the guide lamps on the path are subjected to flashing attenuation according to the distance between the guide lamps and the accident place, so that people to be evacuated are prompted to be in a safer position at the moment, and the panic emotion of the people is visually reduced.
assignees: HONGWEI SMART TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Fire detection and evacuation system using route search algorithm
title_ko: 경로 탐색 알고리즘을 이용한 화재 감지 및 대피 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire detection and evacuation system using a route search algorithm. More specifically, the fire detection and evacuation system using a route search algorithm comprises: a detection unit consisting of one to a plurality of sensors installed in each of a plurality of zones divided inside a building; an information processing unit which receives and collects disaster situation information from the detection unit; a server which receives the information from the information processing unit and manages a disaster situation as a whole; a database which stores spatial information such as a drawing of the building, the location of the detection unit, and the location of disaster preparedness supplies; a dedicated application which is installed in a terminal of a user and transmits and receives the disaster situation information to and from the server; and a communication module unit which forms a wireless communication network between the detection unit, the information processing unit, the server, and the terminal. According to the present invention, it is possible to forcibly transmit an alert to a dedicated application of a user terminal from a web application server (WAS) in the case of a fire or disaster.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경로 탐색 알고리즘을 이용한 화재 감지 및 대피 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 자세하게는 건물 내부에 구획된 복수 개의 구역마다 1개 내지 복수 개로 설치되는 센서로 구성되는 감지부, 상기 감지부로부터 재난 상황 정보를 수신하여 수집하는 정보처리부, 상기 정보처리부로부터 정보를 수신하며 재난 상황 전반에 대한 관리를 수행하는 서버, 건물의 도면, 상기 감지부의 위치 및 재난대비용품의 위치와 같은 공간정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스, 사용자의 단말기에 설치되어 재난 상황 정보를 상기 서버와 상호 송수신하는 전용 애플리케이션, 상기 감지부, 상기 정보처리부, 상기 서버 및 상기 단말기 간의 무선 통신망을 형성하는 통신모듈부로 구성되는 경로 탐색 알고리즘을 이용한 화재 감지 및 대피 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: HEO SUNG GANG;KIM YONG KI;KIM CHAN HYEOK;LEE JONG MIN;CHOI JONG O

title_en: System and method of evacuation route guidance for emergency using nfc
title_ko: Nfc를 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An emergency evacuation route guidance system and method using NFC are disclosed. The present invention may include: a sensing part that senses information to determine an emergency situation; a computing device that generates disaster information based on the information; an NFC tag device that includes a URL code for the disaster information from the computing device; and a user terminal that receives a URL code from the NFC tag device.
abstract_ko: NFC를 이용한 비상 대피로 안내 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은 비상 상황을 판단하기 위한 정보를 센싱하는 센싱부, 상기 정보를 기초로 재난 정보를 생성하는 컴퓨팅 장치, 상기 컴퓨팅 장치로부터 상기 재난 정보에 대한 URL 코드를 포함하는 NFC 태그 장치 및 상기 NFC 태그 장치로부터 상기 URL 코드를 수신하는 사용자 단말을 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV DONG EUI IND ACAD COOP FOUND

title_en: Systems and methods of guidance on the escape route in a fire
title_ko: 화재발생 탈출경로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system that guides a safe escape route in case of a fire. The system according to the invention includes a speaker system. The speaker system guides the escape route through a main server including a temperature sensor and a guidance module. Therefore, the system can guide an optimal escape route.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재발생시 안전한 탈출경로를 안내하는 시스템에 대한 것이다. 
[색인어] 
이동통신 단말기, 온도감지 센서, 화재피난처 DB, 탈출경로 안내 모듈, 비상구 탈출경로 안내 디스플레이, 스피커

title_en: Pedestrian dynamic evacuation method and system based on social force model and path finding algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pedestrian dynamic evacuation method and system based on a social force model and a path finding algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring emergency information and corresponding event parameters of a target area; determining obstacle information and space information in the target area according to the Navmash model of the target area and a collision body detection algorithm; determining a plurality of possible evacuation routes in the target area according to a social force model and a dynamic route finding algorithm, and the obstacle information and the space information; and determining an optimal evacuation route from the plurality of possible evacuation routes according to the neural network model and the event parameters. Therefore, the invention can determine a plurality of candidate routes through the social force model and the dynamic route finding algorithm, and then determine the optimal route through the neural network, thereby effectively improving the accuracy and the effectiveness of the final route, improving the evacuation efficiency and the evacuation effect of people and reducing casualties.
assignees: GUANGDONG NORMAL UNIV WEIZHI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation guiding system based on state time sequence evaluation and using method
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of computer simulation, and particularly relates to a crowd evacuation guiding system based on state time sequence evaluation and a using method thereof; constructing evacuation scene information and navigation points, randomly generating pedestrians in the scene, and storing initial pedestrian evacuation state information; pedestrians start to evacuate and move towards the exit, the pedestrians can receive evacuation guiding paths from a system guiding strategy in the evacuation process, and the evacuation paths with higher evacuation efficiency are pushed; the guiding module in the simulation system is to establish a connection between the saturation of the navigation points and the selection probability of the navigation points by taking the saturation of the navigation points as an input BP neural network, evaluate the guiding strategy at the previous moment by establishing a state time sequence evaluation model of the saturation of the navigation points, and optimize the evacuation guiding strategy by utilizing TD errors to generate the selection probability of the navigation points which is more favorable for evacuation until evacuation is completed.

title_en: High-rise fire-fighting rapid escape system
abstract_en: The application provides a high-rise fire-fighting rapid escape system, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting escape systems. The high-rise fire-fighting rapid escape system comprises an equipment distribution control system, wherein the equipment distribution control system is connected with a fire alarm system, the fire alarm system is connected with an evacuation indication system, the evacuation indication system is connected with a channel control system, the channel control system is connected with an evacuation guiding system, the evacuation guiding system is connected with an equipment prompt system, and the equipment prompt system is connected with an emergency collecting system. The escape route can be calculated for the user when the user is at the node position, and the optimal route is selected in real time according to actual conditions and requirements, so that the calculated result route is more effective and safer, and the model is simplified when the model is calculated, the reading is convenient, the calculation efficiency is improved, and the escape success rate is finally improved.

title_en: Method and device for planning emergency evacuation path of mail wheel
abstract_en: The application provides a mail wheel emergency evacuation path planning method, which comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional model of the postal wheel based on the structural parameters of the postal wheel; determining an evacuation topological graph based on the three-dimensional model of the mailbox, and determining at least two influencing factors influencing the time of passing by the passable road section; obtaining simulation accident parameters; determining an influence degree value of any influence factor based on the simulation accident parameters; determining the weight of the influence degree value of any influence factor based on a preset evaluation model, carrying out weighted summation on the weight of the influence degree value of at least two influence factors, and taking the weighted summation value as the evacuation weight value of the corresponding side of the evacuation topological graph; based on a preset path planning algorithm, taking an initial node where a person is located as a departure point, taking a preset exit node as an end point, and selecting an evacuation weight and a minimum passable road section from an evacuation topological graph as an optimal path. The application can effectively improve the safety of the escape of the mail wheels and the efficiency of the escape of the personnel under the sudden fire accident.

title_en: Disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, system and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning method, a disaster avoidance path dynamic planning system and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first position and a second position in a digital twin space corresponding to a target place; taking the first position as a starting point and the second position as an ending point, and carrying out path planning based on the passing cost of the sub-path between the first position and the second position to obtain the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths; a target path is determined among the plurality of candidate paths based on the traffic cost for each candidate path. The distance of each candidate path and the influence degree of each candidate path on safety accidents are comprehensively considered, and the time spent and the risk faced by different candidate paths are weighed based on the passing cost of a plurality of candidate paths, so that a target path which accords with the actual production operation environment is dynamically planned, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the casualties are reduced.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE SHANGHAI INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD;CMIM NETWORK CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle guiding method, device, equipment, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle guiding method, a device, equipment, terminal equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of Internet of vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a lane danger avoiding request sent by a target vehicle; acquiring state information of a first escape route in front of at least one target vehicle in the running direction according to the real-time position information and the running direction of the target vehicle; determining danger avoiding guide information according to the lane danger avoiding request and the state information of at least one first danger avoiding lane, wherein the danger avoiding guide information comprises navigation information of the target vehicle driving to a target danger avoiding lane, and the target danger avoiding lane is the danger avoiding lane in the first danger avoiding lane; and sending the risk avoidance guiding information to the target vehicle. According to the scheme, the problem that after the vehicle brake fails, a driver cannot easily determine the specific position of the escape route or cannot determine whether the escape route is occupied, so that the driver misses the opportunity of escaping through the escape route is solved.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE IOT CO LTD;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Mine fire escape real-time dynamic path planning method based on bidirectional A-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine safety emergency, in particular to a mine fire escape real-time dynamic path planning method based on a bidirectional A-algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, determining underground ignition points and fire spreading directions based on roadway topology data and wind speed and direction sensor data; s2, determining the equivalent length of the roadway based on the roadway type, the gradient, the local obstacle, the wind speed and the wind direction; s3, determining the passing time and the fire spreading time of each roadway according to the equivalent length of the roadway, the fire spreading speed and the personnel escape speed; s4, determining an optimal escape route based on a bidirectional A-type algorithm according to the current underground personnel position, the equivalent roadway length, the carbon monoxide content, the gas content, the transit time of each roadway personnel and the fire spreading time. The method combines static and dynamic parameters, performs forward and reverse search simultaneously based on a bidirectional A-x algorithm, selects a search direction in time, reduces a search range, and plans an optimal escape path.
assignees: TIANDI CHANGZHOU AUTOMATION CO;CHANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP CORP

title_en: Special vehicle dispatching method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a special vehicle dispatching method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, so as to solve the problem that a special vehicle cannot reach a destination at the fastest speed, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when an emergency task is received, acquiring position information of a destination; calculating a recommended route reaching a destination under the current condition; dividing the recommended route according to the regions, transmitting route data of each region to a corresponding edge data center, enabling each edge data center to acquire a possibly evacuated congestion road section in the region, calculating the running time of the congestion road section after congestion evacuation, and uploading the running time to a central server; recalculating the optimal route and arrival time to the destination according to the travel time of each congestion road section after congestion and evacuation uploaded by the centers of the edge data; determining whether to evacuate the congested road segment; if so, evacuating the congested road section and enabling the special vehicle to reach the destination through the optimal route. The present disclosure may shorten the time for a special vehicle to reach a destination.

title_en: Method and apparatus for searching pedestrian path on the shortest distance algorithm using map api
title_ko: 맵 api를 이용한 최단 거리 알고리즘 기반 보행자 경로 탐색 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and an apparatus for searching for a pedestrian path based on a shortest distance algorithm using a map application programming interface (API) to reduce the loss of lives in flooding or disasters. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus for searching for a pedestrian path based on a shortest distance algorithm using a map API comprises: a communication module communicating with a user terminal; a database storing data associated with pedestrian path search operations based on a shortest distance algorithm using a map API; a memory storing one or more programs; and a processor executing the stored one or more programs. The processor can search for a shortest path by using a map API and a shortest distance algorithm in a preset area, store the searched shortest path in the database, search for an evacuation path to a shortest-path shelter based on the current location of the user terminal based on the shortest path stored in the database if an evacuation situation occurs, and provide the searched evacuation path for the user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 맵 API를 이용한 최단 거리 알고리즘 기반 보행자 경로 탐색 방법 및 장치에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 맵 API를 이용한 최단 거리 알고리즘 기반 보행자 경로 탐색 장치는, 사용자 단말과 통신하는 통신 모듈; 맵 API를 이용한 최단 거리 알고리즘 기반 보행자 경로 탐색 동작과 관련된 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스; 하나 이상의 프로그램을 저장하는 메모리; 및 상기 저장된 하나 이상의 프로그램을 실행하는 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 기 설정된 지역에서 최단 거리 알고리즘 및 맵 API(Application Programming Interface)를 이용하여 최단 경로를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 최단 경로를 데이터베이스에 저장하고, 대피 상황이 발생한 경우, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 최단 경로를 기반으로 사용자 단말의 현재 위치를 기준으로 최단 경로의 대피소까지 대피 경로를 탐색하고, 상기 탐색된 대피 경로를 사용자 단말에 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: PAICHAI UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method for highway tunnel fire disaster growth period
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel evacuation path planning method for a highway tunnel fire disaster growth period, which establishes a highway tunnel fire disaster growth period smoke disaster-causing database; obtaining a highway tunnel grid map, and planning nodes in the grid map; importing database data into a grid map, adding disaster-causing grids into the grid map to realize personnel evacuation path planning in a highway tunnel fire disaster growth period, and constructing a highway tunnel fire disaster evacuation environment model; initializing an ant colony algorithm, determining node positions and calculating equivalent lengths according to personnel evacuation path planning in a fire disaster growth period, starting iteration and searching evacuation paths, starting the next iteration to the maximum iteration times, and outputting an optimal evacuation path; and obtaining a final evacuation path. The method adopts the steps, utilizes the real-time smoke disaster-causing data in the tunnel in the database to perform grid transformation, can comprehensively adjust and implement the evacuation strategy in real time in combination with the tunnel fire disaster development condition, remarkably enhances the timeliness of the whole planning process, and makes the path planning more reasonable.

title_en: Subway station safety evacuation path planning method considering fire spread and personnel position
abstract_en: Urban subways become one of urban irreplaceable public transportation means, but most lines and stations of subways are sealed underground, and once a fire disaster occurs in a subway station, the environment is sealed, personnel are crowded, people are easy to evacuate difficultly due to panic, and personal injury and property loss are caused. Therefore, the application provides a subway station safe evacuation path planning method considering fire spread and personnel positions, which comprises the following steps: according to the layout and the space structure in the subway station, the environmental information near the ignition point and the personnel position information in the subway station are acquired when a fire disaster occurs, the flame spreading situation and the smoke spreading process are simulated through FDS fire dynamics software, then the fire disaster simulation result and the personnel position information are combined, the improved Dijkstra algorithm is used for path planning, and then the safety evacuation path is dynamically optimized according to the real-time personnel distribution information and the real-time crowding degree information of the safety evacuation path during personnel evacuation, so that the safety and high efficiency of the personnel evacuation process are realized.
assignees: SMART TRANSP RESEARCH BRANCH ZHEJIANG COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;UNIV JILIANG CHINA

title_en: Urban rail security emergency treatment and emergency navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city rail security emergency treatment and emergency navigation system and method, a knowledge information database constructed by basic data of city rail traffic security emergency treatment is provided with a scene recognition module, an AR navigation module, an object recognition module and the like, when a security event occurs, a user uploads a picture in a photographing mode, the scene/object recognition module recognizes the picture, and when a corresponding security event background is detected, the knowledge information database is called, and security event risk avoidance knowledge is actively pushed; meanwhile, real-time interaction of AR navigation can be realized, an AR navigation function is started by a user in a scene, and a real-time interaction emergency escape route is given by a background aiming at user positioning information; the invention takes a picture through the mobile phone APP by the public, rapidly and easily obtains the related knowledge of emergency avoidance of the corresponding scene, and simultaneously provides disaster real-time information and on-site evacuation guidance to provide auxiliary support for emergency disposal of staff.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency evacuation two-dimensional code system with positioning function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency evacuation two-dimensional code system with a positioning function, and belongs to the technical field of fire-fighting systems. A fire-fighting emergency evacuation two-dimensional code system with a positioning function comprises a two-dimensional code generation module, a fire-fighting plan database, a positioning navigation module, an emergency alarm module and a background management module. According to the method, the real-time evacuation dynamic diagram is generated through dynamic display, so that people with codes can know the flow of people with various safety exits, evacuation channels and avoidance difficulties in real time, evacuation people can conveniently and accurately select escape routes in combination with positioning navigation, the probability of road congestion and people trampling is reduced, the evacuation two-dimensional codes provide emergency electric energy and emergency charging ports, wiFi signals for reinforcing the repeater are carried, the problem that people with codes cannot be evacuated due to the fact that mobile phones are not powered and no signals are available is solved, and the fault tolerance of scanning the evacuation two-dimensional codes is effectively improved.
assignees: DONGYING PENGZHAN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency lamp for indicating rescue, fire-fighting emergency method and fire-fighting emergency system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency lamp for indicating rescue, a fire-fighting emergency method and a fire-fighting emergency system, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency, wherein the fire-fighting emergency lamp for indicating rescue comprises a shell, a display module, a control circuit module, a power supply module and a substrate, wherein the display module, the control circuit module and the power supply module are respectively packaged on the substrate; the power supply module is respectively connected with the display module and the control circuit module to respectively supply power to the display module and the control circuit module; the display module comprises a direction indicating unit and a rescue indicating unit, the direction indicating unit is used for indicating the evacuation route, the rescue indicating unit is used for indicating the rescue route, the control circuit module is respectively connected with the direction indicating unit and the rescue indicating unit, and the control circuit module is used for receiving the control signal and respectively driving the direction indicating unit and the rescue indicating unit according to the control signal. By adopting the invention, the route guidance can be carried out on trapped people and rescue workers at the same time, and the evacuation and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Escape route planning method, escape route planning device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an escape path planning method, a device and a storage medium, and a site node diagram is constructed, wherein each node in the site node diagram is each intersection and outlet of a fire site; dividing the site node map according to the position of the trapped crowd in the site node map and the characteristics of the trapped crowd to obtain a plurality of node map areas; determining the node map region that matches the trapped population; and planning escape paths in the node graph area corresponding to the trapped crowd. The calculation amount and calculation time of the fire escape path planning are reduced, and the instantaneity, scientificity, rationality and accuracy of the escape path planning are improved.
assignees: NANJING SHENYE INTELLIGENT SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: Smart fire alarm system
title_ko: 스마트 화재발생 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire alarm system, and more specifically, to a smart fire alarm system having an evacuation route guidance and escape auxiliary function through a fire alarm application installed in a wireless communication device of a user upon occurrence of a fire, in which the smart fire alarm system comprises: a fire detector installed on a wall portion of each floor of a building and including a sensing unit for detecting the fire; a signal receiver communicatively connected to the fire detector, and configured to receive a fire detection signal from the sensing unit to transmit the received fire detection signal to an IoT communication module; a server configured to receive the fire detection signal received by the IoT communication module to provide a fire alarm service to the wireless communication device; and a fire alarm application installed in the wireless communication device and executing the fire alarm service provided from the server, wherein, when the fire occurs, the fire alarm transmits a fire occurrence push alarm to an upper end of the wireless communication device, and when the fire occurrence push alarm is clicked, a map of a corresponding floor on which a fire occurrence area is displayed is output to display an evacuation route, and when a user sets an evacuation start point within the map, different routes are displayed for each set person in order to prevent confusion due to crowding among users.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 화재발생 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 화재발생 시 사용자의 무선통신기기에 설치되는 화재알림 어플리케이션을 통하여 대피로 안내 및 탈출 보조 기능을 구비한 스마트 화재발생 알림 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물 각 층의 벽면부에 설치되며, 화재를 감지하는 센싱부를 포함하는 화재감지기; 상기 화재감지기와 통신 연결되고, 상기 센싱부로부터 화재감지 신호를 수신받아 IoT 통신모듈로 전달하는 신호수신기; 상기 IoT 통신모듈이 전달받은 화재감지 신호를 전달받아 화재발생 알림 서비스를 무선통신기기에 제공하는 서버; 상기 무선통신기기에 설치되고, 상기 서버로부터 제공되는 화재발생 알림 서비스가 실행되는 화재알림 어플리케이션;을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 화재알림 어플리케이션은, 화재발생 시 상기 무선통신기기 상단에 화재발생 푸쉬알림을 발송하고, 상기 화재발생 푸쉬알림을 클릭하면 화재발생 구역이 표시되는 해당 층의 지도가 출력되어 대피로를 표시하되, 사용자가 상기 지도 내에서 대피 시작지점을 설정하면 사용자 간 밀집에 의한 혼선이 유발되지 않도록 설정 인원별로 다른 대피로가 표시되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Fire early warning and escape path planning method and system based on intelligent construction
abstract_en: The application belongs to the field of intelligent construction, and particularly relates to a fire early warning and escape path planning method and system based on intelligent construction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a BIM model, extracting a three-dimensional structure diagram of a building and a smoke alarm installation number; acquiring smoke concentration based on a smoke alarm; judging whether the smoke concentration is larger than a preset threshold value or not; if the smoke concentration is greater than a preset threshold value, generating alarm information and acquiring the number of the smoke alarm; acquiring a fire position based on the smoke alarm number and the BIM; judging whether the fire variation trend is gradually enhanced; if the fire variation trend is gradually enhanced, predicting the fire spreading direction and acquiring the personnel position; based on the fire position, the fire spreading direction, the personnel position and the three-dimensional structure diagram, the escape route of personnel is planned. The application has the effect of providing the optimal escape route when a fire disaster occurs and enabling personnel in the building to evacuate rapidly.
assignees: Beijing urban construction group co ltd

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a device for planning an emergency evacuation path and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an initial path for personnel evacuation based on a preset evacuation network comprising evacuation nodes and evacuation edges; acquiring environment information of a real-time disaster area; judging whether the initial path is affected by disaster or not based on the real-time disaster area environment information; when the initial path is affected by disaster, obtaining a disaster affected area on the initial path, and determining feasible paths from adjacent evacuation nodes of a surrounding target area of the disaster affected area to exit evacuation nodes; and based on the feasible paths, carrying out replacement updating on the initial paths to obtain optimized paths. When a sudden accident occurs, the application can dynamically update and optimize the evacuation path of the personnel, and improve the safety of the escape of the mail wheels and the evacuation efficiency of the personnel under the sudden accident.

title_en: Information intelligent association method and system for evacuation indicator lamp and emergency evacuation system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent information association method and system for evacuation indicator lamps and an emergency evacuation system, which relate to the technical field of intelligent evacuation, and the intelligent data association algorithm for the evacuation indicator lamps and the emergency evacuation system is designed according to two different data importing conditions so as to ensure that the position and arrangement sequence of each evacuation indicator lamp, the affiliated road and the position and area of each evacuation indicator lamp are actually consistent; the method for automatically binding the evacuation indicator lamps and the evacuation communication gateway greatly improves the intelligent degree of the emergency evacuation system and the practicability, convenience and adaptability of deployment and use. In addition, when an accident or emergency exercise occurs, the evacuation indicator lamp automatically calculates the correct indication direction (left flashing, right flashing and double flashing) according to the evacuation direction of the current binding path provided by the emergency evacuation scheme, so that people are guided to evacuate orderly and rapidly according to the optimal route, and the personnel safety is ensured.

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system for the visually impaired
title_ko: 시각장애인을 위한 대피로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guide system for the visually handicapped, capable of guiding the nonhandicapped as well as the visually handicapped to quickly evacuate the scene of a fire by providing a guide for an evacuation route in a building, and, in particular, applying a control force when a visually handicapped person is trying to walk to a fire occurrence spot, thereby guiding the visually handicapped person to safely evacuate to the other side of the fire occurrence spot. In accordance with the present invention, the evacuation route guide system for the visually handicapped includes: an entry/exit guide part installed on a wall, and having a plurality of protruding guide holes formed at regular intervals along a passage direction on a surface facing a passage; a guide part housed in each of the protruding guide holes, and, when rotated by a predetermined angle in a normal or reverse direction, having a predetermined area protruding to the outside of the protruding guide holes while forming a structure inclined to one side or the other side, guiding people in a direction for evacuation; and a rotation drive part installed in the entry/exit guide part, and rotating the guide part by a predetermined angle when receiving an emergency occurrence signal, wherein the guide part is rotated such that the guide part can guide the people to the other side of an emergency occurrence spot.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시각장애인을 위한 대피로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건축물의 내부에 대피로를 안내하는 가이드를 제공하여 일반인과 시각장애인 모두가 화재현장을 신속하게 대피하도록 가이드해줄 수 있고, 특히, 시각장애인이 화재발생지점으로 이동하려고 할 경우 억제력을 부여하여, 화재발생지점의 반대 방향으로 안전하게 대피하도록 가이드해줄 수 있도록 함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따른 시각장애인을 위한 대피로 안내 시스템은, 벽체에 설치되며, 복도를 향하는 면에 다수개의 돌출가이드홀이 복도 방향을 따라 일정간격으로 형성된 인출입가이드부; 상기 돌출가이드홀에 각각 수용되며, 정방향 또는 역방향으로 소정각도로 회전될 시, 일측 또는 타측 방향으로 경사진 구조를 이루면서 일정영역이 상기 돌출가이드홀의 외부로 돌출되어 사람을 대피방향으로 가이드 할 수 있는 가이드부; 및 상기 인출입가이드부에 설치되고, 비상상황 발생신호를 수신할 시 상기 가이드부를 소정각도로 회전작동시키되, 상기 가이드부가 비상상황이 발생된 지점의 반대 방향으로 가이드할 수 있도록 회전작동 시키는 회전구동부를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for planning an emergency evacuation path. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current accident description information and current traffic conditions in a target park; determining a current danger level area in a target park according to the current accident description information, the pre-built park space node network and a pre-set accident result analysis model; determining an evacuation object and an evacuation starting point according to the current traffic condition and the current danger level area; and determining a target evacuation path starting from an evacuation starting point for the evacuation object through a preset path planning algorithm. The technical scheme of the invention provides a novel emergency evacuation path planning method, which combines the actual conditions of an intelligent chemical industry park, relies on an industrial Internet platform to monitor data in real time, and performs dynamic analysis according to the situation development to obtain reasonable evacuation decisions suitable for the chemical industry park, so as to improve the evacuation effect.
assignees: COOS HUAZHI IOT TECH QINGDAO CO LTD;COOS INDUSTRIAL INTELLIGENT RES INSTITUTE QINGDAO CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation system for new energy vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a new energy vehicle emergency evacuation system which comprises a charging module, a lithium battery module and an SMP monitoring module. According to the invention, the lithium battery module at the bottom of the new energy vehicle is monitored in real time through the infrared imager and the very early gas detector on the vehicle loading platform, monitoring information is transmitted to the central processing unit in the SMP monitoring module through the transmission unit to carry out data analysis, comparison and processing, when the central processing unit monitors that the data information is abnormal, a signal is transmitted to a client mobile phone or a computer client and the like through the network transmission module to remind a client, an audible and visual alarm is started to remind surrounding people to evacuate, meanwhile, the central processing unit transmits the signal to the control unit, and the control unit controls the driving unit to drive the vehicle loading platform to leave the new energy vehicle indoors according to a route set by the navigation module and carry the new energy vehicle to an outdoor parking area, so that the new energy vehicle is prevented from spontaneous combustion when being charged in an indoor parking lot or a private garage to cause fire disaster, and economic loss caused by the fire disaster is avoided.
assignees: SHANGHAI BM ASSEMBLY ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an evacuation path planning method, apparatus, device, and storage medium, the method comprising: acquiring current position information; based on the position information, acquiring information of surrounding environment from a database updated in real time, wherein the information of the surrounding environment comprises road network information, disaster avoidance facility information, regional risk level and distance from the nearest disaster avoidance facility; based on the information of the surrounding environment and a pre-trained deep reinforcement learning model, determining an evacuation path in the range of the surrounding environment, wherein the evacuation path is at least a partial path from the current position to the nearest disaster avoidance facility. According to the method and the system, the evacuation path in the range of the surrounding environment is obtained by obtaining the information of the surrounding environment and utilizing the deep reinforcement learning model, the evacuation path can be planned according to the information of the surrounding environment which changes in real time, so that the evacuation path is adaptive to the current situation, and evacuation personnel can complete evacuation by utilizing the information in the range of the visual field under the guidance of the evacuation path.
assignees: UNIV SHENZHEN;SHENZHEN OCEAN DEVELOPMENT RES PROMOTION CENTER SHENZHEN OCEAN MONITORING AND FORECASTING CENTER

title_en: Layered passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation method considering deadline and congestion relief
abstract_en: The invention discloses a layered passenger ship personnel emergency evacuation method considering deadline and congestion relief, which comprises the following steps: establishing a global navigation feature map model according to the internal structure of the ship and the pedestrian moving speed of each passing area in the ship; generating a global reference path according to the global navigation feature map model; constructing an emergency evacuation decision model; training an emergency evacuation decision model based on reinforcement learning by using a training mechanism of the reinforcement learning algorithm and combining a characteristic extraction network frame; on the basis of an emergency evacuation decision model, a layered emergency evacuation decision logic combining global planning and local guiding is formed, and passenger and ship personnel are evacuated according to the logic. The invention has the advantages of low cost, high efficiency and high flexibility.

title_en: Safe navigation method and system for AI (advanced technology attachment) internet of things tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic safety facilities, and discloses a safe navigation method and a safe navigation system for an AI (advanced technology attachment) internet of things tunnel, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating the illumination attenuation coefficient in the tunnel, and determining the visibility in the tunnel; calculating the radiation intensity of a light source in the tunnel, and calculating the brightness value of the tunnel; shooting traffic images in the tunnel in real time, and analyzing traffic flow in the tunnel; setting early warning prompt information corresponding to the tunnel; calculating the concentration of air substances in the tunnel, and setting an evacuation guiding mark in the tunnel according to the concentration of the air substances; a secure navigation scheme within the tunnel is created. The invention aims to improve the safe navigation efficiency of the tunnel.

title_en: Intelligent guiding system and method combined with digital signage
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent guiding system and method combined with a digital signage, and belongs to the technical field of accident emergency treatment. The system comprises a perception terminal, a computing terminal and a guiding module. The perception terminal is used for collecting evacuation data in the digital twin factory. The guiding module establishes connection with a plurality of digital signage and controls the change of the display content thereof. The computing terminal evaluates road safety indexes related to the evacuation routes based on the evacuation data sent by the sensing terminal and plans a plurality of evacuation routes. The guiding module displays a plurality of evacuation routes in the form of digital signage according to the road safety index provided by the computing terminal and the current position of the trapped person. Based on the virtual reality technology, the invention utilizes an intelligent algorithm and a perception terminal to acquire the information of the related environment and crowd, thereby providing the guided optimal route. According to the invention, various guiding route information is displayed through the digital signage of the virtual scene, so that people are guided to evacuate rapidly, and evacuation efficiency and security are improved.

title_en: Intelligent fire scene fire rescue system and control method
abstract_en: An intelligent fire scene fire rescue system and a control method belong to the field of fire rescue, and an individual soldier system comprises a sensor module, a data exchange module and an individual soldier control module; the data exchange module and the individual control module are provided with a quick socket and a wireless module which are connected with the sensor module and are used for connecting various sensors; the data exchange module, the individual control module and the power supply of the individual system are arranged between two layers of base plates on the base frame, the two layers of base plates play a role in protection, and damage to the equipment in the rescue process is prevented; the base frame is also provided with a supporting frame, a sensor base frame and a brace which are connected with the fire-fighting equipment; the braces are internally provided with data transmission antennas for data transmission; the back belt is provided with a connector for installing various temporary devices. The intelligent design of the invention can acquire the situation of a fire scene in real time, and gives rescue schemes, evacuation path planning and various risk plan prompts in combination with the personnel state.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Automatic planning method for platform avoidance route
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic planning method for a platform-avoidance route. In order to solve the problems that the prior art can not find the global optimal solution when carrying out real-time adjustment according to the dynamic state of typhoons and has large workload; the invention comprises the following steps: 1. constructing an inclined coordinate system on a geographic sphere, obtaining a scale point set and obtaining a chart sampling map; constructing a basic route map based on route data published by maritime departments; 2. combining port/wind-shelter information, obtaining a route node map through node analysis, and constructing ship navigation limiting conditions; 3. searching the route to obtain a feasible path, and carrying out path optimization on the feasible path. The collection of sea chart information and channel information is fully considered, important channel nodes are obtained through layer-by-layer analysis through the construction of a sea chart sampling map, a basic channel map and a channel node map, and are reasonably connected, so that the size of dynamic channel space-time search is reduced while channel network information is reserved, and the calculated amount is greatly reduced.
assignees: CSSC ZHEJIANG OCEAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cloud platform-based automatic inspection deep sea culture disaster avoidance system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic patrol deep sea cultivation disaster avoidance system and method based on a cloud platform. When the unmanned patrol ship is operated, the unmanned patrol ship is cruised along the set route by the ship-borne monitoring module, the positioning module and the auxiliary power supply, and data monitoring is carried out at a navigation stopping point; the cloud platform stores the received data into a cloud database, and can monitor the monitoring data, the unmanned patrol ship positioning information and the navigation route in real time; the forecasting module imports data from the cloud platform to carry out wind disaster assessment and forecasting; judging whether an early warning module is required to be started or not according to a prediction result, planning a safe evacuation route, assisting deep sea farmers to quickly sense ocean wind disasters, and quickly judging safe zones, so that the farmers can perform self-early warning to prevent insufficient preparation when disasters come.

title_en: Building fire RFID positioning multifunctional mask based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building fire RFID positioning multifunctional mask based on the Internet of things, which relates to the technical field of masks and comprises a path planning module, an RFID positioning module and a voice broadcasting module; the path planning module is used for planning an escape channel scheme which is available when a fire disaster occurs, optimizing an optimal escape scheme when an emergency occurs, and transmitting the optimal escape scheme to the RFID positioning module and the voice broadcasting module; the RFID positioning module is internally provided with an acquisition unit, an analysis unit, a comparison unit and a prompt unit; the acquisition unit acquires a plurality of data messages of the RFID identification tag in the use process of the fire, wherein the data messages comprise radio frequency messages and communication messages, and the radio frequency messages and the communication messages are uploaded to the analysis unit after being processed after being acquired. The mask in the invention collects specific information of each smoke detector and each temperature detector in the building by utilizing the integrated RFID tag and the RFID identifier in the building through the internet of things technology, and then automatically plans an optimal escape route through terminals such as mobile phones and the like.

title_en: BIM-based construction site safety navigation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction site safety navigation method and system based on BIM, which comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional BIM model of a building structure, dividing and marking evacuation routes, construction entrances and exits and dangerous areas of an underground area in the three-dimensional BIM model, dividing grids of the marked three-dimensional BIM model, setting a plurality of navigation base points, generating a VR panorama and a corresponding two-dimensional code by taking each navigation base point as an initial view angle, pasting the generated two-dimensional code on the construction site, scanning the two-dimensional code to acquire current position and route information, and updating the passing route and safety risk information of each floor in the three-dimensional BIM model in real time. The invention can realize the navigation function of areas such as basements, building groups and the like which lack reference objects in the construction process of large buildings, can help construction operators to be familiar with construction sites faster and safer, and can quickly determine the positioning and the optimal walking route of the construction operators.
assignees: THE SECOND CONSTRUCTION CO LTD OF CHINA CONSTRUCTION FIRST GROUP;CHINA CONSTR 1ST BUILDING GROUP CORP LTD

title_en: Dredging route determining method and device for intelligent fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dredging route determining method and device for intelligent fire fighting, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of sensing data of a plurality of modes and corresponding sensing positions in a target detection area; determining at least one disaster point and disaster type in the target detection area according to the plurality of sensing data and the corresponding sensing positions; acquiring human body movement sensing information in a target detection area in real time; predicting an employee predicted escape route in the target detection area according to the human body movement sensing information and the passing rule of the target detection area; and determining the optimal escape route and a corresponding route guidance instruction of the target detection area according to the predicted escape route of staff in the target detection area and at least one disaster point and disaster type in the target detection area. Therefore, the invention can realize more accurate and efficient crowd evacuation and reduce the damage caused by fire events.
assignees: SHENZHEN GUANGAN FIRE FIGHTING & DECORATION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Urban traffic capacity assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to an urban traffic capacity assessment method. The traffic capacity of the road is calculated by the basic traffic capacity, the lane width and lateral clear width correction coefficient, the large vehicle to traffic capacity correction coefficient and the driver condition to traffic capacity correction coefficient. The value of the basic traffic capacity is obtained by designing the vehicle speed; the lane width and lateral clear width correction coefficients are obtained by the number of lanes, the lane width, the lateral clear width and whether barriers exist on two sides of a lane; the correction coefficient of the large-sized vehicles to the traffic capacity converts the number of the large-sized vehicles into the number of the small-sized vehicles; the correction factor of the traffic capacity is set to 0.9-1, and if the driver is mostly round-trip to the two places, the correction factor is set to 1. During emergency evacuation, the traffic capacity of each road on the path from the collection point to the receiving point is evaluated, so that the road with good traffic capacity is selected during path planning.

title_en: Optimal evacuation path calculation method for rescue evacuation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for calculating an optimal evacuation path for rescue evacuation, which takes various road network data as a basis to calculate a dynamic adjustment parameter value w of each road  n  And (5) path planning evaluation functions, and matching calculation paths. The invention uses the computer to carry out scientific operation through the known road network data, and reasonably selects the shortest distance, the shortest duration and the most unblocked road condition. The method has the advantages that the accurate scientific pre-judgment on emergency evacuation is realized, the evacuation path is reasonably arranged, and the fastest evacuation rescue result is completed by utilizing the optimal path mode.

title_en: Mine water inrush escape multistage planning method combining physical parameters and GIS analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine water burst escape multilevel planning method combining physical parameters and GIS analysis, which is used for collecting roadway three-dimensional coordinates measured by underground wires to obtain a roadway three-dimensional coordinate set and a communication relation set; constructing a three-dimensional roadway network model according to the roadway three-dimensional coordinate set and the communication relation set; calculating the distance weight of the edge node The escape personnel establishes a multi-stage GIS buffer zone by calling the three-dimensional coordinates and the communication relation of the roadway and combining the water burst flow spreading dynamics, the roadway air quantity and the personnel position information, analyzes the roadway safety point nearest to the escape personnel, provides the escape route from the current position to the nearest distance weight of different roadway safety points for the escape personnel by continuously updating the distance matrix D and the sequence matrix P, and can realize the conversion between the optimal routes of different levels, so that the personnel can avoid disasters smoothly, and the technical problem that the mine escape route planning method in the prior art can not provide the dynamic, multi-stage and efficient escape route is solved.
assignees: XIAN MEIKE TRANSPARENT GEOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Distress rescue system and method combining deficiency and excess
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distress rescue system and a distress rescue method combining deficiency and excess, wherein the system comprises a processing unit.
