The processing unit is configured to: dispatching an unmanned submarine as a guiding plane to undersea monitoring undersea data, and constructing a submarine topography virtual space based on the undersea data; under the condition that the distress manned submersible vehicles are monitored, the position of an underwater target is determined based on the cooperative positioning of a plurality of unmanned submersible vehicles, so that an evacuation route is planned; and controlling the unmanned underwater vehicles to guide the distress manned underwater vehicles to travel to the safe water area along the evacuation route in a mode of combining the unmanned underwater vehicles in water to form a three-dimensional guiding mark. The unmanned underwater vehicle can perform fine detection on the submarine topography ground of the target water area, and acquire conditions such as underwater topography situation, dark current distribution and the like. According to the invention, the underwater global environment is monitored through the unmanned underwater vehicle, so that the follow-up blindness of rescue of the manned underwater vehicle is avoided, and the navigation safety of the unmanned underwater vehicle and the manned underwater vehicle is improved.

title_en: Escape and rescue integrated emergency evacuation system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of fire protection, and provides an escape and rescue integrated emergency evacuation system and an operation method, wherein the system comprises a terminal module, a fire alarm module, an emergency evacuation module and a cloud platform module; the terminal module is used for receiving and displaying the navigation route and the user position information; providing a rescue personnel mode or an escape personnel mode, wherein the rescue personnel mode comprises a map marking function; the fire alarm module is used for collecting alarm information of a fire detector in a building and sending the alarm information to the emergency evacuation module; the emergency evacuation module is used for acquiring the position information of the user, generating a navigation route and sending the navigation route to the user; the message information is mutually transmitted with the terminal module; uploading the information content and record of the coming and going information to the cloud platform module; the cloud platform module is used for storing the uploaded information and opening information sharing; the invention can effectively reduce the information difference among the personnel in the fire scene, solves the problems of untimely and out-of-place information grasping of the rescue scene by the fire command center, and improves the success rate of rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN HIGH NEW INVEST SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dynamic fire evacuation path planning system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of fire evacuation, internet of things and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent dynamic fire evacuation path planning system and method, which are used for acquiring a three-dimensional model of a building floor and carrying out fire simulation on the three-dimensional model to obtain a dynamic feasible region; converting the three-dimensional model into an image under a two-dimensional plane by adopting Revit software, and processing the image into a grid map form in a path planning algorithm by using a MATLAB algorithm; combining the grid map with the dynamic feasible region, and generating an escape path and a rescue path by adopting an improved path planning A algorithm based on map partition preprocessing. Based on map partition preprocessing and the improved path planning A algorithm result, the invention enables personnel to directly reach a safety exit according to the luminous band indication; in the later stage of fire, the camera and the infrared sensor are used for carrying out image recognition and positioning, and a rescue path leading to trapped personnel is reversely established for firefighters, so that the double functions of escape and rescue are realized.

title_en: A damage management operation clothes for AR naval vessel
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of AR, in particular to a damage management operation suit for an AR naval vessel, which comprises an AR naval vessel damage management operation suit body, wherein the AR naval vessel damage management operation suit body consists of an intelligent hood controller, intelligent contact lenses, one-piece operation suit and intelligent touch gloves; an AR ship damage management operation suit system is arranged on the AR ship damage management operation suit body; the AR naval vessel damage management operation suit system comprises a control unit, a display unit, a monitoring unit and an environment monitoring and early warning unit; through the positioning and route guiding module, an operator can be helped to quickly and accurately find a target position or equipment, optimal path planning and navigation guidance are provided, lost or time is avoided, maintenance tasks are more efficiently executed, working efficiency and accuracy are improved, and when the environment monitoring module monitors danger, the optimal escape route can be analyzed by matching with the positioning and route guiding module.
assignees: THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF THE SECOND MILITARY MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Emergency command path planning method, device, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency command path planning method, an emergency command path planning device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the emergency command path planning method comprises the following steps: acquiring road network data, equipment data and personnel position information; generating dangerous road section information according to the road network data and the equipment data; according to the dangerous road section information, load information of each escape route is obtained; and adjusting a preset escape path according to the load information and the personnel position information to generate path information. According to the application, the preset escape route can be dynamically adjusted by acquiring the road network data, the equipment data and the personnel position information and combining the dangerous road section information and the load information, so that the problem that the personnel escape route cannot be adjusted according to the specific condition of the equipment is solved, and the personnel escape efficiency and safety are improved.

title_en: Fire evacuation path planning method and system based on road seeker and A-algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire evacuation path planning method and a system based on a road finder and an A-algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining that a fire disaster occurs in a target area according to information acquired in real time on a perception site; acquiring the position information of trapped personnel in a target area; when the position elevation of the trapped person is higher than or equal to the position coordinates of the fire point, path planning is carried out according to a path finder mechanism based on a heuristic function under a fire scene until the position coordinates of all the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire point; when the position coordinates of the trapped person are lower than the position coordinates of the fire points, path planning is carried out according to a path planning mechanism based on heuristic function MOA under the fire scene. The application adopts a segmentation algorithm to plan. According to the position relation, two different path planning algorithms are adopted, the uncertainty of environmental change under a fire scene is fully considered, and the respective emphasis points under the two conditions are considered, so that the aim of combining safety and speed is fulfilled.

title_en: Urban rail transit station fire intelligent evacuation method based on monitoring video
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for improving fire evacuation in a subway station based on a monitoring video. Firstly, identifying fire disaster by adopting a computer vision technology, and determining the position and development scale of the fire disaster; meanwhile, the positions and the number of people to be evacuated are identified, and a data basis is provided for evacuation path planning. Secondly, factors such as fire disaster positions, crowd distribution conditions, passing capacity of each evacuation outlet, evacuation distance, route straightness and the like are comprehensively considered, and a plurality of algorithms are fused to perform rapid optimization solution of evacuation routes, so that the overall station evacuation efficiency is maximized. Thirdly, the technology can be laid based on the existing monitoring system in the subway station, the escape route of the planned call is guided to evacuate the personnel in the station through the safety indication sign, the existing hardware facilities are fully utilized, and the application cost is controllable.

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method and related device based on subway station fire
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel evacuation path planning method and a related device based on subway station fires, and relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation.

title_en: Nuclear power plant serious accident and emergency demonstration system
abstract_en: The present disclosure proposes a nuclear power plant severe accident and emergency demonstration system, the system comprising: the system comprises a panoramic three-dimensional model display module, a positioning navigation module, a real-time operation data processing module, a serious accident and emergency simulation module, wherein the panoramic three-dimensional model display module is used for displaying a three-dimensional panoramic model of a nuclear power plant area and an out-of-plant area in a handheld terminal; the positioning navigation module is used for positioning the handheld terminal, customizing route navigation by a user and navigating an emergency evacuation route in an emergency state; the real-time operation data processing module is used for acquiring real-time operation data related to the operation of the nuclear power plant and managing the real-time operation data; the emergency and emergency simulation module is used for acquiring real-time operation data based on the real-time operation data processing module for operation in an emergency and emergency demonstration mode, displaying the real-time operation data on the three-dimensional panoramic model, and acquiring an emergency evacuation route and an emergency collection area based on the positioning navigation module.
assignees: STATE POWER INVESTMENT CORPORATION SCIENCE & TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent lighting system for escape indication
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent illumination, and particularly discloses an intelligent illumination system for escape indication, which comprises the following components: the intelligent illumination system comprises a safety monitoring module, a path planning module, a brightness adjusting module and an intelligent illumination cloud platform, wherein the safety monitoring module, the path planning module, the brightness adjusting module and the intelligent illumination cloud platform are used for evaluating the danger degree of emergency situations of building scenes, so that the timeliness and the accuracy of an intelligent illumination system in response to the emergency situations are improved, the safety of escape processes is improved, the occurrence of the phenomenon of confusion in the process of treading and searching people is effectively avoided, the escape route is dynamically adjusted according to the changes of people flow density and the emergency situations by monitoring the path length and the danger coefficient of the escape channel, the people evacuation time is shortened, the safety risk is reduced, the efficiency and the safety of people evacuation are improved, and meanwhile, the brightness of escape indicator lamps is automatically adjusted by evaluating the visibility of the escape channels, so that escape indications are always clearly visible, and people are helped to find the evacuation direction rapidly.
assignees: ANHUI TRAFFIC CONTROL ENG GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fire emergency lamp for indicating rescue and intelligent internet of things fire-fighting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-fighting emergency lamp for indicating rescue and an intelligent internet of things fire-fighting system, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency, wherein the fire-fighting emergency lamp for indicating rescue comprises a shell, a display module, a control circuit module, a power supply module and a substrate, wherein the display module, the control circuit module and the power supply module are respectively packaged on the substrate; the power supply module is respectively connected with the display module and the control circuit module to respectively supply power to the display module and the control circuit module; the display module comprises a direction indicating unit and a rescue indicating unit, the direction indicating unit is used for indicating the escape route, the rescue indicating unit is used for indicating the rescue route, and the control circuit module is respectively connected with the direction indicating unit and the rescue indicating unit so as to respectively drive the direction indicating unit and the rescue indicating unit. By adopting the utility model, the route guidance can be carried out on trapped people and rescue workers at the same time, and the evacuation and rescue efficiency is improved.

title_en: Method for Providing of Forest Disaster Information
title_ko: 산림 재난정보 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a method for providing forest disaster information, which provides forest disaster information to a user terminal located in a forest, and allows communicates between user terminals using a clustering technique in a situation where communication with a server is unavailable, thereby quickly disseminating forest disaster and accident situations to people located in the forest and providing a path for a survivor to safely escape from a disaster. The method for providing forest disaster information comprises: a first step of transmitting forest disaster state information including at least one of forest disaster occurrence prediction information and forest disaster occurrence information to a user terminal located in a forest; a second step of outputting the forest disaster state information by the user terminal; a third step of forming a clustering with other user terminals located nearby by using direct WI-FI communication when communication is unavailable; a fourth step of outputting the forest disaster state information received from the other user terminals, by the user terminal; a fifth step of transmitting safety route guide information to the clustered other user terminals; and a sixth step of transmitting the safety route guide information received through a service server from the clustered other user terminals to the user terminals in a communication unavailable state.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 서버에서 산림내에 위치하는 사용자단말로 산림재난정보를 제공하되, 서버와 통신 불가능한 사용자 단말은 주변 사용자 단말과 클러스터링 기법을 통해 산림 재해 및 재난 상황을 제공받도록 함과 더불어, 사용자가 안전하게 대피할 수 있는 안전 경로를 제공하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 산림 재난정보 제공 방법은, 서비스 서버에서 외부로부터 산림 상태에 해당하는 산림 데이터를 수집함과 더불어 산림재난 발생정보를 수집하고, 산림 데이터를 근거로 산림재난 발생 예측정보를 생성하여 산림재난 발생 예측정보 또는 산림재난 발생정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 산림재난 상태정보를 산림내에 위치한 사용자 단말로 전송하는 제1 단계와, 사용자 단말에서 산림재난 상태정보를 출력하는 제2 단계, 사용자 단말에서 서비스서버와의 통신 상태를 감시하고, 통신 불가 상태시 와이파이 다이렉트 통신을 이용하여 주변에 위치한 타 사용자 단말과 클러스터링을 형성하는 제3 단계, 클러스터링 형성된 타 사용자 단말에서 서비스 서버로부터 수신된 산림재난 상태정보를 통신 불가 상태인 사용자 단말로 전송하여 사용자 단말에서 타 사용자 단말로부터 수신된 산림재난 상태정보를 출력하는 제4 단계, 클러스터링 형성된 타 사용자 단말에서 통신 불가 상태인 사용자 단말정보 및 위치정보를 포함하는 조난 발생 정보를 서비스 서버로 전송하고, 서비스 서버에서 통신 불가 상태인 사용자단말 위치정보를 근거로 해당 위치에서 사용자가 안전하게 이동할 수 있는 안전 경로를 생성하고, 안전 경로 안내정보를 클러스터링 형성된 타 사용자 단말로 전송하는 제5 단계 및, 클러스터링 형성된 타 사용자 단말에서 서비스 서버를 통해 수신된 안전 경로 안내정보를 해당 통신 불가 상태인 사용자 단말로 전송하는 제6 단계를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for establishing fire rescue prediction model, fire rescue method and related device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for establishing a fire-fighting rescue prediction model, a fire-fighting rescue method and a related device, and relates to the technical field of emergency rescue of fire-fighting rescue teams, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a firefighting rescue prediction model based on a graph neural network, and defining input and output of the firefighting rescue prediction model; defining a position prediction method of the individual fire fighters as X  (t)：(t+T) ＝f[X (t‑s)：t , G ]; obtaining a plurality of groups of predicted values by using a position prediction method of the individual fire fighters; based on the obtained multiple groups of predicted values and the real values corresponding to the multiple groups of predicted values, taking the L-loss function as a training target, and training the established firefighting rescue prediction model. The invention introduces the graphic neural network into the application field of search and rescue and navigation of individual firefighters, uses the topological structure of the on-site command combat network and the network node RSRP as reference factors to infer the potential positions of the individual firefighters, and realizes search and rescue and evacuation prediction of the individual firefighters on site.
assignees: JIANGSU YOUXIONG SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire real-time evacuation path planning method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire real-time evacuation path planning method and system based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: determining fire scene information in response to receiving the fire command; acquiring monitoring data acquired by monitoring equipment of a fire scene in real time; performing low-dimensional space mapping on the monitoring data to obtain a plurality of first monitoring data feature matrixes; based on the first influence characteristic recognition configuration, carrying out influence characteristic recognition on the plurality of first monitoring data characteristic matrixes, and determining influence monitoring data basis corresponding to the plurality of first monitoring data characteristic matrixes; inputting the influence monitoring data into a target fire spread trend reasoning model which is obtained in advance based on deep learning training, so as to obtain target spread trend information; and generating and transmitting a target evacuation path based on the road planning and the target spreading trend information. The fire spreading trend can be accurately predicted, so that people in a fire scene can be effectively ensured to be evacuated rapidly and reliably, and the evacuation efficiency in the case of fire is effectively ensured.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGZHUO FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A Radiation (capability) measurement system combined with public transportation operating in areas around nuclear facilities
title_ko: 원자력이용시설 주변지역에서 운행되는 대중교통과 결합된 방사선(능) 측정시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to install a radiation (capability) measurement device, a satellite navigation device (GPS, Global Positioning System), a communication device, and an information output device on public transportation (routed buses) operating in areas around nuclear facilities, thereby obtaining radiation (capability) measurement information and measurement location information in real time, and constructing big data to provide a safe movement route in real time when a disaster occurs. The radiation (capability) measurement system combined with public transportation operating in areas around nuclear facilities comprises: a fixed environmental radiation (capability) monitor (20); a mobile environmental radiation (capability) measurement device (30); and a central monitoring center (10) that controls and manages public transportation (40). The mobile environmental radiation (capability) measuring device (30) is connected to the Korea Meteorological Administration server (50), the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency server (60), the local government server (70), and the business server (80) through a communication network, and outputs the corresponding notification information to the information display means (33) and the voice output means (34) when notification information is received from the servers. According to the present invention, it is connected to the Korea Meteorological Administration server, the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency server, the local government server, and the business server through a communication network, and has the effect of providing disaster prevention and social disaster information in real time and transmitting various notification information provided by the state, local governments, and businesses.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능재난을 대비한 사물인터넷 기반 다중 방재시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 원자력시설 등의 사고로 인해 방사능재난이 발생하였을 때, 다양한 양방향 단말기를 사용하여 방사능 오염위험지역에 대한 방사능 오염 탐지, 오염된 지역에 대한 방사선량률 측정 및 기상상황에 따른 방사능 오염원의 이동경로를 종합적으로 분석하여 신속하고 정확하게 방사능재난에 대응할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 방사능재난 지역의 주민들을 신속하게 안전한 구호소로 소개하여 통제관리할 수 있음은 물론 방재요원들 상호간의 실시간 정보교환 및 방사능방재지휘통제본부과 각 방재요원과의 양방향 교신을 통해 실시간으로 재난상황정보를 공유할 수 있도록 하므로서 방재에 투입되는 방재요원들의 신체 및 심리적 안전을 확보하여 방재대응에 충실할 수 있음은 물론 기상청서버, 질병관리청서버, 지자체서버 및 사업자서버와 각각 통신망을 통해 연결되어 미세먼지 및 코로나-19와 같은 방재 및 사회재난 정보를 실시간으로 제공하고, 국가, 지방자치단체 및 사업자가 제공하는 각종 알림정보를 전달할 수 있도록 하는 것이며; 그 구성은 이동형 환경방사선(능) 측정장치는 기상청서버, 질병관리청서버, 지자체서버 및 사업자서버와 각각 통신망을 통해 연결되고, 상기 기상청서버로 부터 수신되는 미세먼지 정보 중 GPS 정보 및 일자정보에 따라 해당지역의 해당일자에 대한 미세먼지 정보를 상기 정보표시수단 및 음성출력수단을 출력하고, 상기 질병관리청서버로 부터 수신되는 코로나-19 정보 중 일자정보에 따라 해당일자의 코로나-19 정보를 상기 정보표시수단 및 음성출력수단을 출력하고, 상기 지자체서버로 부터 알림정보가 수신되었을 때, 해당 알림정보를 상기 정보표시수단 및 음성출력수단을 출력하며, 상기 사업자서버로 부터 알림정보가 수신되었을 때, 해당 알림정보를 상기 정보표시수단 및 음성출력수단을 출력하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and system for monitoring and early warning burst of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the disaster management field of the disaster management field, and provides a method and a system for monitoring and early warning of burst of a barrier lake, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a data monitoring module, a real-time state acquisition module, a risk avoidance scheme planning module and a risk warning module. And taking measures for instantly acquiring the current available route, and planning an evacuation path by combining the predicted collapsibility influence area. The instant path planning based on the current actual situation greatly improves the evacuation efficiency, and can rapidly verify the evacuation path, thereby greatly improving the efficiency and the effectiveness of emergency response. And the obtained automatic processing and real-time data analysis are combined, so that the planning and execution of the coping strategies are further optimized, the precious time is saved, and the overall level of public safety is obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP SECOND ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHINA ANNENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Fireproof ventilation type elevator car based on emergency evacuation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fireproof ventilation type elevator car based on an emergency evacuation system, which relates to the technical field of elevators and comprises a car body, a central controller and an emergency evacuation control module, wherein the central controller is integrated in the car body; the emergency evacuation control module includes: floor navigation path planning unit, emergency communication system and emergency stop door opening mechanism. According to the invention, by installing the emergency evacuation control module, the function of rapidly guiding passengers to evacuate in the case of fire emergency is realized, the problem that passengers cannot rapidly and accurately find an evacuation path in the case of fire emergency is solved, the response speed of an elevator system to the emergency is improved, and accidents in the emergency evacuation process are reduced to the greatest extent.

title_en: Combustible gas concentration monitoring and dangerous area demarcating method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of gas detection and safety, and provides a method and a system for monitoring the concentration of combustible gas and demarcating a dangerous area, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a combustible gas concentration monitoring module, a dangerous area demarcating and visualizing module, a gas diffusion prediction module and an escape route guidance and augmented reality module. The invention provides a set of gas monitoring and safety early warning system which integrates multiple advantages, can rapidly define a dangerous area and effectively prevent potential accidents such as gas leakage. The invention reduces the dependence on manual operation, improves the working efficiency through automatic control, can visualize gas diffusion and visual escape route guidance, and obviously reduces the workload of related personnel. The design of reducing the cost ensures that the system is not only economical to maintain and operate, but also more convenient to popularize and apply in various environments. The feature of strong compatibility allows the system to work in concert with existing security facilities, providing a comprehensive security solution.
assignees: SHENZHEN ROUJIA TECH CO LTD;SOUTH MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG PROVINCE LABORATORY ZHANJIANG

title_en: Evacuation route guidance system
title_ko: 대피로 경로 유도 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is an evacuation route guide system. according to the present invention, an evacuation route guide unit is configured to guide an evacuation route to a structure such as a bench-type chair installed in a building or an underground space, and a survival tool kit is stored in the structure. accordingly, an evacuation route required for an evacuee is provided in a customized manner, and the evacuee secures stability from a disaster area by using the survival tool kit to prevent secondary damage from a disaster risk.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피로 경로 유도 시스템을 개시한다. 이러한 본 발명은 건물이나 지하공간에 설치된 벤치형 의자와 같은 구조물에 대피 경로를 유도하는 대피경로 유도부를 구성함은 물론 구조물내에 생존도구 키트가 보관되도록 구성한 것이고, 이에 따라 대피자에게 필요한 대피 경로를 맞춤형으로 제공하면서 대피자가 생존도구 키트를 이용하여 재난지역으로부터 안정성을 확보하여 재난 위험으로부터 2차 피해를 방지하는 것이다.

title_en: Mine fire evacuation path planning method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine fire emergency evacuation, in particular to a mine fire evacuation path planning method and device, which are particularly suitable for mines with complex mine network, weak emergency evacuation capacity and fixed escape route, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out numerical simulation on mine fire by using a numerical simulation technology to obtain fire dynamic change data; constructing a mine network topology model; constructing a roadway equivalent length calculation model according to the fire dynamic change data, the mine network topology model and the roadway static parameters; and obtaining a mine fire evacuation path planning result according to the fire dynamic change data, the roadway equivalent length calculation model and the improved Floyd-Warshall algorithm. The systematic mine fire evacuation path planning method comprises fire numerical simulation, network topology theory, equivalent length calculation model and improved Floyd-Warshall algorithm. Compared with the traditional optimal route planning method, the evacuation route can be optimized, so that evacuees can avoid dangerous routes, and the evacuation safety level is obviously improved.

title_en: Evacuation Route Guidance Station
title_ko: 대피 경로 가이드 스테이션
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide an evacuation route guide station that generates an evacuation route based on a type of a disaster that occurs when a disaster situation occurs in a building, and starts a guide robot traveling along the evacuation route to guide the requester with the evacuation route when a requester is detected. The present invention relates to the evacuation route guide station for guiding an evacuation route when a disaster situation occurs in a building. Provided is the evacuation route guide station comprising: a station body having an accommodation space therein; a disaster determination unit for determining whether a disaster situation occurs; a route information generation unit for generating evacuation route information for evacuating a requester; and one or more mobile guide robots accommodated in the accommodation space. The guide robot deviates from the accommodation space and guides and drives according to the evacuation route information so as to guide the evacuation route to the requester when the disaster situation occurs. According to the present invention, since an evacuation route is generated based on a type of a disaster generated when a disaster situation occurs, an optimal evacuation route is provided according to the type of the generated disaster, so that a requester can safely and quickly evacuate.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피 경로 가이드 스테이션에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 대피 경로 가이드 스테이션은, 건물 내 재난 상황 발생 시 대피 경로를 가이드 하는 대피 경로 가이드 스테이션으로, 내부에 수용 공간을 구비하는 스테이션 바디와, 재난 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 재난 판단부와, 요구조자를 대피시키기 위한 대피 경로 정보를 생성하는 경로 정보 생성부, 그리고 수용 공간에 수용되며, 주행 가능한 하나 이상의 가이드 로봇을 포함하고, 가이드 로봇은 재난 상황이 발생하면 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 가이드 하도록, 수용 공간으로부터 이탈하여 대피 경로 정보에 따라 가이드 주행할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의하면, 발생한 재난 종류에 따라 최적의 대피 경로를 제공함으로써, 요구조자가 안전하고 신속하게 대피할 수 있고, 가이드 로봇이 주행하며 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 가이드함으로써, 요구조자가 보다 용이하게 대피할 수 있으며, 가이드 로봇이 요구조자의 대피 경로를 가이드하는 중에 다른 요구조자가 대피 경로 가이드를 요청하여도 새로운 가이드 로봇을 통해 대피 경로의 가이드가 가능하다.
assignees: CHANG SHIN COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COLLABORATION PARTY

title_en: Evacuation Route Guidance Robot
title_ko: 대피 경로 가이드 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an evacuation route guide robot. As an evacuation route guide robot that guides an evacuation route when a disaster occurs in a building, the evacuation route guide robot according to one embodiment of the present invention includes: a robot body that can drive; a disaster judgment unit that determines whether a disaster has occurred; a path information generation unit that generates evacuation route information for evacuating a person in need of rescue; and a driving control unit that controls the guided driving of the robot body to guide an evacuation route to a person in need of rescue based on the generated evacuation route information. According to the present invention, since an evacuation route is generated based on the type of disaster that occurred when a disaster occurred, an optimal evacuation route is provided according to the type of disaster that occurred. Therefore, a person in need of rescue can safely and quickly evacuate, and instead of simply providing an evacuation route using lighting and sound, the guide robot drives and guides the person in need of rescue to an evacuation route. As a result, a person in need of rescue can evacuate more easily.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대피 경로 가이드 로봇에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 대피 경로 가이드 로봇은, 건물 내 재난 상황 발생 시 대피 경로를 가이드 하는 대피 경로 가이드 로봇으로, 주행 가능한 로봇 바디와, 재난 상황 발생 여부를 판단하는 재난 판단부와, 요구조자를 대피시키기 위한 대피 경로 정보를 생성하는 경로 정보 생성부, 그리고 생성한 대피 경로 정보에 기초하여 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 가이드 하도록 로봇 바디의 가이드 주행을 제어하는 주행 제어부를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 재난 상황 발생 시 발생한 재난의 종류에 기초한 대피 경로를 생성하므로, 발생한 재난 종류에 따라 최적의 대피 경로를 제공함으로써, 요구조자가 안전하고 신속하게 대피할 수 있으며, 단순히 조명, 소리를 이용하여 대피 경로를 제공하는 것이 아니라,가이드 로봇이 주행하며 요구조자에게 대피 경로를 가이드함으로써, 요구조자가 보다 용이하게 대피할 수 있다.
assignees: CHANG SHIN COLLEGE IND ACADEMIC COLLABORATION PARTY

title_en: Escape route generation method, electronic device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an escape route generation method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving data to be processed acquired by at least one sensor deployed in a target area; under the condition that the existence of the early warning requirement is determined based on the data to be processed, determining the current early warning factor according to the data to be processed corresponding to each roadway; determining the target trafficability of the roadway based on the current early warning factor and the initial weight factor corresponding to the roadway; and determining a target escape path based on the target trafficability and the position information corresponding to the roadway inflection point. According to the technical scheme, the path can be dynamically planned in the roadway by combining roadway data, data to be processed acquired by sensors deployed in each roadway and initial weight factors corresponding to each roadway, and the timeliness and flexibility of path planning updating are improved.
assignees: NANJING BESTWAY INTELLIGENT CONTROL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Guide illumination fire-fighting lamp
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a guiding illumination fire-fighting lamp, which comprises an emergency illumination device, wherein the emergency illumination device comprises an emergency lamp box, a lamp shade, an indicator, a sound transmission hole, a heat dissipation groove, a smoke sensor, a fixed support, an LED illuminating lamp and an emergency illumination controller, wherein the lamp shade is fixedly arranged on one side of the emergency lamp box, the indicator is fixedly connected to one side of the lamp shade, which is far away from the emergency lamp box, the sound transmission hole is symmetrically and uniformly penetrated at two ends of the emergency lamp box, the heat dissipation groove is uniformly penetrated at the top end of the emergency lamp box, the smoke sensor is uniformly and fixedly arranged at the bottom end of the emergency lamp box, and the fixed support is fixedly connected to one side of the emergency lamp box, which is far away from the lamp shade. According to the utility model, by combining the illuminating lamp and the indicator, the illumination is provided, meanwhile, the evacuation path indication and the circulation playing voice navigation are provided, so that people are reminded to observe the evacuation path, and a faster and orderly evacuation site is realized.
assignees: SHANDONG CHENGHEAN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Data display method, device, augmented reality equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a data display method, a data display device, augmented reality equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: responding to the disaster early warning information acquired by the augmented reality equipment in the wearing state, and acquiring an escape identifier corresponding to the current position; generating an escape path based on the escape mark; the escape path is displayed within a field angle of the augmented reality device. Therefore, under the condition that a user does not need any manual operation, the escape direction is quickly determined based on the escape route displayed in the view angle, and the escape route is generated based on the escape identification mark of the current position, so that the accuracy of escape route guidance is improved.

title_en: Mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and path planning method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a mine emergency escape system based on digital twinning and a path planning method thereof. According to the invention, the BIM model, the Internet of things technology and the optimization algorithm are comprehensively utilized, and when disasters occur, the shortest escape route can be planned for personnel at different positions underground on the premise of personnel safety, so that the timeliness and rationality of evacuation guidance are improved; when the escape route is planned, not only the dangerous area of the roadway is considered, but also the position information of personnel in the roadway is considered, so that the optimized escape route has more pertinence; by utilizing the three-dimensional visual function of BIM technology, the three-dimensional phase expression of evacuation guidance is realized, and the guidance effect is improved.
assignees: FUJIAN MEIFANG SHIDAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent escape navigation system for real-time route display and optimal path planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent escape navigation system for real-time route display and optimal path planning, which relates to the technical field of fire safety evacuation and comprises a fire detection module, a video monitoring module and an evacuation navigation monitoring module; the traditional blind escape path selection under fire is improved into the visual, dynamic and intelligent escape path optimization problem, and the escape path optimization is realized by applying modern mature technical means; according to the escape route optimization method, on the basis of escape route optimization, comprehensive factors such as the flowing condition of escape crowds, the crowd density at a safety exit, the flowing state of fire smoke, the concentration of CO on the escape route and the like are comprehensively considered, so that an optimal escape route is provided for evacuees in time; effectively improve the safe evacuation efficiency of conflagration.
assignees: ZHONGAN CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Escape system based on natural disaster occurrence condition
abstract_en: The invention provides an escape system based on the occurrence of natural disasters, and relates to the technical field of electronic information. The escape system based on the natural disaster occurrence condition comprises a positioning module, a scheme module and a navigation module, wherein the positioning module is arranged in electronic equipment, the positioning module is used for helping the system to determine the accurate position of a user when the disaster occurs and transmitting position information to a rescue center or a parent mobile phone in real time, the scheme module is used for acquiring, transmitting and transmitting data of the user position, and the navigation module is used for acquiring detailed map data, planning an optimal escape route and navigating. The invention establishes a unified information system through data integration and sharing, and integrates various emergency self-rescue scheme resources. By realizing the sharing and exchange of data, the efficiency and accuracy of information acquisition are improved.

title_en: Emergency rescue method based on remote sensing satellite and Beidou grid position code
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, in particular to an emergency rescue method based on remote sensing satellites and Beidou grid position codes, which comprises the following steps: performing Beidou grid division on the map of the industrial park to obtain a grid map of the industrial park, and endowing each grid unit with a unique Beidou grid position code; obtaining an emergency plan and storing the emergency plan in a plan library, carrying out abstract analysis on each basic element in the emergency plan to form an indivisible element model, and drawing the emergency plan in a grid map based on the element model for visual display; when the alarm information is acquired, calling a remote sensing satellite to shoot an accident occurrence position corresponding to the alarm information in real time, and matching a corresponding target emergency plan in a plan library and starting the plan; and determining an optimal route for an emergency team to arrive at the accident occurrence position based on the real-time traffic condition and correcting the evacuation route in the target emergency plan. The method well improves the emergency rescue capability and success rate.
assignees: SHAANXI YIJIE WANMING TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI WESTLAND IND AUTOMATION LTD;XIAN VANXVM ELECTRONICS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elevator evacuation rescue system under fire disaster condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an elevator evacuation and rescue system under the condition of fire, which comprises: defining elevator operation modes in different periods of fire according to evacuation strategies under the participation condition of the elevators; acquiring site fire disaster position information, elevator evacuation environment information and building information by utilizing a multi-source data acquisition device; judging whether an elevator is adopted to participate in evacuation for site fire position information, elevator evacuation environment information and building information; under the condition that the elevator participates in evacuation, establishing a mathematical model of evacuation path planning according to building information and fire position information; according to the change of the fire position and the evacuation environment, the elevator operation mode is converted into boundary conditions, and the elevator operation mode is controlled; the evacuation path is broadcasted in real time to guide evacuation personnel to evacuate through the voice broadcasting and video display modes of the building. According to the invention, under the condition of fire, the elevator can safely and efficiently complete emergency evacuation tasks, and casualties are reduced to the greatest extent.
assignees: BEIJING BUILDING MECHANIZATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and device
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of geological disaster analysis, and provides a method and a device for monitoring and early warning of coal mine geological disasters, and as a further scheme of the invention, the system comprises: the system comprises a sensor network module, a channel risk state evaluation module, a safety risk avoidance path analysis module and a rescue guidance module. The core advantage of the coal mine geological disaster monitoring and early warning method is the highly integrated and intelligent system design, and the design not only ensures the real-time monitoring and quick response of the mine state, but also forms a closely connected emergency management network through comprehensive risk assessment and intelligent evacuation path planning. The construction of such a network enables the system to quickly initiate multiple emergency actions in the face of mine anomalies, such as identifying safe areas, providing directions, performing borehole ventilation and excavation rescue, etc., all based on in-depth analysis and understanding of mine geology.

title_en: Intelligent guiding method and system for fire evacuation path of super high-rise building
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent guiding method and system for fire evacuation paths of super high-rise buildings, which belong to the technical field of fire emergency evacuation of super high-rise buildings, wherein the method comprises the steps of marking the fire and the spreading position of the fire and giving out an alarm when the occurrence of the fire is confirmed by the alarm sent out by a temperature sensor, a smoke sensor and a carbon monoxide sensor; the method comprises the steps of collecting crowd evacuation behavior videos in an evacuation channel in real time by using cameras, detecting and tracking crowds with multiple targets by using a deep learning algorithm, dynamically planning a safe evacuation path (hereinafter called an optimal evacuation path) with highest evacuation efficiency by using a path planning algorithm in combination with fire spread information by calculating crowd density and crowd evacuation speed in evacuation passage; and guiding the evacuation path based on the optimal evacuation path in the super high-rise building digital twin system. The invention solves the problem that the traditional evacuation path guiding method based on the principle of shortest evacuation distance is difficult to be suitable for the actual demand of the evacuation guiding of the super high-rise building.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted navigator with built-in heat abstractor
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of vehicle navigation instruments, and discloses a vehicle navigation instrument with a built-in heat dissipation device, which comprises a vehicle navigation instrument, wherein an electronic element is arranged in the vehicle navigation instrument, the vehicle navigation instrument with the built-in heat dissipation device is provided with a control component, heat generated when the electronic element in the vehicle navigation instrument works enters a thermal expansion air bag from a heat conduction pipe, the thermal expansion air bag is heated in a fixed frame to expand, and a movable disc is abutted against the movable disc to move under the support of a first spring, the fixed horizontal pole synchronous movement in activity dish surface, horizontal pole conflict movable plate move under the support of spring two, and the flat pole that movable plate surface was high drives baffle synchronous movement, and the baffle no longer shelters from the heating panel, then makes the heating panel discharge the inside hot air of vehicle navigation appearance, avoids the heat to pile up the damage that causes vehicle navigation appearance, and this mode can prevent that the dust from getting into when vehicle navigation appearance inside temperature is normal.
assignees: SHENZHEN XINHUA CHUANGNENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, medium and equipment for dynamic planning of evacuation path in building
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency route planning, and provides a method, a system, a medium and equipment for dynamic planning of evacuation paths in a building, wherein the technical scheme is as follows: the device network is formed by connecting lines, so that the analysis of a plane drawing is not needed, useless information irrelevant to paths is eliminated, the plane graph is skillfully converted into the graph of nodes and line segments, a scene is abstracted into an undirected graph by connecting lines based on a graph theory method, a safety exit and various feasible evacuation paths in the scene can be simply and intuitively displayed, the subsequent path calculation process is simplified, the complexity of an optimized breadth-first path algorithm is low, the calculation delay is low, real-time path planning can be realized, the escape efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for all complex scenes.
assignees: SHANDONG HUATIAN TECH GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG HOTEAM ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire evacuation indication method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication method, an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication system, an intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication device and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of intelligent fire-fighting indication, and the intelligent fire-fighting evacuation indication method comprises the following steps: step one, arranging sensors in a building, designing timing self-calibration and triggering self-calibration flow of the sensors, processing data among different sensors through a data fusion algorithm, identifying abnormal values, and testing self-calibration and mutual detection mechanisms of the sensors; according to the invention, the VR technology is combined for evacuation exercise, the familiarity of personnel to evacuation paths is improved, the AR technology is used for providing real-time navigation, intuitively guiding evacuation directions, and integrating the functions of fire alarm, evacuation indication and communication into a building management system, so that integrated management is realized, a simulation scene is constructed according to building structure and people flow data, and the evacuation efficiency and safety are further evaluated.

title_en: Station evacuation path planning method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a station evacuation path planning method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein a station environment model is constructed based on station space information and real-time perception information, and three-dimensional station space contained from an evacuation starting point to a station entrance is converted into a combination of a plurality of two-dimensional space layers to obtain a space layer set to be searched; calculating the selectable evacuation sub-paths of each space level to be searched and the passing time length of each selectable evacuation sub-path by using a path planning algorithm and a passenger passing efficiency evaluation model based on the passable area and the evacuation starting point; combining the selectable evacuation sub-paths of each space level to be searched based on the connection relation of the adjacent space levels to obtain selectable evacuation paths; and determining a target station entrance and a corresponding evacuation path from the selectable evacuation paths based on the passing duration of each selectable evacuation sub-path. By adopting the method, the effectiveness and the evacuation efficiency of the obtained evacuation path are improved, and safe and efficient evacuation based on the evacuation path is ensured.
assignees: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Outdoor Route Guidance System
abstract_en: To provide an outdoor route guidance system capable of being used for more than just evacuation guidance thereby improving the penetration rate thereof.SOLUTION: An outdoor route guidance system X1 includes: multiple lighting units 1 installed in a place where people pass by; and a control unit 2 that controls the multiple lighting units 1. The control unit 2 is configured to select and execute multiple control modes including a normal control mode for lighting the place and a guidance control mode for navigating through the location to a predetermined destination.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: fire toxic-gas detecting and evacuate-route guiding system by use of 5G-based P-type fire receivers and composite sensors
title_ko: 5g 통신망 기반 p형 수신기와 복합 센서를 활용한 화재 유해가스 감지 및 대피경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for detecting harmful gas and guiding an evacuation route in the event of a fire, and particularly, to a system for detecting fire harmful gas and guiding an evacuation route using a P-type receiver and a complex sensor based on a 5G communication network, which can quickly and accurately detect the occurrence of a fire through harmful gas detection and fire occurrence detection to which a complex sensor is applied, build a mesh network based on a wireless LAN and 5G to share fire occurrence information with P-type receivers and an external system, and calculate an optimal evacuation route from an ignition point to guide evacuation for workers and residents inside a building, thereby reducing casualties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 일반적으로 화재 발생시에 유해가스를 감지하고 대피경로를 안내하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 복합 센서를 적용한 유해가스 감지 및 화재발생 탐지를 통해 화재 발생을 신속 정확하게 초기 탐지하고 무선랜과 5G 기반의 메쉬 네트워크를 구축하여 P형 수신기들 및 외부 시스템과 화재발생 정보를 공유하며 발화지점으로부터의 최적 대피경로를 산출하여 건물 내부의 작업자와 거주자에 대한 대피를 안내함으로써 인명 피해를 낮출 수 있는 5G 통신망 기반 P형 수신기와 복합 센서를 활용한 화재 유해가스 감지 및 대피경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: DAON CO LTD;GUMI ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Navigation Device
abstract_en: To provide a navigation device that presents a quide route avoiding a dangerous area to a user even when no destination is set.SOLUTION: A navigation device 1 includes: a current position acquisition unit 12 that acquires a current position of a vehicle; an emergency alarm determination unit 13 that determines whether or not an emergency alarm is issued; a disaster information acquisition unit 14 that, when the emergency alarm determination unit 13 determines that the emergency alarm has been issued, acquires disaster information including information on at least a dangerous area; a guide route calculation unit 15 that calculates a guide route from the current position avoiding the dangerous area to a destination on the basis of the disaster information; and a display unit 30 that displays information on the calculated guide route. The guide route calculation unit 15, when the emergency alarm determination unit 13 determines that the emergency alarm has been issued and no destination is set, sets a registered shelter previously registered by a user to the destination to calculate the guide route.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title_en: Rural intelligent scenic spot tourist safety service system
abstract_en: The application discloses a rural intelligent scenic spot tourist safety service system, which comprises a processing center, wherein the processing center is connected with a monitoring module, a route planning module, a guiding module and a broadcasting module, the monitoring module is used for capturing image information in scenic spots in real time, the route planning module analyzes the passenger flow of each route according to the image information captured by the monitoring module and plans an optimal route which can reach a designated place under an emergency, the guiding module comprises a marker post and a color-variable indication arrow, and the broadcasting module is used for synchronously broadcasting related information under the emergency. According to the application, the scenic spot images are captured in real time through the monitoring module, the emergency situation is found by utilizing the image analysis algorithm, the multidimensional emergency response is started, the optimal evacuation route is planned, the guidance and the broadcasting of multilingual emergency information are indicated, the rapid evacuation of tourists is ensured, the route planning module dynamically adjusts the route, and the broadcasting module supports multilingual broadcasting and updates the content in real time.
assignees: GANSU NEW SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;GANSU POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE ANIMAL HUSBANDRY & ENG

title_en: Ship fire evacuation path planning method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: A ship fire evacuation path planning method based on an ant colony algorithm belongs to the technical field of crowd emergency evacuation. The invention aims to solve the problems that the traditional path planning method is easy to fall into a local optimal solution, evacuation efficiency is low due to no consideration of personnel density and environmental complexity, and the time required for path searching is long. According to the method, a ship path network is generated according to nodes and paths in the ship; positioning the positions of all the people on the ship, taking the positions of the safety points in the ship path network as evacuation end points, calculating evacuation speed according to the position states and the environment states of all the people on the ship, taking the evacuation speed as a heuristic function of an ant colony algorithm, and planning evacuation paths based on the heuristic function to obtain an evacuation path set. The method can be applied to the technical field of crowd emergency evacuation.

title_en: Robot path planning method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a robot path planning method and device and the technical field of a shelter simulation test method, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting data of an environment; s2, calculating a preliminary path by using a preset algorithm based on the collected data; s3, performing an outer theory on the preliminary path to form a final navigation path; s4, dynamically adjusting the optimal path to adapt to emergencies or newly-appearing obstacles in the environment, combining the path planning method with the path planning device, and integrating various sensing technologies and intelligent algorithms, the method can more accurately identify and process the obstacles and the terrain features in the complex environment, remarkably improve the efficiency and the accuracy of path planning, improve the performance of path planning, expand the use environment and the application scene of the robot, and provide important technical support and innovation directions for the development of future robot technologies.

title_en: Urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method based on GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a GIS-based urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method, and relates to the technical field of earthquake hazard space risk assessment. The invention provides a GIS-based urban building earthquake hazard space risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of acquiring building, earthquake risk data and site condition data in an area, constructing a three-dimensional model of the building, and integrating an earthquake disaster database; constructing a seismological hazard scene simulation model, and generating a maximum displacement thermodynamic diagram of the building; based on building characteristics and earthquake motion parameters, obtaining the generation probability of secondary objects of the building and the object trajectory, and generating an object risk thermodynamic diagram; and obtaining and visualizing the space unit earthquake hazard risk according to the maximum displacement thermodynamic diagram and the falling object risk thermodynamic diagram of the building. Therefore, by adopting the method, a risk control basis is provided for disaster prevention and reduction planning, and decision support is provided for building reinforcement, danger avoidance area demarcation, emergency evacuation path planning and other aspects.

title_en: Crowdsourcing evacuation experimental device based on virtual reality
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public safety, in particular to a crowdsourcing evacuation experimental device based on virtual reality, which comprises the following components: the initial creation module is used for creating a plurality of experiment rooms and access links according to the target experiment; a virtual character module for assigning a birth point, an image and an animation of a virtual character and a virtual collision body to each participant entering each experimental room; the experimental process control module is used for setting a scene trigger in each experimental room and controlling the start and the end of a target experiment; the interaction and navigation module is used for providing collision simulation and arm shaking operation navigation for each participant so as to control the virtual character to execute actual evacuation behavior; the data acquisition module is used for acquiring log data and behavior data of each participant entering the experimental room to generate an experimental result. Therefore, the problems of incompatibility, low customizable and expandable performance, low reliability and the like of application programs in the current crowdsourcing VR evacuation experiment are solved.

title_en: Museum tour guide robot path planning method based on improved RRT fusion algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mobile robot path planning application, in particular to a museum guiding robot path planning method based on an improved RRT fusion algorithm. The invention further optimizes the output result of the RRT algorithm by using the ant colony algorithm to obtain a better static path, and then combines the improved DWA algorithm in path following to perform dynamic obstacle avoidance. Through the combination of the three algorithms, the length, the inflection point number and the smoothness of the static path are optimized, and the adaptability problem of the dynamic environment can be solved. The navigation robot can automatically navigate in the museum by means of built-in sensors and map data, avoid obstacles, understand the questions and instructions of tourists through a voice recognition technology, generate answers by using a natural language processing technology, respond to the tourists with natural sounds through a voice synthesis technology, and can provide emergency information and assist evacuation in emergency situations such as fire or injury of the tourists.

title_en: Dynamic emergency evacuation path planning and visual guiding method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency evacuation path planning and visual guiding method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: representing the building plan as a graph g= (V, E); initializing weights for each edge ; Collecting real-time environment data; judging whether fire disaster occurs according to the real-time environment data; if yes, starting an alarm signal; updating the weight of each edge according to the real-time environment data ; According to the weight of each edge Generating an optimal evacuation path by adopting an A-Star algorithm; visual guidance is carried out according to the optimal evacuation path; the invention can monitor the fire occurrence condition in the building in real time, dynamically generate a safe and reliable evacuation path, provide visual guidance, facilitate trapped people to evacuate rapidly and safely, and ensure the life safety of people.

title_en: Route planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method for collaborative search and rescue of trucks and unmanned aerial vehicles in mountain environments, and belongs to the field of path planning. Establishing a refuge site selection model according to the data parameters by acquiring population and refuge data of a disaster-stricken area and terrain and road network data of the area; and acquiring evacuation results of population points by using the site selection model, determining rescue priority by using an analytic hierarchy process, establishing a path planning model for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck, and acquiring a search and rescue scheme corresponding to the site selection result. According to the method, a proper refuge site selection model can be established under a mountain area environment to optimize site selection results, and meanwhile, the search and rescue mode under the cooperation of the carrier truck and the unmanned aerial vehicle is optimized, so that the search and rescue efficiency is improved, and the method is suitable for collaborative search and rescue of the unmanned aerial vehicle of the truck in the mountain area environment.

title_en: Indoor navigation system and method for fire emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of indoor navigation, in particular to an indoor navigation system and method for fire emergency. The system comprises a monitoring module, a positioning alarm module, an analysis prediction module, a path adjustment module and a sharing module, wherein the path adjustment module is used for collecting the personnel density in the optimal escape path formulated in the analysis prediction module, when the optimal escape path personnel reach a saturation threshold value, the personnel are distributed and escape through avoiding the saturation area of the optimal escape path, so that the whole evacuation time can be shortened, the survival chance under the emergency conditions such as fire disaster is increased, meanwhile, the optimal escape path personnel are prevented from being excessively concentrated in certain areas, the trampling risk caused by congestion is reduced, and the secondary injury of the personnel in the escape process is avoided.

title_en: Escape route guidance system, portable device and escape route signs
abstract_en: The invention regards an escape route guiding system comprising a plurality of emergency signs (2, 3) provided with a communication module (5), and at least one portable device (6, 7) provided with a communication module. The communication modules of the emergency signs (2, 3) and of the portable device (6, 7) are configured to establish a communication with each other enabling positioning of the portable device (6, 7) The system comprises a memory (11) storing individual information associated with the portable device (6, 7), wherein the individual information comprises at least one of preferences, habits and attributes. An information processing unit (10) is configured to determine information on an individualized escape route based on the individual information and to transmit the determined information to the at least one emergency sign and/or the portable device (6, 7). The at least one emergency sign (2, 3) and/or the at least one portable device (6, 7) is configured to output at least some of the determined information on the individualized escape route.

title_en: Mountain area flood emergency risk avoiding path planning method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, and discloses a mountain area flood emergency risk avoidance path planning method, which constructs a flood evolution model according to the topographic data and rainfall data of an area to be researched; and constructing a risk avoiding path planning model according to the intelligent body model and the flood disaster risk assessment model, and planning a mountain area flood emergency risk avoiding path. The risk avoiding path planning method provided by the invention has the advantages that the flexibility and the adaptability of the risk avoiding path are obviously improved, the dynamic adjustment and the optimization can be carried out in real time according to the water situation and the disaster situation, and the crowd evacuation precision and the risk avoiding early warning timeliness are ensured. The method effectively overcomes the limitation of the prior art, provides a more scientific, efficient and reliable solution for flood control and disaster reduction in mountainous areas, and protects the life safety of people to the greatest extent.

title_en: Toxic gas leakage accident evacuation path planning method considering panic psychology of personnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a toxic gas leakage accident evacuation path planning method considering the panic psychology of personnel, which relates to the field of dangerous chemical accident emergency and chemical safety planning, and comprises the steps of constructing a factory road network; dividing a toxic gas leakage diffusion influence area, calculating the average concentration value of toxic gas on road sections of a road network falling into different toxic gas concentration ranges, calculating the average walking speed of personnel on the road sections, solving the toxic load of a path formed by each road section, constructing an evacuation model and solving. According to the invention, the multi-factor coupling effects such as personnel characteristics, toxic gas leakage and road conditions are fully considered, the optimal evacuation path is obtained by solving the evacuation model, the safety and effectiveness of the evacuation process can be improved, and the method has a good application prospect in the fields of dangerous chemical production and storage and transportation.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC RESEARCH INSTITUTE SAFETY ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Emergency lighting control system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of emergency lighting, in particular to an emergency lighting control system which comprises a controller and emergency indicator lamps arranged in each fire-fighting indication area, wherein the controller comprises a main control module, a power supply module, a controller lamp panel and an industrial computer, and a fire alarm signal interface for inputting fire alarm signals and a lamp interface for connecting the emergency indicator lamps are reserved on the main control module. Compared with the prior art, the emergency lighting control system provided by the utility model has the advantages that the disaster place can be known at the first time, the optimal escape route corresponding to each fire-fighting indication area of the whole building is determined, the optimal route guidance of people is provided by controlling the emergency indication lamps at each position to display the escape route direction and the distance of the relative safety exit, the personnel evacuation efficiency is improved, and the risk of being damaged by the disaster is reduced.
assignees: WUHAN ZHONGSEN JIAOZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: System for providing emergency evacuation guidance service for disaster vulnerabel population based on speech recognition
title_ko: 피난약자를 위한 음성인식 기반 피난유도 서비스 제공 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a voice recognition-based evacuation guidance service providing system for vulnerable evacuees. The evacuation guidance service providing system comprises: a disaster detection device configured to detect at least one disaster and output a disaster detection event; a user terminal configured to be woken up in response to the disaster detection event of the disaster detection device, extract an evacuation route based on the current location, provide guidance along the extracted evacuation route, recognize voice utterances through voice recognition, and provide guidance according to the evacuation route; at least one beacon installed on at least one node for tracking the location of the user terminal and transmitting location information corresponding to the at least one node; and an evacuation guidance service providing server comprising a database formation unit, a transmission unit, an evacuation route providing unit, a route guidance unit, a voice recognition unit, and a deviation prevention unit.
abstract_ko: 피난약자를 위한 음성인식 기반 피난유도 서비스 제공 시스템이 제공되며, 재난감지장치의 재난감지 이벤트에 따라 웨이크업(Wakeup)되고, 현위치를 기반으로 피난경로를 추출하며, 추출된 피난경로에 따라 피난경로를 안내하고, 음성발화를 음성인식으로 인식한 후 피난경로에 따른 안내를 실시하는 사용자 단말, 사용자 단말의 위치추적을 위해 적어도 하나의 노드(Node)에 설치되고, 적어도 하나의 노드에 대응하는 위치정보를 전송하는 적어도 하나의 비콘 및 적어도 하나의 건물에 재난상황이 발생했을 시 적어도 하나의 재난 시나리오에 따른 적어도 하나의 피난경로를 저장하는 데이터베이스화부, 재난감지장치로부터 재난감지 이벤트가 발생하는 경우 사용자 단말로 전달하는 전달부, 사용자 단말에서 재난감지 이벤트를 수신하여 웨이크업된 경우, 사용자 단말의 현위치를 기반으로 피난경로를 추출하고, 추출된 피난경로를 사용자 단말로 전송하는 피난경로제공부, 사용자 단말에서 피난경로를 기반으로 경로를 안내할 때 적어도 하나의 비콘을 통하여 사용자 단말의 위치를 추적하면서 경로를 안내하도록 하는 경로안내부, 사용자 단말에서 음성발화가 입력된 경우, 사용자 단말의 음성발화를 음성인식으로 인식한 후 음성발화에 대응하는 텍스트에 대응하는 응답을 사용자 단말로 전송하는 음성인식부를 포함하는 피난유도 서비스 제공 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster safety risk avoiding method and device based on distribution
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for safely avoiding danger of tunnel fire based on distribution. The method is characterized by comprising the steps of obtaining section sensor data and tunnel section image data of a tunnel section, carrying out fire disaster identification on the tunnel section based on the section sensor data and the tunnel section image data, determining fire disaster identification information, considering that fire disasters exist in the tunnel section and obtaining safety node information of the tunnel section under the condition that the fire disaster identification information is the section fire disaster position and the section fire disaster hazard degree, carrying out section path planning according to the safety node information and the fire disaster identification information of the tunnel section, determining at least one safety path information, uploading the safety path information to a tunnel safety center, receiving a target evacuation route issued by the tunnel safety center, and carrying out danger avoidance prompt according to the target evacuation route. The data of the edge nodes can be fused, the optimal emergency evacuation and escape scheme is obtained, the tunnel disaster change is adapted, and the flexibility and the adaptability of the system are improved.

title_en: Multi-dimensional fire safety management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety, in particular to a multi-dimensional fire safety management system, which comprises an environment monitoring module, a data analysis module, a real-time video monitoring module, an intelligent decision module and an adaptive evacuation navigation module, wherein the environment monitoring module is used for collecting environment data, the data analysis module is used for processing and analyzing the collected environment data, the real-time video monitoring module monitors the internal condition of a building by adopting a high-resolution camera, the intelligent decision module generates a fire disaster response strategy, the adaptive evacuation navigation module dynamically generates and updates a safe evacuation route in the building, and the self-adaptive evacuation navigation module is introduced to dynamically generate and update the safe evacuation route in the building. By analyzing the development of fire conditions and the distribution condition of personnel in a building in real time, the system can adjust evacuation routes according to the current environmental conditions, effectively avoid personnel from entering a high-risk area by mistake, and ensure that the personnel can be guided to a safety area rapidly and orderly in an emergency.
assignees: QINGDAO TONGREN BUILDING FIRE PROT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of path planning technologies, and in particular, to a method, a system, and a storage medium for planning an emergency evacuation path. The method comprises the steps of obtaining building layout data, carrying out building structure topology analysis on the building layout data to generate building structure layout data, carrying out monitoring equipment arrangement according to the building structure layout data to obtain monitoring equipment arrangement data, carrying out environment sensing on monitoring equipment based on the monitoring equipment arrangement data to generate environment sensing data, carrying out static image acquisition on the environment sensing data to obtain static environment images, carrying out channel connection on the static environment images to generate building channel distribution data, and carrying out potential dangerous channel area identification on the building channel distribution data through the static environment images to generate potential dangerous channel area data. The invention improves the flexibility and accuracy of emergency evacuation path planning by integrating environment awareness, dynamic video stream analysis and intelligent path scheduling.
assignees: HAINAN VOCATIONAL UNIV OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

title_en: GNSS-based gas detection system for path planning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas detection system for path planning based on GNSS, which solves the technical problems that in a gas leakage place, personnel safety cannot be ensured and evacuation or rescue efficiency is low in the process of evacuating or carrying out rescue. Comprises a position sharing device and a plurality of advance detectors which are distributed in the gas leakage places and are respectively connected with the position sharing device. The detector firstly moves before the personnel, after detecting the gas type and concentration in the place, the dangerous area is calibrated, the position corresponding to the dangerous area is sent to the position sharing device, the personnel selects a proper path to evacuate or rescue through the dangerous area position displayed on the position sharing device.

title_en: Medical and nutritional combined building fire-fighting evacuation refuge system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical and nutritional combined building fire evacuation refuge system which comprises a modeling module for partition arrangement of different movement capacities, a safety exit and refuge position setting module, a medical and nutritional combined building fire evacuation refuge method, wherein the modeling module is used for partition arrangement of buildings according to the movement capacities and the cognitive capacities of resident groups, the safety exit and refuge position setting module is used for setting the positions of the safety exit and the refuge according to the partition arrangement results, the medical and nutritional combined building fire evacuation refuge method is applicable to any refuge system, and comprises the following steps of S1, building partition and safety arrangement, S2, evacuation path planning and dynamic adjustment, S3, fire monitoring and personalized evacuation indication, and S4, auxiliary evacuation strategies and equipment use. According to the invention, by means of classifying modeling of different crowds and dynamically adjusting the width of the evacuation channel, the residence time of people in a fire disaster can be effectively reduced, and the size and configuration of the refuge can be adjusted according to actual conditions.
assignees: NANJING CITY ARCH DESIGN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Building fire control thing networking system alarm device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm device of a building fire-fighting Internet of things system, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting alarm, and comprises a detection part and an alarm part, wherein the detection part comprises a mounting plate and a detection module, the alarm part comprises an upper layer box body, a lower layer box body and an alarm navigation mask, a projection lamp, an LED lamp and a loudspeaker are arranged outside the upper layer box body, a controller and a dispersing assembly are arranged inside the upper layer box body, and the alarm navigation mask is hoisted below the dispersing assembly.
