The invention can project alarming characters on a wall, and can attract the attention of people with visual impairment and people with hearing impairment to receive alarming information in time through the flashing light, the display screen can synchronously display accurate fire places, provide accurate information for people, plan escape routes and avoid fire areas, and can automatically drop the alarming navigation mask, the alarming navigation mask is provided with voice broadcasting and character display functions, provides escape routes for trapped people, and simultaneously synchronizes the positions to rescue workers, thereby facilitating search and rescue.
assignees: JINAN NOAH EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency traffic evacuation path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a planning method and a planning system for emergency traffic evacuation paths, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of pieces of sound information of an emergency area, analyzing sound texts and sound types corresponding to each piece of sound information according to a voice analysis algorithm, determining vehicle danger probabilities corresponding to a plurality of subareas of the emergency area according to the sound texts and the sound types corresponding to each piece of sound information, and calculating evacuation paths corresponding to the emergency area according to the vehicle danger probabilities corresponding to the subareas. Therefore, the invention can effectively utilize the sound information of the emergency area to carry out route planning, improve the safety and efficiency of route planning and reduce further loss.
assignees: GUANGZHOU INST OF GEOGRAPHY GUANGDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Multi-ship anchoring scheduling path planning method based on improved RRT algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-ship mooring scheduling path planning method based on an improved RRT algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-ship mooring scheduling destination selection mechanism, S2, constructing a multi-ship mooring scheduling evaluation index selection mechanism, S3, calculating ship scheduling priority according to the multi-ship mooring scheduling evaluation index, S4, constructing a multi-ship mooring scheduling collision avoidance decision mechanism, and S5, calculating a multi-ship mooring scheduling path planning result. The invention can be used for coping with the situation that a plurality of ships need to be moored and scheduled at the same time, optimizes the berthing sequence and the navigation path of the ships, thereby minimizing the waiting time of the ship mooring and scheduling, reducing the navigation distance of all the scheduled ships as much as possible, improving the berthing utilization rate, and has important significance in the aspects of complex water area multi-ship scheduling, ship emergency evacuation, comprehensive management of water traffic hub and the like.
assignees: CHINA COMM CONSTR CO 2ND HARBOR CONSULTANTS CO LTD;CCCC XIDI TECH WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic disaster evacuation path planning method and system based on network flow model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency traffic evacuation and path planning, and provides a dynamic disaster evacuation path planning method and system based on a network flow model, wherein the method comprises the following steps of determining an evacuation area of an evacuation event; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the number of vehicles to be evacuated in an evacuation area, determining evacuation traffic distribution of the evacuation area according to the distribution condition of the vehicles to be evacuated, generating a path network model according to vector geographic data and the evacuation traffic distribution, wherein the path network model comprises network nodes consisting of evacuation source points, evacuation sink points and road network intersections and edges consisting of road network road segments, constructing an event dynamic evacuation model according to the path network model, searching minimum cost-maximum flow paths from the evacuation source points to the evacuation sink points in the evacuation road network based on the event dynamic evacuation model, and distributing the vehicles to be evacuated of each evacuation source point until evacuation planning is completed according to search results. The invention improves the evacuation efficiency, reduces the evacuation time and realizes quick, orderly and safe evacuation.
assignees: STARGIS TIANJIN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Personnel evacuation route planning method and system during gas leakage
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for planning a personnel evacuation route in gas leakage, and relates to the technical field of route planning, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending a unique identity, a coordinate and a gas type supporting detection to a path safety controller through a gas link control protocol; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a registration request by a path safety controller to generate a visual topological graph, receiving weight configuration by the path safety controller and sending the weight configuration to a gas detection device, calculating leakage risk values by the gas detection device, reporting the leakage risk values to the path safety controller, analyzing leakage risks of all paths by the controller to generate an optimal evacuation route and sending the optimal evacuation route, and triggering an alarm and indicating the path by the gas detection device based on the optimal evacuation route to trigger the alarm and indicate the evacuation direction. According to the application, through automatic registration, real-time topological graph generation, dynamic weight configuration and optimal path planning, the efficiency and safety of personnel evacuation during gas leakage are obviously improved.

title_en: Nuclear power station accident emergency evacuation path generation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a generation method of an emergency evacuation path of a nuclear power station accident, which relates to the technical field of path generation and comprises the steps of collecting topographic feature information, building distribution information and traffic road data within a calibration radius range which is centered on the nuclear power station, constructing a calibration range scene model, responding to an accident alarm signal, obtaining an accident type and an accident source position, collecting an article position list and an article type list through a monitoring camera, conducting spreading analysis to obtain a spreading position set, conducting spreading path prediction to obtain an accident prediction spreading path, conducting shortest path planning by taking an evacuation target area outside the calibration radius range as the basis of the accident prediction spreading path, obtaining a recommended evacuation path, and sending the recommended evacuation path to an evacuation management end. The invention solves the technical problems that the path planning method in the prior art generally performs path planning according to the accident state, so that the path planning has poor advance and the safety of the evacuation crowd cannot be ensured.

title_en: Evacuation indication system and evacuation indication method for subway carriage
abstract_en: The application provides an evacuation indication system and an evacuation indication method for subway carriages, wherein the system comprises a fire monitoring module, a crowd density monitoring module, a train central control module and a multi-information combined intelligent evacuation indication module; the system comprises a fire monitoring module, a crowd density monitoring module, a train central control module, a multi-information combined intelligent evacuation indication module and a passenger transmission module, wherein the fire monitoring module is used for monitoring fire data in each subway carriage and generating a dangerous alarm signal according to the fire data, the crowd density monitoring module is used for monitoring crowd density data in each subway carriage, the train central control module is used for planning an evacuation strategy of each subway carriage according to the dangerous alarm signal and the crowd density data, and the multi-information combined intelligent evacuation indication module is used for transmitting the evacuation strategy of each subway carriage to passengers by using various information transmission modes. Therefore, real-time evacuation route guidance can be provided for passengers, passengers can be effectively prevented from mistakenly entering a dangerous area where fire smoke spreads and crowded subway carriages, and accordingly evacuation efficiency and evacuation safety are improved.
assignees: CRRC CHANGCHUN RAILWAY VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Guidance system for visually impaired using audible pedestrian signal
title_ko: 음향신호기를 이용한 시각장애인 안내시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a guidance system for the visually impaired using an audible pedestrian signal and, more particularly, to a guidance system for the visually impaired using an audible pedestrian signal, which provides accurate route guidance to the visually impaired and enables the visually impaired to safely cross a crosswalk by using the location of an audible pedestrian signal installed at a crosswalk to provide route guidance and information for crossing the crosswalk, and enables quick and effective evacuation in the event of a disaster by providing guidance according to disaster through the audible pedestrian signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 음향신호기를 이용한 시각장애인 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 횡단보도에 설치되는 음향신호기의 위치를 이용하여 시각장애인에게 길 안내 및 횡단보도를 건너기 위한 정보를 제공하도록 함으로써, 시각장애인에게 정확한 길 안내를 제공하고 안전하게 횡단보도를 건널 수 있도록 하며, 음향신호기를 통해 재난에 따른 안내가 이루어지도록 하여 재난발생시 신속하고 효과적인 대피가 가능하도록 하는 음향신호기를 이용한 시각장애인 안내시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Real-time people counting and disaster evacuation guidance system and method using uwb communication device
title_ko: Uwb 통신 장치를 이용한 실시간 인원계수(apc)와 재난 대피로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A real-time personnel coefficient (APC) and disaster evacuation route guidance method using a UWB communication device according to the present invention comprises the steps of: (a) acquiring, by APC equipment, personnel coefficient information or environment information of a site; (b) determining, by the APC equipment, whether a disaster occurs in the site in real time while acquiring the environment information; (c) providing, by the apc equipment, a disaster evacuation route to a user terminal at a location in the site confirmed through UWB communication when a disaster occurs in the step (b); (d) determining, by the APC equipment, whether an evacuation completion signal has been received from the user terminal; and (e) terminating, by the APC equipment, disaster evacuation route guidance when the evacuation completion signal is received from the user terminal. When a disaster occurs, it is possible to accurately identify the location of an occupant and the location of a fire through the UWB transmission/reception equipment included in the APC equipment of the workplace and the UWB transmission/reception function in the user's mobile phone, thereby minimizing casualties.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 UWB 통신 장치를 이용한 실시간 인원계수(APC)와 재난 대피로 안내 방법은 (a) APC 장비가 현장의 인원계수정보 또는 환경정보를 획득하는 단계; (b) 상기 APC 장비가 환경정보를 획득하면서 현장의 재난발생 여부를 실시간으로 판단하는 단계; (c) 상기 APC 장비가 상기 (b)단계에서 재난이 발생한 경우 UWB 통신을 통해 확인된 현장내 위치의 사용자 단말기에 재난대피경로를 제공하는 단계; (d) 상기 APC 장비가 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 대피완료신호를 수신했는지 판단하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 APC 장비가 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 대피완료신호를 수신한 경우 재난 대피로 안내를 종료하는 단계;를 포함하여 재난 상황 발생시 작업장의 APC 장비내에 포함된 UWB 송수신 장비와 사용자 핸드폰내 UWB 송수신 기능을 통한 정확한 재실자 위치 및 화재 위치를 파악할 수 있는 효과가 있고, 그로 인해 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and system for guiding evacuation routes in case of fire based on digital twin
title_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for guiding an evacuation route in accordance with a fire based on a digital twin. A method for guiding an evacuation route according to the occurrence of a fire may include the steps of: generating a space map including a virtual building corresponding to a real building based on a digital twin; performing a harmful substance diffusion simulation in the space map; predicting a harmful substance diffusion state in the real building using the result of the harmful substance diffusion simulation when a fire occurs in the real building; and guiding an evacuation route to a user based on the predicted harmful substance diffusion state.
abstract_ko: 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로를 안내하는 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다.  화재 발생에 따른 대피 경로 안내 방법은 디지털 트윈에 기초하여 현실 건물에 대응하는 가상 건물이 포함된 공간 맵을 생성하는 단계; 상기 공간 맵에서 유해물질 확산 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 단계; 상기 현실 건물에서 화재가 발생한 경우, 상기 유해물질 확산 시뮬레이션의 결과를 이용하여 상기 현실 건물에서의 유해 물질 확산 상태를 예측하는 단계; 및 예측한 유해 물질 확산 상태에 기초하여 사용자에게 대피 경로를 안내하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Vegetation coverage change monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing and AI intelligent analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to a vegetation coverage change monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing and AI intelligent analysis, and belongs to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring. The system comprises a satellite remote sensing data acquisition module, a data storage module for storing satellite remote sensing data, an AI intelligent analysis module for detecting vegetation coverage change conditions and disaster occurrence conditions according to the satellite remote sensing data, and a warning module for warning according to the disaster occurrence conditions. The invention builds a park scenic spot ecological change monitoring system based on satellite remote sensing and AI intelligent analysis, realizes comprehensive, accurate and real-time monitoring of the ecological condition of the park scenic spot, carries out regional division on the park scenic spot through the disaster analysis module, and provides an evacuation path according to the position relation of road sections, disaster areas and isolation zones by the path planning module so as to guide the evacuation module to lead disaster-stricken personnel to go to a safe area.

title_en: Intelligent lifesaving wheelchair and evacuation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of escape appliances in public places, and provides an intelligent lifesaving wheelchair and an evacuation method, the wheelchair comprises a wheelchair main body, an audible and visual alarm device, a voice broadcasting module, a gravity sensing module, a global searching module, a path planning module, an automatic obstacle avoidance module, a speed control module and a wireless transmission module. The wheelchair can normally meet the moving requirement of the weak group under the daily condition, can judge whether the wheelchair takes the weak individual or not when the danger occurs, can directly and automatically carry personnel to quickly escape if the wheelchair takes the weak individual, and can quickly escape after the wheelchair is found and carried if the wheelchair takes the weak individual. The invention can improve the evacuation efficiency and success rate of the weak groups after accidents occur in public places.
assignees: HANGZHOU RAILWAY DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Underground coal mining safety protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an underground coal mining safety protection method and system, and relates to the technical field of underground safety protection, wherein the method comprises the steps of installing a high-definition camera and a sensor, and collecting real-time video and data of a safety channel; extracting images from real-time video frame by frame, preprocessing the images, inputting the preprocessed images into YOLOv model, detecting obstacle and wall crack in the images, analyzing real-time data, judging whether abnormal condition exists, transmitting the detected condition and abnormal condition to a safety channel monitoring center for early warning, determining personnel position by using underground positioning system when emergency evacuation occurs, and sending instant notice to personnel through application program to indicate a problem-free safety channel. The invention can early warn the abnormal situation in the safety channel, ensure the safety channel to pass safely in the emergency situation, and provide navigation guidance for personnel when the emergency evacuation situation occurs underground, so that the personnel can arrive at the safety channel rapidly.
assignees: HUANENG COAL TECH RESEARCH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic allocation and path planning method for buses in multimode emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of bus distribution and path planning, and discloses a bus dynamic distribution and path planning method in multi-mode emergency evacuation, comprising the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-mode super-weighted directed graph considering buses and cars according to an urban multi-mode traffic network, emergency traffic demands and refuge distribution; and S2, establishing a bus dynamic allocation and path planning optimization model for multi-mode emergency evacuation according to the multi-mode super-weighted directed graph, and S3, calculating and generating a multi-mode dynamic traffic emergency evacuation scheme considering the bus dynamic allocation and path planning optimization. The invention can realize dynamic allocation and path planning of buses in multi-mode emergency evacuation, and further can help to improve emergency evacuation efficiency, thereby reducing life and property loss caused by emergencies, effectively describing dynamic characteristics and interactive influence of the multi-mode emergency evacuation system, and dynamically optimizing allocation and path planning of buses.

title_en: Fire control system and method for thermal power plant based on image processing
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire control systems, in particular to a fire control system and a fire control method for a thermal power plant based on image processing, which comprises a central control room, a detection alarm system and a fire control facility inspection system, wherein the detection alarm system consists of a fire detection system, an alarm and linkage control system, an emergency broadcasting and telephone system and a fire control area integrated cabinet, the alarm and linkage control system is internally provided with an information acquisition unit, an evacuation plan unit, an information transmission unit, a navigation generation unit, a disaster area fire extinguishing/fire fighting facility starting unit and a blocking plan unit, wherein the evacuation plan unit is internally provided with an evacuation information generation unit, an evacuation route generation unit and an edge updating feedback unit. The invention can reduce the problems of false alarm and missing report caused by equipment failure or aging, has a scheme for preventing fire from spreading and an emergency operation scheme for emergency treatment, and can ensure the passing of a safety officer as far as possible in the emergency operation scheme.

title_en: Disaster evacuation route guidance system and method using fire receiver and dats equipment
title_ko: 화재 수신기와 dats 장비를 이용한 재난 대피로 안내 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a disaster evacuation route guidance system using a fire receiver and data equipment comprises: a p-type fire receiver directly connected to a sensor for detecting heat or smoke to receive fire information; an r-type fire receiver to which the sensor is connected through a relay to receive fire information; a data device for collecting temperature and vibration data in a distributed linear sensor method from a collection device connected by an optical cable; a fire prevention server for receiving data from the p-type fire receiver, the r-type fire receiver, and the data device to determine whether there is a mistake, identifying a location where the corresponding fire occurred when an actual fire occurs, and generating and providing an evacuation route; and a user terminal for receiving the evacuation route from the fire prevention server and providing the evacuation route to a user. Accordingly, there is an effect of quickly and cleanly recognizing a fire occurrence place.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 화재 수신기와 DATS 장비를 이용한 재난 대피로 안내 시스템은 열 또는 연기를 감지하는 감지기와 직접 연결되어 화재 정보를 수신하는 P형 화재 수신기; 상기 감지기가 중계기를 통해 연결되어 화재 정보를 수신하는 R형 화재 수신기; 광케이블로 연결된 수집장치로부터 분포형 선형 센서 방식으로, 온도 및 진동 데이터를 수집하는 하는 DATS 장치; 상기 P형 화재 수신기, R형 화재 수신기, 및 DATS 장치로부터 데이터를 전달받아 오탐여부를 판단하고, 실제 화재가 발생한 경우, 해당 화재가 발생한 위치를 파악하고, 대피로를 생성하여 제공하는 소방방재 서버; 및 상기 소방방재 서버로부터 대피로를 전달받아 사용자에게 제공하는 사용자 단말기;를 포함하여 빠르고 정화하게 화재 발생 장소 인식할 수 는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for guiding disaster evacuation routes in dangerous areas using automatic people counter
title_ko: 자동인원계수기를 이용한 위험지역 재난 대피경로 안내장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a disaster evacuation route guide device comprises: a display unit; a personnel counter counting the number of personnel entering and exiting a predetermined area in real time and displaying the counted number on the display unit; an automatic personnel counter including an image collection unit collecting a fire image when a fire occurs in the predetermined area; and a management server connected to the automatic personnel counter through a communication network. The management server sums the real-time personnel count signals when receiving the real-time personnel count signals to display the real-time number of occupants in the predetermined area on the display unit, and converts a screen of the display unit to generate an evacuation route and display the evacuation route on the display unit when receiving the fire image. Therefore, the present invention collects and transmits emergency situation information generated in a predetermined area in real time by using an automatic personnel counting device pre-installed in the predetermined area to count and display the number of persons entering and exiting the predetermined area classified as a dangerous area in real time, thereby quickly grasping a disaster generated in the dangerous area without installing additional equipment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서 제공하는 재난대피경로 안내장치는, 디스플레이부; 소정영역에 출입하는 인원을 실시간으로 계수하여 상기 디스플레이부에 표시하는 인원계수기; 및 상기 소정영역에 화재발생시 화재영상을 수집하는 영상수집부를 포함하는 자동인원계수장치; 및 상기 자동인원계수장치와 통신망으로 연결된 관리서버를 포함하되, 상기 관리서버는 실시간 인원계수신호 수신시 상기 실시간 인원계수신호를 합계처리하여 상기 소정영역 내의 실시간 재실자수를 상기 디스플레이부에 표시하고, 상기 화재영상 수신시 대피경로를 생성하여 상기 디스플레이부에 표시하도록 상기 디스플레이부의 화면을 전환한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 위험지역으로 분류된 소정영역에 출입하는 인원을 실시간으로 계수 및 표시하기 위해 상기 소정영역에 기 설치된 자동인원계수장치를 이용하여 상기 소정영역에 발생한 위급상황정보를 실시간으로 수집 및 전송하도록 함으로써, 추가적인 장비의 설치 없이, 위험지역에 발생한 재난을 신속하게 파악할 수 있도록 하는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for guiding disaster evacuation route using automatic people counter and indoor positioning function
title_ko: 자동인원계수기 및 실내측위기술을 이용한 재난대피경로 안내 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an apparatus and a method for guiding a disaster evacuation route, which preemptively respond to risk factors caused by the spread of fire and induce evacuation to a safe area in real time. The apparatus for guiding a disaster evacuation route comprises: a fire detector for generating fire occurrence time information and fire occurrence location information when a fire occurs; indoor positioning equipment for measuring the location of a person or an object located in the indoor space; personnel counting equipment for counting the number of people entering and exiting the indoor space; a fire spread prediction unit for storing a pre-generated fire spread model and predicting fire spread by applying the fire occurrence time information and the fire occurrence location information to the fire spread model when a fire is detected by the fire detector; and an evacuation route calculation unit for calculating an evacuation route by reflecting the result of the fire spread prediction, the number of occupants, and the result of the indoor positioning. According to the present invention, there is an advantage of inducing safe evacuation of occupants as well as enabling an effective structure.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서 제공하는 재난대피경로 안내장치는, 임의의 실내공간에 대한 화재 발생여부를 탐지하고, 화재 발생시 화재발생시각정보, 및 화재발생위치정보를 생성하는 화재탐지기; 실내측위를 수행하여, 상기 실내공간에 위치한 사람 또는 사물의 위치를 측량하는 실내측위장비; 상기 실내공간의 출입구에 설치되어 상기 실내공간으로 출입하는 인원을 카운트하는 인원계수장비; 화재발생시 화재확산속도, 및 화재확산방향에 영향을 미치는 상기 실내공간의 특성정보를 이용하여 미리 생성된 화재확산모델을 저장하고, 상기 화재탐지기에서 화재가 탐지된 경우 상기 화재발생시각정보 및 화재발생위치정보를 상기 화재확산모델에 적용하여 화재확산을 예측하는 화재확산예측부; 및 상기 인원계수장비, 및 상기 실내측위장비로부터, 상기 실내공간 내에 위치한 재실자의 인원수 및 실내측위 결과를 수집한 후, 상기 화재확산예측 결과, 상기 재실자의 인원수, 및 실내측위 결과를 반영하여 대피경로를 산정하는 대피경로 산정부를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 화재의 확산속도 및 확산방향을 예측한 후 그 결과를 반영한 대피경로를 산정함으로써, 화재의 확산에 따른 위험 요소에 대하여 선제적으로 대응하고 실시간으로 안전지역까지 대피를 유도할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Intelligent rescue assisting method and system for high-rise building fire disaster
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent security, in particular to an intelligent evacuation assisting method and system for fire disaster of a high-rise building, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring environmental information by a base station subsystem and providing positioning information for a mobile terminal subsystem and an unmanned aerial vehicle subsystem; the vision subsystem acquires image information of safety exits in each floor, and people flow density distribution information is obtained based on the image information; the upper computer subsystem displays the motion trail of the firefighter and the unmanned aerial vehicle and carries out real-time navigation; the invention can improve survival probability of people in distress and reduce risk of firemen.

title_en: Intelligent fire control operation command auxiliary decision-making system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent fire fighting command auxiliary decision-making system, which belongs to the field of fire rescue and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module, an intelligent decision-making module, a communication module, a positioning and navigation module and a storage module. The system collects fire scene environmental data and firefighter status data via various sensor devices, and then uses a data processing module for data cleaning and identification. The intelligent decision-making module generates a fire extinguishing strategy and personnel scheduling suggestions to assist commanders in making decisions. The system also monitors the positions of firefighters and fire trucks in real time using GPS or other positioning technology and generates fire extinguishing paths and personnel evacuation paths. The system also includes a storage module for storing the historical data and the decision process. The design can better assist fire commanders in making decisions, and improves the efficiency and effect of fire rescue.
assignees: CHENGDU HIGH TECH VISION DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban planning simulation system based on live-action three-dimension
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city planning simulation system based on live three-dimensional, which relates to the technical field of city planning and comprises a data acquisition module, a live three-dimensional and disaster simulation module, a comprehensive planning module and a comprehensive evaluation module; according to the invention, by utilizing a path planning algorithm, an area affected by the damaged infrastructure and the recovery time of the infrastructure are considered, so that an optimal emergency evacuation route is planned, the safety and feasibility of the evacuation route are ensured, the evacuation efficiency is greatly improved, meanwhile, the type and layout of the rescue facility are determined according to the emergency evacuation route planning result and the infrastructure toughness evaluation result, the service range and coverage degree of the rescue facility are analyzed through a geographic information system, the layout of the rescue facility is optimized, and the rescue resource is ensured to efficiently and accurately reach the disaster-affected area.

title_en: Earthquake early warning terminal civil air defense refuge positioning system, method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system, a method, equipment and a medium for positioning civil air defense refuge of an earthquake early warning terminal. The evacuation route management system comprises a map data management module and a route planning module, wherein the map data management module is used for acquiring personnel position coordinates, sending an indoor map with personnel position marks to the route planning module based on the personnel position coordinates marked in the indoor map, and the route planning module is used for taking the personnel position coordinates in the indoor map as a starting node and taking refuge place coordinates as target nodes, extracting key information from the indoor map, determining intermediate nodes according to the key information, and calculating each node based on a route planning algorithm to generate an evacuation route. The map data management module can master the positions of the personnel, provides a basis for follow-up evacuation planning, plans by the path planning module by taking the actual positions of the personnel as starting points and taking refuge sites as end points, enables evacuation routes to be more targeted, can generate evacuation routes which are more in line with actual conditions by extracting key information in an indoor map, and improves evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Real-time path planning method and system for fire scene evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time path planning method and a real-time path planning system for fire evacuation, wherein the method comprises the steps of initializing a to-be-explored list FS, an explored list ES and a set P, judging whether the to-be-explored list FS is empty, backtracking to find a father node and output a path if the to-be-explored list FS is empty, setting a grid with the minimum cost as a current grid G  i  if the to-be-explored list FS is not empty, adding a neighbor grid G  j  into the to-be-explored list FS, judging whether the current grid G  j  is equal to a target network G  t , backtracking to find the father node and output a path if the current grid G  j  is equal to the target network G  t , otherwise checking the neighbor grid G  j  of the grid G  i , judging whether the neighbor grid G  j  is not in the explored list ES, adding the to-be-explored list FS, continuously returning to judge whether the to-be-explored list FS is empty or not, otherwise ignoring the grid G  j , continuously returning to judge whether the to be-explored list FS is empty. The invention can provide more accurate, real-time and globally considered evacuation path planning so as to ensure that people can be evacuated safely and quickly in a fire scene.

title_en: Smart fire detection response system with evacuation guidance function based on fire progress analysis and its control method
title_ko: 화재 진행 상태 분석 기반의 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 스마트 화재 감지 대응 시스템 및 이의 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart fire detection response system having an evacuation guidance function based on fire progress state analysis and a control method thereof, which can calculate an optimal evacuation route in the event of a fire and efficiently respond to the occurrence of a fire through an intuitive evacuation direction instruction. The smart fire detection response system comprises: a plurality of smart fire detection sensors installed in a building to detect the occurrence of a fire and transmit a fire occurrence alarm signal and fire information to a fire detection response server; a fire detection response server receiving the fire occurrence alarm signal and fire information from the smart fire detection sensor, analyzing a fire occurrence point and progress state, and transmitting an evacuation guidance control command to an evacuation guidance controller in the building based on the calculated optimal evacuation route; an evacuation guidance controller installed in the building and controlling the operation of a guidance indicator so that remaining personnel can evacuate to the optimal route by the evacuation guidance control command; and a plurality of guidance indicators installed in the building and separately displaying a fire occurrence direction and an evacuation direction so that the remaining personnel can evacuate to the optimal route under the control of the evacuation guidance controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화재 발생시에 최적의 대피 경로를 산출하여 직관적인 대피 방향 지시를 통하여 화재 발생에 대한 효율적인 대응이 가능하도록 한 화재 진행 상태 분석 기반의 대피 유도 기능을 갖는 스마트 화재 감지 대응 시스템 및 이의 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 건물내에 복수 개가 설치되어 화재 발생을 감지하여 화재발생 경보 신호 및 화재정보를 화재감지 대응 서버로 전송하는 스마트 화재감지 센서;스마트 화재감지 센서로부터 화재발생 경보 신호 및 화재정보를 수신하여 화재 발생 지점 및 진행 상태를 분석하여 산출된 최적 대피 경로를 기준으로 화재발생 건물내 대피유도 제어기로 대피 유도 제어 명령 전송하는 화재감지 대응 서버;건물내에 설치되고 대피 유도 제어 명령에 의해 잔류 인원들이 최적의 경로로 대피할 수 있도록 안내표시기의 동작을 제어하는 대피유도 제어기;건물내에 복수개가 설치되고 대피유도 제어기의 제어에 의해 잔류 인원들이 최적의 경로로 대피할 수 있도록 화재 발생 방향과 대피 방향을 구분하여 표시하는 안내 표시기;를 포함하는 것이다.
assignees: DONGEUI INSTITUTE OF TECH INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COORPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide evacuation route guidance to those who are stranded and potentially unlikely to return home in the case of a disaster.SOLUTION: Provided is a system comprising: means for transmitting an alert with evacuation route guidance to those who are stranded and potentially unlikely to return home depending on the level of a disaster and a power crunch situation; means for predicting train delays, etc. on the basis of a power outage prediction or the observation of a rainfall or snowfall amount; and means for providing, regarding homecoming route, guidance of predicted congestion/traffic jams, estimated recovery time, etc.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Navigation controller and navigation method
abstract_en: To provide information having higher accuracy related to a location where a small-sized mobility can avoid rain during rainfall.SOLUTION: A control unit 20 which is a navigation controller comprises: a location information acquisition unit 21 which acquires location information indicating a present location of a micro mobility; a sensor data acquisition unit 23 which acquires sensor data from a sensor 13 which is disposed in the micro mobility and can detect whether or not a road surface is wet; a weather information acquisition unit 24 which acquires weather information; a determination unit 27 which determines that it is a section which does not get wet in rain or a spot for sheltering from the rain, when the weather information indicates rainfall and the sensor data indicates that the road surface is not wet, on the basis of acquired weather information and acquired sensor data; and a map information update unit 31 which adds a determined section which does not get wet in the rain or rain shelter information indicating the spot for sheltering from the rain, to map information stored in a map information storage unit 15.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: CVaR-based expressway dangerous chemical vehicle accident rescue and evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: A CVaR-based expressway dangerous chemical vehicle accident rescue and evacuation path planning method belongs to the technical field of traffic safety and emergency. The path planning method comprises the steps of obtaining a dangerous chemical vehicle transportation accident occurrence point, a rescue vehicle rescue point, an accident vehicle placement point (evacuation destination) and related parameters of a road network, comprehensively considering the shortest response time and highest efficiency of the rescue vehicle in a rescue stage for the path from the rescue vehicle rescue point to the accident occurrence point, establishing an upper layer rescue vehicle travel time shortest model, considering that a highway dangerous chemical vehicle transportation accident is extremely easy to generate a secondary accident, establishing a lower layer model based on CvaR secondary accident risk is minimum, forming a highway dangerous chemical vehicle accident rescue double-layer game planning model, and establishing an accident vehicle evacuation path planning model based on CVaR dangerous chemical leakage risk in consideration of the possibility of pollution generated by dangerous chemical leakage in the evacuation stage for the path from the accident occurrence point to the vehicle placement point of the dangerous chemical accident vehicle in the evacuation stage. The expressway dangerous chemical vehicle accident rescue and evacuation path planning method provided by the invention can improve the road traffic safety level and the emergency rescue efficiency, and ensure the smooth and orderly operation of expressway traffic.

title_en: Evacuation indication control method and system based on fire emergency lighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evacuation indication control method and system based on fire emergency lighting, and relates to the technical field of fire emergency lighting, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the invention can accurately grasp key information of fire occurrence position, smoke concentration and channel condition through real-time environment monitoring, dynamically evacuation path planning is carried out on the basis, multiple factors of channel traffic capacity, smoke concentration and distance from a safety exit are comprehensively considered, the safest and quickest evacuation route is ensured to be planned for a person, evacuation time is greatly shortened, and in addition, an emergency illumination brightness self-adaptive adjusting function ensures that people can clearly see evacuation paths and surrounding environments in different environments, so that evacuation speed and accuracy are further improved.
assignees: CHANGHUI TECH DEVELOPMENT NANTONG CO LTD

title_en: Crowd evacuation path planning method considering panic diffusion
abstract_en: The crowd evacuation path planning method considering panic spread comprises the steps of determining initial individual panic degree of each individual in a crowd of a target scene, determining adjacent individuals of each individual, updating the initial individual panic degree of each individual to obtain individual panic degree of each individual under panic transmission, conducting panic attenuation processing on the individual panic degree of each individual under panic transmission to obtain final individual panic degree at the current moment, determining predicted obstacle avoidance speed of each individual in the crowd of the target scene at the next moment to obtain final obstacle avoidance speed of the final individual panic degree updated at the next moment, and determining crowd evacuation planning paths based on the final obstacle avoidance speeds at all moments. According to the method, the crowd evacuation path planning is completed under the consideration of the influence of the panic emotion of the crowd, the authenticity of the crowd evacuation path planning simulation is improved, and the evacuation efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a venue building evacuation route planning and security elimination management method based on digital operation and maintenance, which relates to the technical field of intelligent fire control management and comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model of a venue building based on BIM and Internet of things, and constructing a fire monitoring model by using the digital twin model and fire emergency event instance data; acquiring real-time multi-source security data through fire control equipment of a venue building to perform fire detection and early warning, determining fire scene dynamic parameters to update a fire monitoring model, and acquiring fire dynamic characteristics of different venue building areas; and acquiring key factors influencing evacuation efficiency, planning evacuation paths by combining an improved mouse swarm algorithm, and visually displaying the optimal evacuation paths of different venue building areas according to a preset mode. According to the invention, evacuation path planning and overall monitoring and management of fire safety of a venue are dynamically performed in real time according to the development situation of a fire disaster, so that loss in emergency situations such as the fire disaster is reduced.
assignees: ZHEJIANG UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY ENGINEERING DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Disaster evacuation route guidance system
title_ko: 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a disaster evacuation route guidance system comprising: an identification unit for identifying an evacuation target person in a managed area; a disaster monitoring unit for collecting environmental information in the managed area and determining whether a disaster situation occurs in the managed area; a dangerous area analysis module for selecting a disaster dangerous area that may be dangerous when the evacuation target person approaches within the managed area when it is determined that a disaster situation has occurred; an evacuation route calculation module for generating an evacuation route through which the evacuation target person in the managed area can evacuate to a preset safety area without passing through the disaster dangerous area; and an information providing server for providing information on the evacuation route calculated by the evacuation route calculation module to the evacuation target person. According to the present invention, the disaster evacuation route guidance system calculates an expected spread route of a corresponding disaster when the disaster occurs in a management target area, and generates an evacuation route not to overlap the expected spread route, thereby guiding an evacuation target person to more safely evacuate from the management target area to a safe area.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 관리대상 지역 내의 대피 대상자를 식별하는 식별유닛과, 상기 관리대상 지역 내의 환경 정보를 수집하고, 수집된 환경 정보를 토대로 해당 관리대상 지역에서의 재난 상황 발생 여부를 판별하는 재난 감시 유닛과, 상기 재난 감시 유닛에서 해당 관리대상 지역에서 재난 상황이 발생된 것으로 판별되면, 해당 관리대상 지역 내에서 상기 대피 대상자가 접근시 위험할 수 있는 재난 위험 영역을 선별하는 위험영역 분석모듈과, 해당 식별유닛에서 제공받은 식별정보를 토대로 상기 관리대상 지역 내의 대피 대상자가 상기 재난 위험 영역을 지나지 않고 기설정된 안전영역으로 대피할 수 있는 대피경로를 생성하는 대피 경로 산출모듈과, 상기 대피 경로 산출모듈에서 산출된 대피경로에 대한 정보를 상기 대피 대상자에게 제공하는 정보제공서버를 구비한다.  
본 발명에 따른 재난 대피 경로 안내 시스템은 관리대상 지역 내에 재난이 발생시 해당 재난의 확산 예상 경로를 산출하고, 해당 확산 예상 경로와 겹쳐지지 않도록 대피경로를 생성하므로 대피 대상자가 관리대상 지역에서 보다 안전하게 안전지역으로 대피하도록 안내할 수 있다는 장점이 있다.

title_en: High-adaptability intelligent emergency evacuation and safety navigation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of fire safety devices, in particular to a high-adaptability intelligent emergency evacuation and safety navigation system. The intelligent adjustable support comprises a central processing unit, an environment monitoring module group, a personnel positioning and evacuation guiding module group, a projection device module group, a voice broadcasting system module group, an intelligent adjustable support and an emergency energy source guaranteeing module group, wherein the environment monitoring module group, the personnel positioning and evacuation guiding module group, the projection device module group, the voice broadcasting system module group, the intelligent adjustable support and the emergency energy source guaranteeing module group are connected with the central processing unit, the intelligent adjustable support specifically comprises a mounting support which is mounted on a wall body, one side of the mounting support is provided with a supporting rod, and a rotating rod is rotatably connected between the two groups of supporting rods. The utility model has novel and compact structure, is suitable for the use of a safe fire-fighting escape system, ensures the correct escape route to be guided according to the actual emergency route adjustment, reduces the danger, is more perfect, and can comprehensively assist the evacuation, emergency rescue and other works of trapped people from real-time emergency scene display, disaster behavior prediction, optimal escape path planning, AI man-machine interaction and the like.
assignees: CN RAILWAY SIYUAN SURVEY & DES;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Intelligent management system and method for emergency evacuation places
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent evacuation of chemical plant areas and discloses an intelligent management system and method for emergency evacuation places, wherein the intelligent management method for emergency evacuation places comprises the steps of constructing a chemical risk semantic unified characterization space by using a risk semantic mapping algorithm, and generating a mapping relation between a risk state and semantic expression; the method comprises the steps of generating employee feature characterization models by applying a feature image algorithm, generating personalized semantic guidance aiming at employees with different features based on a chemical risk semantic personalized adaptation model, generating a multi-level chemical risk semantic model by applying an area hierarchical clustering algorithm, processing real-time position and risk change data by a collective intelligent optimization algorithm, calculating a dynamic evacuation path planning scheme, realizing differential safety management based on employee feature, risk source distribution and semantic understanding, solving the inefficiency problem caused by a one-cut instruction in the traditional evacuation management, and improving emergency evacuation efficiency and safety of a chemical plant area.

title_en: System for alarming the occurrence of a fire based on a fire extinguisher stand
title_ko: 소화기 받침대에 기반한 화재 알람 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire alarm system based on a fire extinguisher stand on which a plurality of fire extinguishers distributed in a building are respectively mounted, and the fire alarm system based on a fire extinguisher stand on which a plurality of fire extinguishers distributed in a building are respectively mounted, comprises: a main body on which the fire extinguishers are mounted, a plurality of fire extinguisher stands that sense the occurrence of a fire based on at least one of CO, CO2, smoke, heat, flame, and an alarm sound, and then wirelessly notify the occurrence of the fire simultaneously with at least one of light and sound; and a central control device that registers and manages the plurality of smart stands, and when at least one of the plurality of smart stands wirelessly notifies the occurrence of a fire, causes all of the plurality of smart stands to forcibly perform a fire alarm operation, and the central control device further includes a function of calculating an evacuation route based on the position of the smart stand that notified the occurrence of a fire, and then additionally performing an evacuation route guidance operation using the plurality of smart stands.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건물에 분산 배치된 다수의 소화기 각각이 거치되는 소화기 받침대에 기반한 화재 알람 시스템에 관한 것으로, 이는 건물에 분산 배치된 다수의 소화기 각각이 거치되는 소화기 받침대에 기반한 화재 알람 시스템은, 소화기가 거치되는 본체를 구비하고, CO, CO2, 연기, 열, 화염 및 경보음 중 적어도 하나에 기반하여 화재 발생을 센싱한 후, 화재 발생을 빛과 소리 중 적어도 하나를 통해 알림과 동시에 무선 통보하는 다수의 소화기 받침대; 및 상기 다수의 스마트 받침대를 등록 관리하며, 상기 다수의 스마트 받침대 중 적어도 하나가 화재 발생을 무선 통보하면, 상기 다수의 스마트 받침대 모두가 화재 알람 동작을 강제 수행하도록 하는 중앙 관제 장치를 포함하며, 상기 중앙 관제 장치는 화재 발생을 통보한 스마트 받침대의 위치에 기반하여 대피 경로를 산출한 후, 상기 다수의 스마트 받침대를 이용한 대피 경로 안내 동작을 추가 수행하는 기능을 더 포함하는 중앙 관제 장치를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method, program, equipment and storage medium considering dynamic inclination of passenger ship
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation path planning method, program, equipment and storage medium considering dynamic inclination of a passenger ship, and belongs to the field of personnel evacuation simulation modeling. The method comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining a passenger ship inclination angle and a pedestrian moving direction, constructing a pedestrian speed attenuation factor reasoning model, 2, analyzing and modeling the influence of pedestrian mass movement on ship inclination, 3, introducing a congestion penalty factor, a safety penalty factor and an attenuation factor based on a path cost function of a D-Lite algorithm, obtaining a pre-planned path according to a leader starting point and an exit point, 4, presetting a re-planning triggering condition, when the preset triggering condition is met, taking a current node as a new starting point, and repeating the steps 1 to 4 to re-plan an evacuation route until the whole evacuation process is completed. When an emergency occurs, the method can adjust the evacuation strategy according to the inclination angle, the exit congestion and the passenger distribution, and obviously improve the evacuation efficiency and the safety in the passenger-ship evacuation scene.

title_en: Narrow-track escape route planning method and intelligent robot
abstract_en: The application provides a narrow-way getting rid of-trapped path planning method and an intelligent robot, the narrow-way getting rid of-trapped path planning method comprises the steps of 1, obtaining a minimum rectangular frame of a chassis of the robot, synchronously stretching the long side of the minimum rectangular frame to obtain a physical model V1 of the robot, generating a planned path S1 forward based on a cost map, 2, initializing a queue F and a set R, wherein the set R is used for storing accessed nodes C, taking the end point of the planned path S1 as an initial starting point O to be added into the queue F, calculating a free rotation angle A of each node in the queue F by using the physical model V1, 3, taking out the node C with the largest free rotation angle A from the queue F for access, adding all non-accessed neighbor nodes N of the node C into the queue F, and cycling the steps until the node C with the free rotation angle A being larger than the getting rid of-trapped rotation angle A  min  is taken as a getting rid of point E. The method of the application realizes the rapid escape of the non-circular chassis robot in the irregular narrow road.

title_en: Shelter Navigation System Based on GIS Information Through Disaster Text Trigger
title_ko: 재난문자 트리거를 통한 gis 정보 기반 대피안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geographic information system (GIS) information-based evacuation guidance system. More specifically, the present invention relates to an evacuation guidance system based on GIS information through a disaster text trigger, which identifies a location of a user by using a disaster text trigger, determines information such as the nearest and the head of several people at the same time, guides a way to an evacuation center at an optimal location, and provides additional information on the disaster text such as a disaster evacuation manual.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GIS(Geographic Information System: 지리정보시스템)정보 기반 길안내 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난문자 트리거를 이용하여 사용자의 위치를 파악, 가장 가깝고 동시에 몇 명이 향하는 등의 정보를 판단하여 최적 위치의 대피소로의 길안내를 진행하며, 재난 대피 매뉴얼 등 재난문자에 대한 추가 정보를 제공하는 재난문자 트리거를 통한 GIS정보 기반 대피안내 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Building fire crowd evacuation intelligent path planning system and method based on extended ground field and multiple targets SBOA
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent path planning system and method for building fire crowd evacuation based on an extended ground and multiple targets SBOA. The invention relates to the technical field of building crowd evacuation simulation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a cellular set based on a space structure of a building, collecting basic information of pedestrians of the building based on a questionnaire and a video observation mode, judging the panic degree of the pedestrians according to the basic information of the pedestrians to obtain a panic field, obtaining a dangerous field based on an FDS smoke diffusion model and according to real-time smoke concentration of fire, establishing an expanded ground field CA model based on a classical ground field CA model and the panic field and the dangerous field to obtain a current pedestrian target evacuation path, optimizing the evacuation path according to the current pedestrian target evacuation path based on a multi-target SBOA optimization algorithm, and generating an optimal evacuation path. The invention actually reflects the relation among evacuation groups, plans more reasonable evacuation paths, shortens evacuation time, improves safety, reduces casualties and improves evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Emergency path planning method based on action force grouping and improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency path planning method based on a mobile power grouping and improved ant colony algorithm, and relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation. The method comprises the steps of inquiring the number of local resident population and the reserved quantity of private cars, dividing crowd running power, distributing high-mobility crowd and low-mobility crowd to each disaster-stricken point, solving the distance from each disaster-stricken point to each shelter by using a GIS, establishing a distance matrix, solving the position of an emergency bus riding point according to accessibility, respectively establishing a high-mobility crowd evacuation model and a low-mobility crowd evacuation model, and solving the high-mobility crowd evacuation model and the low-mobility crowd evacuation model by using an ant colony algorithm. The invention considers the driving force of the people to be evacuated, so that the constructed evacuation model is more in line with the evacuation condition when the disaster occurs, and the evacuation efficiency is improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE

title_en: Emergency evacuation path planning method based on HBA optimization ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency evacuation path planning method based on an HBA optimization ant colony algorithm. The method comprises the steps of firstly initializing the number and the positions of populations, updating density factors and obtaining initial optimal path tracks x  new  based on a built indoor space two-dimensional map based on a badger optimization algorithm, then optimizing initial pheromones of an ant colony algorithm by using the obtained initial path tracks x  new , then introducing distance estimation and smoothing functions to improve transfer probability selection of the ant colony algorithm, and finally updating the pheromones of the ant colony algorithm, and forming optimal path Z output after iteration. According to the method, the melis optimization algorithm is introduced into the ant colony algorithm, the quick searching capability of the ant colony algorithm is further improved, the problem of local optimum is avoided, meanwhile, an improved heuristic function is provided by combining a smooth function and distance estimation, the convergence speed of the ant colony algorithm is further improved, and the method can be suitable for path planning in complex scenes and improve evacuation efficiency.
assignees: NANJING VOCATIONAL UNIV OF INDUSTRY TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Disaster-division type emergency refuge and evacuation method based on spatial analysis algorithm
abstract_en: A disaster-separating emergency refuge and evacuation method based on a space analysis algorithm belongs to the technical field of evacuation path planning and comprises the steps of generating a dynamic risk distribution diagram, establishing a road structure damage prediction model, determining disaster-stricken population gathering areas and requirements to be transferred, defining a search range by taking disaster-stricken personnel gathering points as the center, determining refuge places meeting evacuation requirements, generating a space topological relation diagram, constructing a disaster event dynamic evacuation model, continuously accessing a base station positioning data stream, and dynamically triggering path re-planning. The emergency evacuation path selection scheme designed by taking the multi-disaster as the background not only can effectively cope with complex and changeable multi-disaster superposition situations, but also is completely suitable for emergency response under a single-disaster background, realizes the evacuation priority grading of the evacuation path, ensures that evacuation personnel can safely reach an evacuation destination, performs optimization calculation based on personnel dynamic data, and can effectively improve the dynamic property and disaster adaptation of an evacuation path planning model.
assignees: UNIV XIAN SCI & TECHNOLOGY;XIAN JIERUI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic planning method for resident evacuation path of flood storage area based on crowd sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic planning method for resident evacuation paths in a diapause area based on crowd sensing, which belongs to the technical field of evacuation path planning, and the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in the diapause area, cleaning the multi-source heterogeneous data in the diapause area, further carrying out data fusion on the multi-source heterogeneous data after the data cleaning, updating the fused data, predicting flood condition data of a preset coordinate point, constructing a dynamic road network based on the fused data and the flood condition data of the preset coordinate point, transmitting the dynamic road network to a preset terminal according to a preset mode, finally evaluating real-time state information of the dynamic road network, and dynamically updating the dynamic road network based on an evaluation result. According to the invention, the multisource heterogeneous data and the ant colony algorithm are fused, and the multisource heterogeneous data is used as constraint conditions of the ant colony algorithm, so that the evacuation path in the flood storage area can be optimized, and the evacuation path is more reasonable.
assignees: GUANGDONG RES INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER

title_en: Mobile robot path planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mobile robot path planning method and a mobile robot path planning system, which belong to the technical field of robots, and comprise global path planning and local path planning, wherein the global path planning comprises the steps of leading in a bilateral obstacle detection algorithm and an offset obstacle avoidance method through an improved A-type algorithm, enabling the path to be constantly far away from an obstacle, avoiding collision with the obstacle during turning, simultaneously carrying out optimization and smoothing treatment on the path by combining an evacuation algorithm and a middle point outward expansion method, and generating a global optimal path, and the local path planning comprises the steps of improving a TEB algorithm, leading in a perception window and an evaluation function, and providing an acceleration and jerk dual-constraint dynamic obstacle avoidance strategy, so that stable movement of the robot in the obstacle avoidance process is ensured. The method and the device improve the path planning capacity and the transportation efficiency of the robot in complex and changeable environments by combining the advantages of global path planning and local path planning.

title_en: Control method and system of fire ventilator
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a control system of a fire ventilator, and relates to the technical field of ventilation control. The control method comprises the steps of determining fire source core coordinates according to building internal environment parameters and building external environment parameters, generating a fire situation map, pre-generating a personnel evacuation path and a plurality of reference smoke discharging paths according to building topological structures and the fire situation map, obtaining the priority of each reference smoke discharging path according to the real-time fire situation map, taking the reference smoke discharging path with the highest priority as a current smoke discharging path, configuring ventilator operation parameters according to the current smoke discharging path, determining first fire source coordinates according to BIM three-dimensional coordinates and fire intensity corresponding to each sensor node, and optimizing the first fire source coordinates through particle filtering to obtain second fire source coordinates. According to the invention, the optimal smoke discharging path is dynamically generated by combining internal and external environment data, so that the dynamic linkage control of multiple ventilators in a fire scene is realized, and the problems of data acquisition limitation and path planning rigidness in the traditional fire-fighting ventilation system are solved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU GAOBIAO FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Airport terminal passenger emergency evacuation path optimization method based on improved A-algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a station building fire evacuation path optimization method based on an improved A-algorithm, which comprises the following steps: (1) Analyzing the flow of the personnel of the terminal building, and finishing the real flight data to perform pretreatment; (2) Simulating the flow of the personnel of the terminal building by using a simulation model, and arranging personnel distribution data; (3) Analyzing the fire disaster reason of the terminal building, and simulating the fire disaster of the terminal building by using fire simulation aiming at the high-ignition fire disaster reason to obtain the fire disaster product data of the terminal building; (4) The method comprises the steps of improving a path planning algorithm, coupling personnel distribution and fire spread data, and re-planning a congestion path; the invention provides a new solution for emergency evacuation of fire disaster in the terminal building and scientific practice guidance for emergency evacuation in complex environments such as the terminal building.

title_en: System of fire monitoring with extinguishing and emergence evacuation route guidance in building
title_ko: 건물 전기선로 누전점검과 경고안내장치
abstract_en: The technical objective of the present invention is to provide a warning guide device that guides evacuation with visual and voice alarms when an electric leakage occurs, detects a leakage position, and quickly notifies a manager of the leakage position. The building electric line leakage inspection and warning guide device includes tempered glass, a gasket, a backlight unit, an audio output unit, a visual alarm, a power failure detection sensor, a capacitor, a memory, and a control unit inside a case. A rapid safety processing unit is installed on one side of the case, and the unit includes a unit housing, a first and a second tube, a pressure plate, a safety processing powder, a grate cover, and a heat transfer pipe. The apparatus controls the backlight and voice-visual alarm. The heat is transferred through the heat transfer pipe to the first tube, and the safety treatment powder is activated.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통로의 바닥면에 전기선로의 정상동작을 점검하고 비정상적으로 동작하는 장애 상태를 검출하도록 구비하여 전기선로의 오작동을 검출하고 검출된 장애발생 상황은 지정된 관리자에게 통보하며 주변 작업자에게는 시각적 신호와 청각적 신호로 동시에 경고안내장치 내부에 신속안전처리유닛을 구비하여 경고안내장치의 오작동과 누전에 의한 전기누전을 초기에 처리하고 장애 발생된 경고안내장치의 위치정보를 지정된 관리자에게 정확하게 전달하여 전기선로의 장애 발생 위치를 정확하며 신속하게 파악하는 건물 전기선로 누전점검과 경고안내장치에 관한 것이며 상측이 개방된 상자 형상의 케이스와, 케이스의 상측에 부착되고 하면에는 안전대피위치를 안내하기 위한 문자나 도형이 표시된 강화유리로 구성되고, 케이스와 강화유리의 내부에는 빛을 투과시켜 외부에서 인식될 수 있도록 하기 위한 백라이트부와, 음성으로 경보(경고) 상황을 알리고 안전대피위치를 안내하기 위한 음성출력부와, 점멸에 의해 장애 발생 등의 경보(경고)를 알리기 위한 시각 경보(경고)기와, 정전을 감지하기 위한 정전 감지 센서와, 전기누전을 감지하는 전기누전 감지 센서와, 외부 전원으로부터 전력을 충전하고 백라이트부에 전원을 공급하기 위한 축전기와, 음성출력부에 출력되는 안내 메시지가 저장되는 메모리를 구비하고, 백라이트의 점등과 상기 음성출력부로의 음성출력, 시각경보(경고)기의 점멸 등의 경고안내장치의 일련의 작용을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되어, 장애가 발생하는경우 통로의 바닥에 밀착된 상태에서도 경고안내장치의 안내 표지를 용이하게 인지할 수 있고, 안내 음성에 따라 안전하게 피신할 위치를 인지하여 신속히 대피하며, 경고안내장치의 내부에서 발생되는 전기누전을 초기에 자체 처리하고 전기누전이 포함되는 장애가 발생된 경고안내장치의 위치정보를 지정된 관리자에게 전달하여 후속조치가 빠르게 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System of fire monitoring with extinguishing and emergence evacuation route guidance in building
title_ko: 건물 전기선로 인공지능 누전점검과 장애검출 경고안내장치
abstract_en: Provided is an artificial intelligence-based leakage current inspection and fault detection warning guidance apparatus for building electrical wiring, the apparatus comprising a warning guidance device (100) including: a case (10) having a box shape; a tempered glass (20) having heat resistance and displaying characters or figures; a waterproof gasket configured to ensure airtight contact between the case (10) and the tempered glass (20); a backlight unit (30) configured to transmit light through the characters or figures displayed on the tempered glass (20) so as to be recognizable from the outside; an audio output unit (40) configured to provide voice guidance for an alarm condition and a safe evacuation location; a visual alarm device (50) configured to provide a warning by blinking; a power outage detection sensor (60); a capacitor (80) configured to supply power to the backlight unit (30); a memory (91) in which voice guidance messages are stored; and a controller (90) configured to control the backlight unit (30), the audio output unit (40), and the visual alarm device (50), wherein a rapid safety processing unit (500) is further installed on one inner side surface of the case (10). According to the present invention, since the warning guidance device includes a visual alarm device and a speaker for guidance broadcasting and is installed at a portion of a building, when an electrical leakage or the like occurs, a user can easily recognize guidance indications of the warning guidance device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통로의 바닥면에 전기선로의 정상동작을 점검하고 비정상적으로 동작하는 장애 상태를 검출하도록 구비하여 전기선로의 오작동을 검출하고 검출된 장애발생 상황은 지정된 관리자에게 통보하며 주변 작업자에게는 시각적 신호와 청각적 신호로 동시에 경고안내장치 내부에 신속안전처리유닛을 구비하여 경고안내장치의 오작동과 누전에 의한 전기누전을 초기에 처리하고 장애 발생된 경고안내장치의 위치정보를 지정된 관리자에게 정확하게 전달하여 전기선로의 장애 발생 위치를 정확하며 신속하게 파악하는 건물 전기선로 인공지능 누전점검과 장애검출 경고안내장치에 관한 것이며 상측이 개방된 상자 형상의 케이스와, 케이스의 상측에 부착되고 하면에는 안전대피위치를 안내하기 위한 문자나 도형이 표시된 강화유리로 구성되고, 케이스와 강화유리의 내부에는 빛을 투과시켜 외부에서 인식될 수 있도록 하기 위한 백라이트부와, 음성으로 경보(경고) 상황을 알리고 안전대피위치를 안내하기 위한 음성출력부와, 점멸에 의해 장애 발생 등의 경보(경고)를 알리기 위한 시각 경보(경고)기와, 정전을 감지하기 위한 정전 감지 센서와, 전기누전을 감지하는 전기누전 감지 센서와, 외부 전원으로부터 전력을 충전하고 백라이트부에 전원을 공급하기 위한 축전기와, 음성출력부에 출력되는 안내 메시지가 저장되는 메모리를 구비하고, 백라이트의 점등과 상기 음성출력부로의 음성출력, 시각경보(경고)기의 점멸 등의 경고안내장치의 일련의 작용을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성되어, 장애가 발생하는경우 통로의 바닥에 밀착된 상태에서도 경고안내장치의 안내 표지를 용이하게 인지할 수 있고, 안내 음성에 따라 안전하게 피신할 위치를 인지하여 신속히 대피하며, 경고안내장치의 내부에서 발생되는 전기누전을 초기에 자체 처리하고 전기누전이 포함되는 장애가 발생된 경고안내장치의 위치정보를 지정된 관리자에게 전달하여 후속조치가 빠르게 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire-fighting path planning system and method based on multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and discloses a fire protection path planning system and method based on multi-objective optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an influence coverage area based on coordinates of fire occurrence points, determining the number of people based on the influence coverage area, determining a personnel aggregation area based on the personnel coordinates, and distinguishing aggregation people based on the personnel aggregation area; the method comprises the steps of planning a fire escape path of each group of people by using a path planning algorithm based on the positions of the groups of people, predicting a group intersection of different groups of people on the fire escape path at a future moment if the fire escape paths corresponding to different groups of people overlap, predicting the number of people born by the next change area of the fire escape path based on the group intersection, determining whether to overlap the fire escape path based on the number of people born, and dividing the groups of people with the group intersection, so that congestion and trampling events are avoided, personnel escape safety is guaranteed, and reliability of a fire evacuation system is improved.
assignees: HEBEI XIONGAN XINGJIANG BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Personnel evacuation danger avoiding path planning method, device and storage medium based on rainfall-induced landslide dynamic early warning
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel evacuation risk avoidance path planning method, device and storage medium based on rainfall-induced landslide dynamic early warning, which comprises the steps of determining landslide easily-generated areas and landslide dangerous areas, determining intelligent body information and intelligent body characteristic attributes required to be evacuated, acquiring state attributes of all grid units, constructing corresponding state sets and action sets, constructing a reward function set, wherein each reward function in the reward function set is rewarded when an intelligent body moves in a corresponding direction from the grid unit in the current state, determining an objective function based on the reward function set, calculating gradients of strategy parameters of the objective function, iteratively updating the strategy parameters based on a depth reinforcement learning algorithm and a Monte Carlo strategy gradient algorithm by adopting a gradient ascending method, and taking a track formed by the corresponding state set and the action set when the objective function is maximum as an optimal evacuation path of the intelligent body. By adopting the planning method provided by the invention, the path can be planned more reasonably.
assignees: CHINA GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT MONITORING INSTITUTE GEOLOGICAL DISASTER TECH GUIDANCE CENTER OF MINIST;UNIV CHINA MINING & TECHNOLOGY BEIJING;HENAN PROVINCE NATURAL RESOURCES MONITORING AND STATE SOIL REGULATION INST;CHONGQING GEOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING STATION;BEIJING SHUSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: A system providing location information of field personnel in an accident ship using UWB and RFID based on Public Safety LTE communication network and controlling method for the same
title_ko: 재난안전통신망 기반 uwb 및 rfid을 활용하여 사고 선박 내의 현장 대원의 위치 정보를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The system for the disaster safety communications network base uwb and rfid being utilized and offering the location information of the field crew within the accident ship comprises a plurality of radio positioning signal transmitters: rtls terminal and rtls control server Inside of the accident ship location is produced by the rtls terminal and the safe movement route can be offered. In rfid and uwb base multiple positioning the communications instability situation, the positional accuracy can be secured. The structural efficiency and safety of the field personnel can be improved.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난안전통신망 기반 UWB 및 RFID을 활용하여 사고 선박 내의 현장 대원의 위치 정보를 제공하기 위한 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 사고선박내에 투입된 현장요원의 RTLS 단말기가 사고선박내의 일정 이격을 두고 설치된 위치신호 송출디바이스 즉, UWB와 RFID 디바이스로부터 설정된 무선측정신호를 확보하여 위치 측위정보를 산출한 다음 그 산출된 위치 측위정보를 재난안전통신망(PS-LTE)의 RTLS 관제서버로 전송하고 RTLS 관제서버로부터 현장요원들에 대한 안전한 이동경로안내정보를 제공받게 함으로써, 사고선박에 대한 구조나 구체적인 위험상황을 제대로 숙지하지 못하고 사고선박내로 현장요원들이 투입된다 하더라도 RTLS 단말기를 통해 사고선박내의 위험 상황에 따른 안전한 이동 경로로 대피할 수 있는 경로 안내와 구조할 인명의 위치를 명확히 전달받아 조치하게 되므로 그에 따라 현장요원의 사고안전성을 극대화시킬 수 있음은 물론, 현장대원의 RTLS 단말기가 위치신호 송출디바이스로부터 1차로 RFID 데이터정보를 수신하여 위치 측위정보를 산출하되, 상기 RFID 데이터정보를 수신하지 못 할 경우 인접된 다수의 UWB 데이터정보를 삼각측량법을 이용하여 선박내의 위치 측위정보를 산출하는 복수의 측위구조를 가짐으로써, 사고선박내에서 발생할 수 있는 다양한 통신환경의 위험에 대응하여 현장대원들의 위치를 정밀하게 확보하여 안전한 대피경로를 제공할 수 있다.
assignees: GUMI ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: A system that guides radiation evacuation routes based AIoT
title_ko: AIoT 기반 방사능 대피경로를 안내하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an AIoT-based radiation evacuation route guidance system; and more specifically, to an AIoT-based radiation evacuation route guidance system for guiding a radiation evacuation route in a location-based mobile web app created in various formats for general users according to machine-learned algorithm conversion result values, by constructing a database server by combining separate weather public data (open-API) such as weather, temperature, wind direction, and wind speed, and radiation shelter location public data (open-API) based on real-time radiation public data (open-API) acquired from a portable radiation detector possessed by an individual and national environmental radiation monitors installed across the country.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AIoT 기반 방사능 대피경로를 안내하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 개인이 소지한 휴대용 방사선감지기 및 전국에 설치된 국가환경방사선감시기에서 취득한 실시간 방사선 공공데이터(open-API)를 기반으로 별도의 날씨, 기온, 풍향, 풍속 등 기상 공공데이터(open-API) 및 방사능 대피소 위치 공공데이터(open-API)를 결합하여 데이터베이스 서버를 구축하고, 기계 학습된 알고리즘 변환 결과값에 따라 일반 사용자가 다양한 포맷으로 만들어진 위치정보 기반의 모바일 웹 앱에서 방사능 대피경로를 안내하기 위한 AIoT 기반 방사능 대피경로를 안내하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Smart city emergency management system and method based on multidimensional heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention discloses the technical field of smart city emergency management, in particular to a smart city emergency management system based on multidimensional heterogeneous data, which comprises a digital twin city model, a historical emergency event model, an emergency event prediction model, a multidimensional data access model, a data fusion model and an emergency event policy model, wherein the emergency event policy model is used for arranging the fused data according to a decision model, and when the emergency event prediction model is excited, the processing policy of an emergency event is given according to the decision model calculation. The smart city emergency management is realized based on the system. The intelligent city emergency management system and method integrate multidimensional data, construct an area comprehensive situation panoramic view, realize omnibearing monitoring and early warning, real-time simulation, decision planning and evacuation path planning of the urban waterlogging, traffic accidents, production safety and other high risk fields, and improve the response speed of emergency management.
assignees: NANJING NANYOU INST OF INFORMATION TEACHNOVATION CO LTD

title_en: Navigation system, and navigation method
abstract_en: To appropriately change route or evacuate when a sudden deterioration in weather.SOLUTION: A navigation system 1 includes: a bad weather estimation device 20 including a photographing data acquisition unit 21 and a bad weather detection unit 22 that detects cloud photographing data including images of clouds indicating bad weather from the photographing data and calculates the location of clouds indicating areas of bad weather based on the detected cloud photographing data; and a navigation device 40 including a route search unit 46, a route guidance unit 47, a bad weather information acquisition unit 44 that acquires bad weather information indicating bad weather from a bad weather estimation device 20, and a determination unit 45 that determines whether or not bad weather will affect a route based on the bad weather information. When it is determined that bad weather will affect the route, the route search unit 46 re-searches for a route that bypasses the area where bad weather is predicted, or searches for a temporary evacuation site.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Intelligent emergency and management and control method for stadium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency and management and control method for a stadium, and belongs to the technical field of stadium safety management and control. The method comprises the steps of collecting video stream data through a monitoring camera array, inputting the data into a pre-trained personnel density identification model to generate a real-time personnel flow distribution thermodynamic diagram, calculating retention indexes of all partitions and activating an emergency evacuation mode by combining a preset safety threshold, monitoring instantaneous personnel flow speed by an infrared sensor group in the emergency mode, generating an optimal evacuation path by a dynamic path planning algorithm, converting the path into a control instruction to drive an electromagnetic gate, emergency lighting and electronic guide marks, feeding back the data to trigger a path recalculation mechanism, and counting the number of people evacuated by a two-dimensional code scanning device to start manual review. The system and the method realize real-time situation awareness, dynamic risk assessment and intelligent evacuation guidance of the stadium, effectively improve emergency response and evacuation efficiency and ensure crowd safety.

title_en: Passenger dynamic evacuation guiding system for postal wheels
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of escape guiding of mail-wheel accidents, and discloses a mail-wheel passenger dynamic escape guiding system which comprises three modules, namely a monitoring alarm module, a path planning module and a dynamic identification module, wherein when a disaster or abnormal ship body posture of a mail-wheel triggers an alarm, the monitoring alarm module collects related data and transmits the related data in real time, the path planning module reconstructs a path network and distributes path weights according to the data, a Dijkstra algorithm for improving a searching strategy is adopted to search a globally optimal route, the dynamic identification module maps route data to an identification indication direction, the dynamic identification layout is optimized by combining with passenger perception behaviors when the system is deployed, the monitoring alarm module monitors the crowd gathering condition of each road section in real time in the escape process, and the related data is conveyed to the path planning module again to search for a new round. According to the invention, the optimal route can be planned in real time according to the accident scene of the mail wheel, and the indication direction of the evacuation mark can be dynamically adjusted, so that the dynamic guidance of crowd evacuation is realized.
assignees: SANYA SCIENCE AND EDUCATION INNOVATION PARK WUHAN UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Urban fire emergency evacuation path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
