abstract_en: The invention discloses a depth reinforcement learning-based urban fire emergency evacuation path planning method which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a dynamic environment map, S2, constructing an evacuation agent strategy network, S3, introducing an improved type of cheetah optimization algorithm into the evacuation agent strategy network, avoiding local optimization through a path jump mechanism, S4, configuring a reconnaissance module for each cheetah body by the improved type of cheetah optimization algorithm, predicting path risks and generating future risk scores, S5, fusing a current path evaluation result and the future risk scores, dynamically correcting path selection, S6, optimizing the evacuation agent strategy network through a centralized training and distribution execution mechanism, generating an optimal evacuation path instruction, S7, receiving dynamic environment map data in real time through an edge computing terminal, outputting the optimal evacuation path instruction, and supporting path rollback and reprofiling. The invention integrates deep reinforcement learning and intelligent optimization algorithm to realize intelligent planning of urban fire evacuation paths.

title_en: Fire control security protection integration system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of building safety management, and provides a fire-fighting and security-protection integrated system which comprises a multi-source data fusion module, a risk event judgment module, a three-dimensional dynamic situation generation module, an intelligent decision module, a resource dynamic scheduling module, a fire truck path planning module and pumping power adjustment module, wherein the fusion data packet comprises pressure, flow and security-protection behavior characteristics, security-protection events such as intrusion, equipment damage and crowd gathering are judged through quantification rules, the three-dimensional dynamic situation generation module is used for superposing a water pressure distribution cloud chart, security-protection event mark points and evacuation channel states in a BIM (building information model) to realize visual monitoring, and the intelligent decision module is used for evaluating expected losses by combining hydraulic calculation and security-protection data. According to the invention, through data depth fusion, accurate risk judgment and intelligent resource scheduling, the cooperative performance and response efficiency of building safety management are obviously improved, and the intelligent resource scheduling method is applicable to the fire-fighting security and protection integrated requirements in complex scenes.

title_en: Dam break flood refuge path dynamic planning model and method based on cellular automaton
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic planning model and a dynamic planning method for a dam-break flood refuge path based on cellular automaton, wherein the refuge path planning adopts a Moore neighborhood topological structure, the refuge path planning model is a calculation formula of transition probability of refuge personnel moving to adjacent cells, the dam-break flood emergency evacuation process can be discretized based on the theoretical modeling of the cellular automaton, real-time evolution rules of the dam-break flood are considered, behavior characteristics of the refuge personnel are fully considered, the assessment of a refuge transition path is limited to the path length, a multidimensional safety assessment system is also constructed, and the core indexes cover path geometric features and space-time safety parameters. The space safety criterion requires that the path topological structure strictly avoids the flood risk area and the submerged area, so that the geometric safety of the evacuation track is ensured, the time safety criterion emphasizes the time response of flood dynamics, realizes the advanced prediction of the submerged trend through a model, and ensures the reliability of the evacuation time sequence.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;UNIV HENAN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Emergency service method and medium for terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency service method and medium of terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps of accessing a city emergency management system, automatically switching a terminal to an emergency mode when emergency situations such as fire and earthquake are detected, enabling the terminal to receive real-time emergency information sent by the city emergency management system in the emergency mode, providing a refuge route navigation function, an emergency package positioning function and a one-key alarm function when the terminal is in the emergency mode, enabling the terminal to timely sense an emergency public event and automatically switch to the emergency mode through accessing the city emergency management system, providing a series of practical and key auxiliary decision functions for users, enabling the users to quickly know basic information and dangerous degrees of the event under the emergency situations, and accordingly better coping with the crisis, and enabling the refuge route navigation function to help the users to plan a safest evacuation path.
assignees: INSPUR FINANCIAL INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Non-tissue emergency escape count intelligent system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unstructured emergency escape number intelligent system which comprises a monitoring sensing end, an analysis decision end, an emergency service end, an emergency prompt end and a mobile management end, wherein by using the technology of the Internet of things, all sensing devices sense collected data in real time, monitor the opening and closing conditions of a fireproof door in a building, escape channel conditions and fire disasters, and simultaneously perform fire early warning monitoring on an electric circuit, a data analysis module performs fire point analysis on all collected data, and a path planning module analyzes the fire point and the position of a safety door in a three-dimensional virtual model of the building to generate an optimal escape path space route, selects the position of a channel indication license plate through which the space route passes and performs direction marking; the intelligent analysis and the path planning provide accurate escape route guidance for the evacuees, so as to strive for time for escape and realize effective escape of the evacuees under the non-organization condition.

title_en: Personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning data analysis, and provides a personnel evacuation path planning method for disaster prevention and reduction projects, which is characterized in that the arrival anomaly degree of each period of refuge is analyzed, the arrival anomaly degree consistency of the road section of each period of time passing through the refuge is further analyzed, the load degree of the road section of each period of time reaching the refuge is analyzed, and the congestion degree of the road section of each period of time is obtained; further analyzing the congestion diffusion degree and the congestion progressive expression degree of each time section road section to obtain the congestion involvement degree of each time section road section, and determining the diversion range; and analyzing the degree of the backward rerouting expansion of the road sections of each time period within the rerouting range, determining the expansion rerouting range, and finally determining the recommended rerouting. The method can provide reasonable evacuation route references for the dangerous personnel, reduce unnecessary injuries and confusion, maintain the evacuation order and improve the overall evacuation efficiency.

title_en: Guiding system and method for intelligently planning optimal evacuation path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a guiding system and a guiding method for intelligently planning an optimal evacuation path. The intelligent optimal evacuation path planning guiding system comprises an environment monitoring unit, a server terminal and an information service unit, wherein the server terminal is in communication connection with the environment monitoring unit and the information service unit, the environment monitoring unit is used for acquiring environment information in real time, the server terminal is used for processing data acquired by the environment monitoring unit and planning paths by using algorithms to generate evacuation paths, and the information service unit is used for converting the evacuation paths into evacuation instructions and transmitting the evacuation instructions to a user and interacting with the user terminal. The intelligent planning optimal evacuation path guiding system and method can be applied to emergency situations such as fire, earthquake and the like, intelligent planning is carried out through the system, and personnel are guided to be evacuated to a safe area rapidly and safely.

title_en: Fire safety management system based on building property information
title_ko: 건물 속성 정보를 기반으로 한 소방 안전 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire safety management system which comprehensively analyzes fire risk factors in a building, predicts the possibility of a fire in real time, and provides evacuation route guidance and warning notification when the fire occurs. More specifically, the present invention relates to a system which learns a fire risk based on data such as structural characteristics and environmental factors of a building, crowd density, past fire patterns, and the like, and evaluates a real-time risk to support efficient evacuation and management response.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건물 내 화재 위험 요소를 종합적으로 분석하고, 실시간으로 화재 발생 가능성을 예측하며, 발생 시 대피 경로 안내 및 경고 알림을 제공하는 화재 안전 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
구체적으로는 건물의 구조적 특성 및 환경적 요인, 인원 밀집도, 과거 화재 패턴 등의 데이터를 기반으로 화재 위험을 학습하고, 실시간 위험을 평가하여 효율적인 대피 및 관리 대응을 지원하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Tourist attraction route planning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tourist attraction route planning system, which relates to the technical field of big data analysis, and comprises a small program unit, a personnel induction unit, a path planning unit, an entrance preparation unit and an emergency evacuation module, wherein the small program module comprises a visual window, a user interaction module and a voice navigation module, the visual window is respectively connected with the voice navigation module and the user interaction interface, the real-time positioning and navigation are provided through a position service module integrating a GPS (global position system) and a map API (application program interface), the personalized tour route can be customized according to personal information, interest and hobbies, time arrangement and budget of a user through a preference collection module and a personalized customization module, and the customization service ensures that each tourist can obtain the tourist experience which best meets the requirements of the user, so that the user satisfaction is remarkably improved.
assignees: GANSU WANHUA JINHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue path planning method, system, equipment and medium based on building earthquake damage simulation
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency rescue path planning method, system, equipment and medium based on building earthquake disaster simulation, relating to the field of rescue path planning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional structure of a building based on a two-dimensional plan of the building in which the earthquake disaster occurs; the method comprises the steps of processing a three-dimensional structure of a building by a physical engine to obtain building damage and road surface accumulation results under an earthquake, extracting an indoor and outdoor integrated road network from the building damage and the road surface accumulation results under the earthquake by a navigation grid method to obtain a road network extraction result, planning a path by adopting an optimized A-type algorithm based on the road network extraction result to obtain an emergency rescue path planning result. The application can meet the requirements of evacuation safety, trafficability, traffic capacity constraint and strain, and provides indoor and outdoor integrated path planning service for search and rescue personnel so as to respond to the emergency optimal rescue path requirement.

title_en: Road tunnel emergency evacuation path planning method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway tunnel emergency evacuation path planning method, system, equipment and medium, which comprise the steps of collecting disaster data at fixed time intervals, generating a plurality of optional escape paths according to the disaster data, calculating real escape rates of all the optional escape paths, calculating the predicted escape rate of each optional escape path according to the disaster data, dynamically generating correction weights according to the change degree of toxic gas concentration at the current moment and the last moment, dynamically correcting the real escape rate of each optional path according to the correction weights, and selecting the optional escape path with the highest real escape rate as an evacuation path. The invention solves the problems that the escape route planning in the prior art depends on a fixed topological model and a preset rule, and only takes the shortest route as an optimization target, so that the generated escape route is disjointed from disaster evolution, and the planned route is inconsistent with the actual situation.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Transmission tower rush-repair method and system based on aerostat
abstract_en: A transmission tower rush-repair method and system based on an aerostat comprises the steps of calculating an optimal transportation path based on acquired meteorological data, map data and flight performance parameters of the aerostat and a path planning algorithm based on reinforcement learning, determining whether a protection mechanism is triggered or not based on real-time equipment states monitored by a visual recognition system carried by the aerostat in the transportation process adopting the optimal transportation path, and after reaching a rush-repair point, using a hover control system of the aerostat, combining real-time environment data and equipment installation requirements, adopting a hover algorithm based on fuzzy control to keep the stable hover state of the aerostat, and calculating the optimal evacuation path by adopting a dynamic planning algorithm according to environment data of an evacuation path and the bearing capacity of the aerostat after the rush-repair is completed. The invention realizes intelligent transportation, installation and evacuation of high-altitude equipment in a complex environment, and improves the operation efficiency and safety.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER ENGINEERING RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST

title_en: Dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation system and a dynamic environment-aware fire intelligent evacuation method, which relate to the technical field of fire protection and safety protection and comprise the steps of collecting real-time data in a fire scene, dividing an evacuation area into a plurality of grid units by utilizing a two-dimensional rasterization technology to form a real-time updated environment map, combining dynamic modeling data, generating an optimal evacuation path by utilizing an improved path planning algorithm, transmitting the evacuation path to trapped people in real time in a visual and auditory mode, wherein the visual and auditory mode comprises the use of dynamic indicator lamps, marker lamps, an electronic screen and a voice broadcasting system, adjusting guide content by combining the real-time data, optimizing evacuation efficiency, linking fire-fighting equipment, optimizing the environment of the evacuation path, and monitoring evacuation states by a dynamic data feedback mechanism. According to the invention, through the integrated sensor network, the dynamic modeling of the fire scene and the intelligent path planning algorithm, the evacuation path is calculated and updated in real time, and a safe and efficient evacuation scheme is provided for trapped people in the fire.
assignees: ANHUI ZHENGHUA TONGAN FIRE PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam break flood emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on improved NSGA-III
abstract_en: According to the dam-break flood emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on the improved NSGA-III, dam-break flood simulation, evacuation point and refuge point selection, multi-objective optimization and heuristic strategies are fused, efficient evacuation path optimization for people with different priorities can be achieved under the extreme dam-break scene, the overall evacuation efficiency and the priority are improved, and an evacuation optimization model adapting to the spatial distribution characteristics of flood risks is constructed by carrying out two-dimensional unsteady flow dam-break simulation in HEC-RAS and combining with scientific selection and priority division of the evacuation point and the refuge point by an ArcGIS Pro platform.

title_en: Chemical plant personnel positioning management system based on GIS technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a chemical plant personnel positioning management system based on GIS technology, in particular to the technical field of positioning management, which comprises a high-precision positioning base station deployment module, an environment information sensing module, a personnel track data acquisition module, a personnel track data analysis module, a personnel track abnormality early warning module, a personnel intelligent scheduling module and an intelligent path planning module, by using the built-in multi-source sensor, intelligent sensing of multi-source environment risks is realized, personnel density, evacuation efficiency and environment risk values of each UWB positioning base station area are obtained, an evacuation response index is calculated, an optimal path is generated, personnel track early warning indexes are calculated through personnel track data, potential safety problems are found in time, the efficiency of abnormal recognition is improved, personnel scheduling priority scores are calculated through personnel task execution data, personnel scheduling is optimized, and overall production efficiency is improved.

title_en: Real-time acquisition and fusion scheduling method for converged communication platform internet of things data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time acquisition and fusion scheduling method for data of a fusion communication platform Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of data fusion and scheduling. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source traffic data, user travel demands and environmental factor data, and generating a travel path planning scheme through a multi-mode data fusion model. The model includes a weather effect sub-model and an emergency response sub-model. Further, the weight of the planning scheme is dynamically adjusted according to the real-time position and the trip emergency degree of the user, and if the weight exceeds a threshold value, a capacity allocation or diversion instruction is triggered. Under the emergency situations such as rail transit delay, an emergency scheduling mode is activated, delay time length, peripheral congestion and the number of affected passengers are comprehensively considered, a compensatory scheduling scheme is generated, the compensatory scheduling scheme comprises a bus connection scheduling and sharing bicycle directional delivery strategy, a connection route is optimized through a dynamic path planning method, and evacuation efficiency is improved. According to the method, through multi-source data fusion and dynamic decision, the traffic scheduling accuracy and the emergency response capability are effectively improved.

title_en: Route planning method for miniature unmanned aerial vehicle for emergency indoor navigation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency indoor navigation miniature unmanned aerial vehicle route planning method, which comprises the steps of constructing an initial indoor threat image, establishing a safety performance maximization flight-adaptive area extraction model, realizing indoor navigation network construction and local shortest flight path planning, planning a global flight route by using a navigation breadth angle sequencing algorithm, and completing the optimization of the flight route of an optimal three-dimensional unmanned aerial vehicle of a travel company algorithm. The invention aims to solve the problem of flight route planning in consideration of route economy, rescue people, flight safety and the like. The calculation example result shows that the unmanned aerial vehicle navigation system can ensure the unmanned aerial vehicle arbitrary route planning of the flight safety under the unmanned aerial vehicle emergency condition by using the navigation argument sequencing algorithm, and the method can provide an effective flight route for the indoor unmanned aerial vehicle navigation and improve the efficiency and safety of personnel evacuation.

title_en: Route guidance system based on digital twin technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a route guidance system based on a digital twin technology, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model management module, a route planning module, a route indication module and a driver, wherein the route indication module is used for controlling a dynamic indicator to rotate and indicate directions according to evacuation routes planned by the route planning module, the dynamic indicator comprises an outer ring body and an indicator arrow shell, the driver is used for receiving control instructions of the route indication module and controlling a rotating shaft to rotate, a first green lamp panel is arranged on one opposite side of the indicator arrow shell, a red lamp panel is arranged on the end face of the arrow side of the indicator arrow shell, a second green lamp panel is arranged on the end face of the other side of the indicator arrow shell, a red annular lamp body is arranged on the outer ring surface of the arrow side of the indicator arrow shell, and a green annular lamp body is arranged on the other side surface of the outer ring body. Compared with the prior art, the invention solves the problem that the emergency evacuation scheme of the public building simulation system lacks a reliable guidance system combined with the emergency evacuation scheme.
assignees: ZHONGKE HUANSEN WISDOM TECH SUZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Emergency Evacuation Route Guidance Light Unit
title_ko: 비상대피로 안내등유닛
abstract_en: The emergency evacuation guide light unit comprises: a plate-shaped unit main body arranged to surround a central area; a panel unit arranged in the central area of the unit main body, and having a lighting arranged inside to output outward light and a guide panel guiding a position of an emergency door; an emergency unit including a communication unit communicating with an external device, an emergency call button for an emergency call, a speaker outputting a voice, and a microphone receiving the voice of a user; and a control unit storing a preset control terminal for the emergency call, controlling the communication unit to be connected to the preset control terminal when the emergency call button is pressed by the user, controlling the speaker to output the voice received from the preset control terminal, and controlling the communication unit to transmit the received voice from the preset control terminal when the voice of the user is received by the microphone.
abstract_ko: 비상대피로 안내등유닛은 중앙영역을 둘러싸며 배치되는 판상의 유닛본체, 유닛본체의 중앙영역에 배치되며, 내측에 배치되어 외향 광을 출력하는 조명 및 비상문의 위치를 안내하는 안내판넬을 갖는 판넬유닛, 외부장치와 통신하는 통신부, 비상호출을 위한 비상호출버튼, 음성을 출력하는 스피커 및 사용자의 음성을 수신하는 마이크를 포함하는 비상유닛, 비상호출을 위한 기설정 관제단말기를 저장하며, 사용자에 의해 비상호출버튼이 눌리면 기설정 관제단말기와 연결되도록 통신부를 제어하고, 기설정 관제단말기로부터 수신되는 음성이 출력되도록 스피커를 제어하며, 사용자의 음성이 마이크에 수신되면 수신된 음성이 기설정 관제단말기로부터 전송되도록 통신부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus for Evacuation Simulation for Radiological Emergency in Nuclear Power Plants and Method thereof
title_ko: 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for simulating introduction of radiation in emergency of a nuclear power plant. The apparatus is a radiation emergency introduction simulation device of a nuclear power plant, and comprises an environment setting unit which sets information on evacuees on the road using a plurality of alternative actors based on an alternative model and an actor-based model, and acquires past traffic volume information and past weather information according to conditions under which introduction simulation is performed. The introduction simulation apparatus may further include an introduction simulation unit configured to calculate an exposure route, which is a route of a radioactive material, when a wide area evacuation occurs due to a radiation emergency in a nuclear power plant, perform a route search to a position outside the exposure route for the plurality of alternative actors according to a moving speed for each of the plurality of alternative actors determined based on past traffic information, past weather information, and the exposure route, and perform an introduction simulation for the plurality of alternative actors.
abstract_ko: 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다.  이 장치는 원자력발전소 방사선 비상시 소개 시뮬레이션 장치로서, 대체 모델과 행위자 기반 모델에 기반한 복수의 대체 행위자를 이용하여 도로 상의 대피자에 대한 정보를 설정하고, 소개 시뮬레이션이 수행되는 조건에 따른 과거의 교통량 정보와 과거의 기상 정보를 획득하는 환경 설정부를 포함한다.  상기 소개 시뮬레이션 장치는 원자력발전소에서 방사선 비상으로 인해 광역 대피가 발생하였을 때 방사성 물질의 경로인 피폭 경로를 계산하고, 과거의 교통량 정보, 과거의 기상 정보 및 피폭 경로에 기반하여 결정되는 복수의 대체 행위자별 이동 속도에 따라 복수의 대체 행위자에 대한 피폭 경로를 벗어난 위치까지의 경로 탐색을 수행하여 복수의 대체 행위자에 대한 소개 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 소개 시뮬레이션부를 더 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Intelligent building fire disaster recognition and simulation early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building fire disaster identification and simulation early warning method and system, which belong to the technical field of building informatization and disaster prevention and control, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to realize early fire disaster identification, intelligent fire disaster prediction and dynamic evacuation path planning, and improve fire disaster identification accuracy and response speed; the multi-mode data acquisition comprises the steps of adopting a vision, environment and space multi-mode sensor to acquire data, carrying out feature fusion on the acquired data by using a multi-channel deep convolution network to generate unified space-time fire characterization, constructing a video-sensing-geometric data collaborative perception network on the basis of the space-time fire characterization, improving recognition robustness in a complex environment, carrying out intelligent recognition and decision, carrying out early warning control linkage, and carrying out post-disaster evaluation feedback.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster self-adaptive dynamic escape channel intelligent guiding system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent guiding system and method for a multi-disaster self-adaptive dynamic escape channel, comprising a data acquisition layer, an intelligent analysis layer and a decision execution layer, wherein the data acquisition layer is used for collecting various environment and equipment data in real time, the intelligent analysis layer is used for judging the type of a disaster which occurs currently, calculating the risk level according to an evaluation formula aiming at different disasters, then a path planning algorithm module is used for planning an optimal escape path for different disasters according to a risk evaluation result in combination with personnel position information, and the decision execution layer is used for guiding the escape path planned in the path planning algorithm module to be evacuated safely. The invention solves the complex decision problem under the condition of multi-disaster coupling, ensures that people can be safely evacuated when a plurality of disasters are concurrent, realizes the dynamization and the intellectualization of evacuation instructions, and improves the response speed and the accuracy of the people to escape guidance, thereby obviously improving the escape efficiency and the safety of the people when the disasters happen in a large underground factory building.

title_en: Underground automatic driving path planning method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an underground automatic driving path planning method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of automatic driving control. The method comprises the steps of determining safety distances between vehicles, planning a plurality of transportation roadways which only allow one-way transportation of automatic driving vehicles, repeatedly arranging the transportation roadways in a mode of single-row in two first directions and single-row in two second directions, enabling vehicles at the channel opening of a vehicle head towards an evacuation channel to enter the evacuation channel closest to the channel opening when one transportation roadway fails, enabling at least one transportation roadway at two sides of the failure point transportation roadway to serve as the evacuation roadway, enabling the vehicles at the channel opening of the evacuation channel to adjust the safety distance of the vehicles to be 2 times, and enabling the vehicles driving out of the evacuation channel to be inserted into the middle of the vehicles in the evacuation channel. The invention can efficiently evacuate the blocked automatic driving vehicle and can avoid the problems of congestion or collision of the automatic driving vehicle in the evacuation process.
assignees: SHANXI FENGQINGHENG ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire alarm information processing method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire alarm information processing method, a fire alarm information processing system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of fire alarm information management. And determining a rescue path and a personnel evacuation path based on the fire disaster area, performing fire extinguishing treatment based on the rescue path, and performing personnel evacuation treatment based on the personnel evacuation path. The invention can determine the central position of fire occurrence and the starting point of path planning at the first time by determining the fire area, and can ensure the safe evacuation of personnel by determining the rescue path and the manual evacuation path, and simultaneously can provide a quick path for the rescue of firefighters, thereby avoiding the expansion of fire and the loss of property to the greatest extent.
assignees: BEIJING METRO CONSTRUCTION ADMINISTRATION CORP LTD

title_en: Urban building group three-dimensional function partition and floor population dynamic distribution method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for three-dimensional functional partitioning of urban building groups and dynamic population distribution of floors, and relates to the technical field of urban space information processing. The method comprises the steps of constructing semantic feature vectors of multi-source POI data based on a BERT model and domain specific words to generate fusion data, constructing a floor position probability distribution model according to a three-layer progressive reasoning structure and a reasoning technology, carrying out three-dimensional function partitioning according to function coupling strength and an improved spectral clustering algorithm, generating demographic data of a building level to construct a differential attraction model, and solving a floor population distribution constraint optimization model according to the improved half model to obtain population dynamic distribution of each floor. The invention breaks through the granularity limit of the traditional functional partition, realizes the refined three-dimensional functional partition of the floor level and the population dynamic distribution prediction, and provides important decision support for the applications such as business site selection, emergency evacuation path planning, public service facility configuration optimization and the like in the smart city construction.

title_en: Flood disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system with space-earth cooperation
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of flood monitoring, and provides an air-ground collaborative flood disaster real-time monitoring and early warning system which comprises an air-ground multi-source data acquisition end, a cloud platform, a mobile terminal and a mobile terminal, wherein the multi-source data acquisition end is used for transmitting multi-source data acquired by a satellite observation unit, an aerial remote sensing unit and a ground sensing unit to the cloud platform through a first communication unit, the cloud platform is used for generating a flood risk dynamic assessment result and early warning information through data analysis and assessment and transmitting the flood risk dynamic assessment result and the early warning information to the mobile terminal, and the mobile terminal is used for generating an emergency strategy comprising an evacuation path planning, a material scheduling scheme and a risk avoidance instruction and outputting a corresponding executable operation instruction. According to the invention, through setting the data interaction of the acquisition end, the cloud platform and the mobile terminal, the accuracy and the comprehensiveness of flood monitoring of some complex scenes are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire disaster intelligent evacuation guiding robot system based on multi-mode sensing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode sensing-based intelligent evacuation guiding robot system for tunnel fires, which belongs to the technical field of tunnel fire-fighting equipment and comprises a multi-source sensing fusion unit, a hierarchical communication decision unit, a dynamic path planning unit, a multi-mode guiding unit and an intelligent inspection unit, wherein the multi-source sensing fusion unit is used for constructing a three-dimensional point cloud map of a tunnel with centimeter-level precision according to collected data and updating dynamic environment in real time, the hierarchical communication decision unit is used for ensuring stability and reliability of signal transmission under different working conditions by adopting dual-mode communication, the dynamic path planning unit is used for generating and optimizing a safe evacuation path in real time, and finally the multi-mode guiding unit is used for guiding people in three modes of vision, hearing and human body posture tracking, so that evacuation crowd is ensured. The robot system can realize intelligent and efficient evacuation guidance of a tunnel fire scene, improves the efficiency and safety of rescue actions, and avoids unnecessary confusion and danger.

title_en: Subway evacuation dynamic decision simulation system based on virtual reality and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway evacuation dynamic decision simulation system based on virtual reality and artificial intelligence, which comprises an environment modeling module, an agent generation module, an evacuation behavior decision module, a path planning module and a man-machine interaction module which are in communication coupling, wherein the environment modeling module is used for constructing a three-dimensional subway tunnel evacuation scene and integrating fire scene dynamic data, the agent generation module generates heterogeneous agent groups based on demographic data, the evacuation behavior decision module adopts an improved social force-agent model and a finite state machine to realize agent behavior decision, the path planning module implements a three-level navigation algorithm to realize global path planning and local path dynamic adjustment, and the man-machine interaction module acquires participant behavior data through VR equipment and interacts with a simulation environment in real time. The method has the advantages that the interaction between the real person evacuation behavior and the intelligent body is realized through the highly simulated environment and the intelligent decision model, and the efficiency and the scientificity of subway tunnel emergency evacuation exercise are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI TUNNEL ENGINEERING & RAIL TRANSIT DESIGN AND RES INSTITUTE;SHANGHAI SHENTONG METRO GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI SHENTONG METRO CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD;SHANGHAI INST OF DISASTER PREVENTION AND RELIEF

title_en: Disaster Damage and Earthquake Impact Prediction-Based Evacuation Range Estimation and Management System
title_ko: 풍수해 및 지진 피해 예측 기반 대피 범위 추정 및 관리 시스템

title_en: Indoor escape route optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning, in particular to an indoor escape route optimization method and system. The method comprises the steps of constructing a layered road network model, receiving monitoring data of the Internet of things to conduct danger diffusion simulation and predict danger areas when danger occurs, acquiring crowd distribution information by combining a camera and a Wi-Fi probe to obtain a predicted personnel distribution map in a preset time zone, conducting escape route optimization in the preset time zone according to the predicted danger areas and the predicted personnel distribution map by utilizing the layered road network model, outputting an optimal escape scheme, respectively sending a plurality of optimal escape routes to a plurality of associated escape personnel through equipment terminals, and executing route dynamic update according to danger sensing data until personnel evacuation is completed. The optimal escape scheme suitable for different dangerous scenes and personnel distribution conditions can be rapidly and accurately planned.
assignees: HEBEI BRANCH OF CHINA TOWER CORPORATION LTD

title_en: Urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge system
abstract_en: An urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge system belongs to the technical field of urban flood disaster early warning and emergency refuge. In order to solve the problem that a scheme capable of carrying out early warning and emergency refuge guidance according to the area where flood disasters are expected to occur is lacking at present. The system comprises a flood disaster prediction and early warning unit, an emergency shelter and a path planning unit, wherein the flood disaster prediction and early warning unit is used for taking the area exceeding the threshold value of the water accumulation depth as the area where the flood disaster is likely to occur and early warning according to the weather satellite cloud image and corresponding precipitation prediction data of a target city, the ground elevation data of the city, the city construction drainage pipe network and drainage capacity data and the city road network data, the emergency shelter is screened out from the area where the flood disaster is not likely to occur based on the position of the emergency shelter, the reachability prediction is carried out, and the emergency shelter is comprehensively determined according to the cost of the reachability prediction and the elevation of the emergency shelter, and the path planning is carried out, so that the emergency shelter is evacuated.

title_en: Intelligent fire safety assessment method and system for building
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire safety assessment method and system for a building, which relate to the technical field of fire safety and comprise the steps of performing spatial registration and interpolation calculation on a risk thermodynamic diagram and a hierarchical early warning level, generating an evacuation guiding diagram, performing dynamic path planning to obtain an optimal evacuation route, performing spatial coverage comparison on the basis of the optimal evacuation route and the evacuation guiding diagram, obtaining a route coverage, generating a route effectiveness verification result through coverage efficiency matching, performing risk correlation analysis according to the route effectiveness verification result and preprocessed multi-source data, generating a risk correction factor, and obtaining a safety assessment report through multi-criterion decision analysis. According to the invention, through the risk tensor integral model and the multi-objective optimization algorithm, real-time and accurate assessment of the fire safety risk of the building is realized, and scientific guidance is provided for emergency evacuation.

title_en: Visitor identity management system with accurate and efficient face recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visitor identity management system with accurate and efficient face recognition, which relates to the technical field of visitor management, wherein high-definition cameras with active near infrared technology are deployed in each key area of a mail wheel, facial features are extracted by using a deep-learning convolutional neural network model, identity is accurately verified, and the safety of the mail wheel is effectively ensured. And multiple standard network protocols are used for obtaining multisource data such as the mail wheel track, the equipment operation, the weather, the personnel health and the like for different systems, and a basis is provided for operation decisions. And passenger flow monitoring equipment is installed in each play area, and passenger flow real-time monitoring, risk early warning and current limiting are realized by combining a risk assessment model, so that the experience of tourists is optimized. APP integrates positioning and path planning functions, evacuation is guided by means of multi-mode interaction and AR technology in emergency, and emergency response efficiency is improved by cross-system collaborative linkage. Meanwhile, data safety and authority management are guaranteed, early warning optimization and intelligent adjustment are carried out, and system performance and service quality are comprehensively improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU HANGHUI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire prevention, control and emergency treatment system for underground factory building
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire prevention and control and emergency treatment system for an underground factory building, which relates to the technical field of safety protection of underground power stations and comprises a fire detection module, a gas fire extinguishing module, a smoke discharging control module, an evacuation guiding module and a central control module. The fire detection module is provided with a smoke detector, a temperature detector and a gas concentration monitor, accurate fire identification is achieved through multiple judging standards, the gas fire extinguishing module is used for extinguishing a fire by adopting carbon dioxide or nitrogen, secondary damage is avoided, the smoke discharging control module is linked with the fire detection, the working state of a fan is intelligently adjusted, the evacuation guiding module comprises a dynamic path planning unit, evacuation routes are adjusted in real time according to dangerous grade division, and the central control module is used for managing all subsystems uniformly to achieve coordinated linkage response. The invention effectively solves the problems of delay fire early warning, poor fire extinguishing effect, untimely smoke discharging, difficult evacuation and the like of the underground factory building.

title_en: Big data driven urban fire prevention and control intelligent decision method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical fields of computer science and technology, data science and big data, and discloses a big data driven urban fire prevention and control intelligent decision method and system, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition processing end, a decision analysis end and a decision execution end, and the multi-source data fusion is realized through a frequency consistency judgment and interpolation algorithm; the method comprises the steps of constructing a static and dynamic combined data matrix of urban fire, dynamically matching the type of an optimal prevention and control decision algorithm based on a hawk optimization algorithm, generating prevention and control scheme data comprising evacuation path planning, resource allocation schemes and fire control strategies, establishing a closed-loop feedback mechanism real-time correction scheme, and connecting a fire control management platform and an Internet of things sensor network through a data bus. The invention breaks through three technical bottlenecks of multi-source data fusion distortion, decision algorithm solidification and response closed loop deletion, and realizes the reduction of fire prediction errors, the improvement of scheme generation efficiency and the reduction of major fire casualties.
assignees: WUHAN XINRUIFA FIRE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent security method and device for industrial park, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of Internet of things, and provides an intelligent security method, an intelligent security device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for an industrial park. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment and feature fusion on sensor data to obtain environment perception data, carrying out face feature recognition and hierarchical authorization processing on the environment perception data to obtain regional personnel data, carrying out disaster prediction coupling on the regional personnel data and the environment perception data to obtain risk evolution data, carrying out evacuation path planning on the risk evolution data and the regional personnel data to obtain evacuation navigation data, and carrying out emergency response processing on the evacuation navigation data and real-time position coordinates of personnel to obtain a device control instruction set. The application realizes refinement, real-time and automation in all links of environment perception, identity management, risk prediction, evacuation navigation and emergency response, and improves the safety protection capability of an industrial park.
assignees: ANKE PREFERRED SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning device and method based on campus broadcasting
abstract_en: The invention discloses earthquake early warning equipment and method based on campus broadcasting, which are characterized in that building response coupling analysis is carried out by receiving an early warning signal of an earthquake monitoring center to generate a shock level-building coupling characteristic, the shock level-building coupling characteristic is mapped into an enhanced early warning source of acoustic environment adaptation, acoustic cavity detection is carried out based on the recognition of a wizard area to construct a differential playing topology, a high-risk gathering area is extracted through personnel density scanning to generate personalized evacuation guiding content and determine playing priority, high-precision time sequence control is realized by adopting a synchronous reference anchor point technology, a multi-mode playing domain is constructed through carrier modulation and frequency division multiplexing, and finally, the accurate scheduling and playing of an acoustic navigation field to guide an audio signal can be realized according to the shock resistance characteristic and acoustic environment characteristic of different buildings, so that differential playing and accurate coverage of early warning information are realized, and an intelligent acoustic solution is provided for campus earthquake early warning.
assignees: FUZHOU BENYANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: HPSO-IGWO algorithm-based evacuation path dynamic planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for dynamically planning an evacuation path based on HPSO-IGWO algorithm, and relates to the technical field of fire safety and emergency evacuation. The system mainly comprises a fire information acquisition module, a data processing coordination module, a path planning module and an evacuation indication module. The fire information acquisition module acquires information such as the position, smoke concentration and temperature of a fire disaster through a sensor, transmits acquired data to the data processing coordination module, the data processing coordination module transmits the data to the path planning module, so that the path planning and optimization are carried out on an evacuation path by utilizing a HPSO-IGWO algorithm, the path is dynamically adjusted according to the real-time condition of the fire disaster, the safety and the optimality of the evacuation path are ensured, finally, the path planning module transmits planned evacuation path information to each LED evacuation indicator through a wireless sensor network, and the indicators display evacuation directions in real time according to the information transmitted by the server, so that people are guided to evacuate along the planned path.

title_en: Disaster avoidance place starting and path planning decision-making method considering urban water affair system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster avoidance place starting and path planning decision method considering an urban water system, which comprises the steps of obtaining rainfall update forecast data under rainfall events in a target area, constructing a decision scene, namely establishing an urban waterlogging simulation model through the urban water system data, inputting the rainfall update forecast data into the urban waterlogging simulation model to generate a inundation scene, obtaining space-time distribution of disaster-stricken personnel evacuation demands in each building, obtaining the function change condition of a road network, constructing a multi-stage evacuation decision frame, namely considering disaster avoidance place cost and disaster-stricken personnel transfer risk, constructing a double-objective optimization mathematical model, updating a double-objective optimization mathematical model solving result, and carrying out path planning for disaster-stricken personnel needing to be transferred to obtain an optimal transfer path. The invention balances the cost of disaster avoidance places and the transfer risk of disaster-stricken personnel, solves the inherent error in forecasting rainfall, and dynamically optimizes decision in the process that rainfall information is gradually clear along with the time.
assignees: CHINA ENERGY ENGINEERING GROUP ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Fire rescue path searching method, device and system based on Internet of things architecture
abstract_en: The application provides a fire rescue path searching method, device and system based on an Internet of things architecture. The method comprises the steps of acquiring fire scene information in real time through an Internet of things architecture, running a pre-established hybrid particle swarm optimization-whale optimization model, and generating a global optimal rescue path based on the fire scene information. The method combines a particle swarm algorithm and a whale optimization algorithm, finds the optimal escape route for the evacuee through the PSO in the early search stage, thereby accelerating the particle convergence speed, realizing quick optimization, introducing the relevant dependence in WOA management fire disaster event and the learning phenomenon of the evacuee in the middle search stage, and enhancing the capability of the particle jumping out of local optimization. Meanwhile, the hybrid particle swarm optimization-whale optimization model is combined with the Internet of things architecture, can acquire fire scene information in real time, dynamically adjust rescue paths, overcome the limitation of a traditional path planning method in a complex fire environment, and provide accurate path planning support for fire rescue.

title_en: Subway multi-line transfer station flood multi-target dynamic evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway multi-line transfer station flood multi-target dynamic evacuation path planning method which comprises the steps of establishing a three-dimensional space model by acquiring subway station structure information and abstracting the three-dimensional space model into network representation, acquiring real-time water condition information by utilizing a hydrological sensor and video monitoring, preprocessing and fusing the real-time water condition information to generate water condition sensing data under unified time-space reference, acquiring in-station crowd information in real time by video target detection, calculating people flow density and traffic capacity to form people flow situation sensing data, combining water condition, people flow situation and trafficability constraint, adopting a real-time path search algorithm to generate a plurality of group evacuation path candidate schemes for different types of passengers, classifying evacuation paths according to the types of the passengers, issuing evacuation guidance through a multi-terminal channel, and realizing differential dynamic guidance of outbound passengers, transfer passengers and passengers with inconvenient actions. The method can respond to flood disasters and people flow changes in real time, and the evacuation efficiency and the security of subway transfer stations are improved.

title_en: Autonomous obstacle avoidance path planning system of low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle and control method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicles, in particular to an autonomous obstacle avoidance path planning system and a control method of a low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a path planning module, a control module and the unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring environmental data around the unmanned aerial vehicle, the environmental data comprises optical data and magnetic field data, the data processing module is used for processing the acquired data of the data acquisition module and acquiring a barrier distribution diagram around the unmanned aerial vehicle, the path planning module is used for adjusting the moving path of the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the processing result of the data processing module, and the control module is used for controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the moving path acquired by the path planning module. The scheme detects the obstacle through introducing the geomagnetic field, is favorable to making up the detection error that traditional optical detection equipment brought, simultaneously, detects the obstacle through the magnetic field, is favorable to detecting the obstacle that is sheltered from by the field of view.
assignees: JIUCHUANG ZHIHANG GUANGXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Artificial intelligent space people stream evacuation path planning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence space people stream evacuation path planning method which comprises the steps of determining a space region, collecting space people stream data, establishing a path planning model, outputting an optimal evacuation path scheme and carrying out safety supervision. The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, in particular to an artificial intelligence space traffic evacuation path planning method, which adopts a path traffic capacity model based on crowd density to consider the correction of traffic capacity by crowd density, comprehensively balances safety, time and capacity factors to a multi-objective path fusion control model to obtain path comprehensive scores, then calculates and determines the evacuation optimal direction trend through a dynamic path gradient field, and obtains a decision threshold through a fuzzy decision control equation to adapt to complex situations; and (3) arranging optimal path scheme data of the evacuation planning model by adopting a data processing technology and a visualization technology, calculating evaluation indexes and visually displaying to provide people stream evacuation navigation guidance.

title_en: Safety detection device and method for air supply pipe of aircraft ground air conditioner
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety detection device and a safety detection method for an air supply pipe of an air conditioner on the ground of an airplane, which belong to the technical field of safety control of ground guarantee equipment of the airplane and comprise a touch screen integrated machine (HMI), an aviation plug sensor, a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC), an overrunning switch and an audible and visual alarm unit. The navigation plug sensor is used for collecting state signals of whether the air valve is mechanically inserted and locked in place in real time, the PLC receives and processes input signals, executes a preset safety interlocking logic program and outputs control instructions to the chassis driving circuit, the touch screen integrated machine provides full parameter state display, history fault record, system setting and man-machine interaction functions, the overrun switch is used as a hardware emergency bypass, and emergency evacuation authorization with the highest priority is provided when the interlocking system fails. According to the invention, through a software and hardware double interlocking mechanism, the accurate and reliable detection and forced interlocking of the connection state of the air valve are realized, and the safety and automation level of the operation of the ground air conditioning system of the aircraft are greatly improved.
assignees: WUXI SNOW GULL MOVE AIR CONDITION CO LTD

title_en: Airport emergency rescue intelligent navigation method and system based on scene understanding
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to an airport emergency rescue intelligent navigation method and system based on scene understanding, which responds to alarm information and determines the position of an alarm dangerous source and the information of vehicles to be scheduled, and establishing a multi-target risk avoiding path planning mathematical model of the evacuation and rescue vehicles, planning an objective function of the risk avoiding path of the vehicles to be scheduled, and solving the objective function to obtain an optimal running path of the vehicles to be scheduled. According to the invention, the scene recognition technology is utilized to rapidly plan the danger avoiding route, so that the cooperative navigation of the evacuation vehicles and the rescue vehicles is realized, and various vehicles are guided to the nearest safe parking area or the rescue target position.
assignees: HUNAN AIRPORT MAN GROUP CO LTD;HUNAN XINGCHENG HAOYU TECH CO LTD

title_en: High-rise building pedestrian positioning and tracking system based on ILS (information and tracking system) searching strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of surveying and discloses a high-rise building pedestrian positioning and tracking system based on an ILS (information and tracking system) searching strategy. The system comprises a signal acquisition and preprocessing module, a multi-source data fusion positioning module, an ILS path searching and optimizing module, a dynamic environment modeling module and a decision and instruction issuing module, wherein the positioning accuracy is improved by fusing wireless signals and inertial navigation data, an optimal evacuation path is dynamically planned based on an iterative local search algorithm, and meanwhile, obstacle and congestion states are perceived by combining a real-time environment model, so that efficient and robust pedestrian positioning guidance and emergency evacuation management are realized. According to the invention, through the multi-source data fusion positioning module, the wireless signal positioning and the inertial navigation technology are combined, the inherent error of a single technology is effectively restrained by using a Kalman filtering algorithm, the positioning precision and stability under a complex building environment with serious signal shielding and multipath effects are remarkably improved, and a reliable data base is laid for the follow-up accurate path planning.

title_en: Intelligent escape evacuation indication system of hydropower station and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of escape evacuation, in particular to an intelligent escape evacuation indicating system of a hydropower station and a control method thereof, comprising the steps of collecting three-dimensional space data and real-time operation parameters of the hydropower station, and establishing a digital twin model of the hydropower station environment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out risk assessment on a digital twin model to obtain a risk assessment matrix, optimizing an evacuation strategy of an action set according to a Q-learning algorithm to obtain an evacuation path planning table, embedding emergency constraint conditions into the evacuation path planning table, verifying path feasibility according to a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm, carrying out path reconstruction on a region with equipment blockage or structural damage, calculating the shortest safety distance of an alternative path according to the Dijkstra algorithm to obtain an optimized evacuation scheme, and carrying out noise suppression on a prediction result to obtain an evacuation instruction set. According to the invention, the Monte Carlo tree search and Dijkstra algorithm are used for rescheduling the alternative path, so that personnel can find the safest evacuation route, and the strain capacity of the system under complex and sudden conditions is improved.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency evacuation method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire emergency evacuation method, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring personnel status data and environment risk data in a preset period, carrying out dynamic quantitative analysis on the environment risk data through a pre-trained infectious disease dynamics model and cellular automaton fusion algorithm on the basis of a preset digital twin building model to obtain a space-time risk probability map, generating corresponding evacuation paths for personnel in different areas by adopting a path planning algorithm based on the personnel status data and the space-time risk probability map, and outputting evacuation guiding instructions according to the personnel status data and the evacuation paths. The method improves evacuation safety and efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR WISDOM BUILDING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intersection accident evacuation scheduling method for cooperation of unmanned aerial vehicle and large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides an intersection accident evacuation scheduling method for cooperation of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a large language model, and relates to the technical fields of intelligent traffic management, unmanned aerial vehicle application and artificial intelligent multi-mode fusion. The method comprises the steps of generating an optimized inspection route based on a large language model, controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle cluster to collect multi-mode data of intersection nodes of an urban road network, using a multi-mode fusion module enhanced by the large language model to fuse multi-source heterogeneous data, inputting the multi-mode large language model based on a traffic special Prompt template to generate a semantic report containing accident positioning, influence assessment and resource requirements, converting a natural language decision output by the large model into a structural control instruction, combining real-time load elasticity of the road network to adjust signal lamp timing and lane allocation strategies, and synchronously issuing multi-mode guide instructions through a variable information board, a vehicle-mounted terminal and a navigation APP.

title_en: Intelligent building-oriented emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method and related equipment thereof
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of building emergency evacuation path planning, and particularly provides an emergency evacuation path dynamic planning method for an intelligent building and related equipment thereof, which mainly comprise the steps of acquiring building real-time monitoring data, preprocessing the real-time monitoring data, and obtaining building security situation data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out threat diffusion simulation and region division on building security situation data to obtain security region division data, carrying out personnel cluster analysis and social force model prediction on the basis of the building security situation data to obtain personnel evacuation behavior prediction data and evacuation bottleneck early warning data. The application realizes the accurate adaptation of evacuation paths, on-site threat spreading trend and real-time change of personnel flow, avoids personnel from sinking into an unwarranted threat area, reduces local congestion, and effectively shortens the whole evacuation time.

title_en: Subway station emergency evacuation route planning method based on brain-like pulse neural network
abstract_en: A subway station emergency evacuation route planning method based on a brain-like pulse neural network belongs to the crossing field of traffic transportation and intelligent computation. The invention discloses a multi-objective path planning method for a large passenger flow scene of a subway station, which is based on a Brain-like pulse neural network (Brain-INSPIRED SPIKING NeuralNetwork, BSNN) to construct an evacuation environment map structure and combines crowd heterogeneity modeling and personalized path objective functions. The method integrates neural network modeling based on a topological graph, objective function design of multi-type passenger demands, a pulse-driven rapid optimizing mechanism and a congestion prediction algorithm based on membrane potential change, and realizes self-adaptive path adjustment and congestion avoidance flow guidance among different demand personnel. The system dynamically generates personalized paths through a time sequence control and path state iterative updating mechanism, and remarkably improves evacuation efficiency and road utilization rate in a high-density people stream environment. Simulation experiments show that the method can shorten the whole evacuation time by about 48% in the subway peak period scene, improves the path utilization rate by 27%, has good response speed and self-adjusting capability, and is suitable for an intelligent decision support system of multi-scene emergency evacuation tasks.

title_en: Passive personnel positioning and path planning method and system for indoor emergency evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a passive personnel positioning and path planning method and a system for indoor emergency evacuation, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing high-density sampling on geomagnetic data of a key area of an indoor emergency evacuation scene, preprocessing the geomagnetic data, and generating a geomagnetic reference map of the key area according to the preprocessed geomagnetic data; and positioning the pedestrian position in real time, and carrying out evacuation route planning based on a geomagnetic reference map through a particle filtering fusion positioning model based on pedestrian positioning data and geomagnetic data. The method and the device have the advantages that geomagnetic data of key areas of indoor emergency evacuation scenes are sampled, geomagnetic reference diagrams are generated, accuracy and reliability of positioning and path planning of the emergency evacuation scenes by the model are improved, the built particle filter fusion positioning model optimizes the aggregation degree of position information, and a path searching mechanism and a path recalculating mechanism are combined for further optimization to obtain a final evacuation route, so that real-time positioning accuracy and system stability in the emergency evacuation scenes are improved.

title_en: Intelligent park comprehensive management and control system and method based on multi-mode data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of integrated management of intelligent parks and discloses an intelligent park comprehensive management and control system and method based on multi-mode data analysis, wherein the intelligent park comprehensive management and control method based on multi-mode data analysis comprises the steps of obtaining a park multi-dimensional real-time data stream, and extracting a current situation characteristic vector and a personnel distribution thermodynamic diagram; and generating a dynamic evacuation path planning and resource scheduling scheme based on a graph optimization algorithm, constructing a minimum cost flow optimization problem with a weighted sum of time cost and waiting time as an objective function, and solving to obtain an optimal people flow distribution scheme. The invention solves the problem that the emergency response can not adapt to the dynamic environment change. Experience knowledge cannot be effectively inherited and utilized. The emergency response system has the technical problems of slow response and improper resource allocation.
assignees: ZHONGWU GEZHONG SHENZHEN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster people transfer bus route planning method and system considering transfer urgency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster transfer bus route planning method and system considering transfer urgency, and relates to the field of emergency transfer arrangement. The method comprises the steps of constructing an evaluation index system of the transferring urgency of a disaster recovery point according to disaster information and transferring requirements of the disaster recovery point, calculating subjective-objective fusion weights of the evaluation index system by utilizing a game theory, determining transferring urgency sequences of different disaster recovery points based on a TOPSIS method, defining delayed evacuation dissatisfaction indexes, constructing a continuous operation emergency public transportation evacuation path planning model among different disaster recovery points, carrying out transferring urgency coding on transferring urgency coefficients of the disaster recovery points, constructing a corresponding harmony-genetic optimization algorithm, and solving the emergency public transportation evacuation path planning model based on the harmony-genetic optimization algorithm of the transferring urgency coding. The invention judges the urgency degree of the transfer of each disaster-stricken point, thereby realizing reasonable arrangement of the dispatching of the evacuation vehicles.
assignees: UNIV ZHENGZHOU;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE

title_en: Dynamic planning method and system for emergency evacuation path
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic planning method and a system for an emergency evacuation path, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a facility network diagram, and solving the facility network diagram by using a Di-Jie-Tet method to obtain an initial shortest path from a starting point to an ending point; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time facility information in real time, planning an initial evacuation path by utilizing a differential creative search method according to the real-time facility information to obtain a new path, taking the new path as the new evacuation path, taking the new evacuation path as the initial evacuation path, repeating planning iteration until the iteration times reach a preset value, ending the iteration, and outputting the evacuation path as a final result. When the iteration number reaches a preset value, the invention performs preliminary path calculation by using Di Jie Style, and further solves the problem that the existing path planning cannot comprehensively, quickly and in real time plan the escape path by combining a differential creative search method with the real-time path condition.
assignees: CCCC FOURTH HARBOR ENG INST CO;SOUTHERN MARINE SCIENCE AND ENG GUANGDONG LABORATORY ZHUHAI

title_en: Crowd evacuation method based on coupling of emotion infection and social force model
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of crowd simulation and emergency evacuation, and provides a crowd evacuation method based on coupling of emotion infection and social force models, which comprises the following steps of constructing an emotion infection model based on SEIRS frames, dividing individual emotion states into an easy state, an exposed state, an infected state and a recovered state, dynamically adjusting the infection rate and the recovery rate through a feedback function, establishing a social force model, embedding emotion values into target driving force and inter-individual repulsive force calculation, realizing real-time adjustment of emotion on exercise behaviors, and fusing Global path planning and an ant colony pheromone mechanism, and introducing a density perception cost function and an pheromone guiding force to realize dynamic blocking avoidance; and designing a bidirectional feedback mechanism, and triggering local path reconstruction when congestion is detected. The invention realizes the bidirectional coupling of emotion transmission and behavior decision, improves the authenticity and adaptability of evacuation simulation, and can provide scientific basis for emergency management and evacuation strategy optimization in public places.

title_en: Access control emergency control method, system, medium and electronic equipment based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application discloses an access control emergency control method, a system, a medium and electronic equipment based on multi-source data, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing environment data acquired in real time by various sensors deployed in a building according to a preset period to obtain a multi-dimensional data set; the method comprises the steps of determining whether a building meets preset entrance guard emergency conditions according to a multi-dimensional data set, planning an optimal escape path according to the multi-dimensional data set and a preset dynamic escape path planning function when the building meets the preset entrance guard emergency conditions, unlocking an entrance guard electromagnetic lock in the optimal escape path of the entrance guard to link a preset laser module for projection, and continuously executing the steps of acquiring and preprocessing environment data acquired in real time by various sensors deployed in the building according to a preset period. Therefore, by adopting the embodiment of the application, the problem of false alarm of a single sensor can be effectively avoided. Meanwhile, the escape route can be dynamically planned, and the escape route is projected in parallel with the preset laser module, so that the escape risk is reduced.
assignees: BEIJING CHINA TRANSINFO STOCK CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent dynamic nuclear emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of path planning, in particular to a multi-agent dynamic nuclear emergency evacuation path planning method and system based on deep reinforcement learning. In particular to a multi-agent optimized path generation and dynamic adjustment method based on a deep reinforcement learning technology, aiming at improving the instantaneity, safety and execution efficiency of public evacuation paths in emergency nuclear events. According to the scheme, the optimal evacuation path is automatically explored by deep reinforcement learning, a path model is not required to be manually preset, complex factors such as pollution dynamic diffusion and traffic jam in a nuclear accident scene can be dealt with, and the efficiency and safety of emergency evacuation path planning are greatly improved. The system is suitable for public emergency response systems in high-risk environments such as nuclear accidents, earthquakes, fires, urban explosions and the like.

title_en: Flood emergency path planning method
